verses.original: ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਹਮਰਾ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਪਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh sukh hamaraa tis hee paasaa ||
verses.translation: I place my pain and pleasure before Him.

verses.original: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਨੋ ਸਭੁ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਪੜਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: raakh leeno sabh jan kaa paRadhaa ||
verses.translation: He covers the faults of His humble servant.
Nanak sings His Praises. ||4||19||32||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
The whiner whines every day.

verses.original: ਬਲਨ ਬਰਤਨ ਕਉ ਸਨਬੰਧੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: balan baratan kau sanaba(n)dh chit aaiaa ||
verses.translation: His attachment to his household and entanglements cloud his mind.
If someone becomes detached through understanding,

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਫਿਰਿ ਸੋਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: janam maran fir sog na hoi ||1||
verses.translation: he will not have to suffer in birth and death again. ||1||
All of his conflicts are extensions of his corruption.
How rare is that person who takes the Naam as his Support. ||1||Pause||
The three-phased Maya infects all.
Whoever clings to it suffers pain and sorrow.
There is no peace without meditating on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
By great good fortune, the treasure of the Naam is received. ||2||
One who loves the actor in his mind,
later regrets it when the actor takes off his costume.
The shade from a cloud is transitory,
like the worldly paraphernalia of attachment and corruption. ||3||
If someone is blessed with the singular substance,
then all of his tasks are accomplished to perfection.
One who obtains the Naam, by Guru's Grace
- O Nanak, his coming into the world is certified and approved. ||4||20||33||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
Slandering the Saints, the mortal wanders in reincarnation.
Slandering the Saints, he is diseased.
Slandering the Saints, he suffers in pain.
The slanderer is punished by the Messenger of Death. ||1||
Those who argue and fight with the Saints

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਦੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tin ni(n)dhak naahee kichh saadh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: - those slanderers find no happiness at all. ||1||Pause||
Slandering the devotees, the wall of the mortal's body is shattered.
Slandering the devotees, he suffers in hell.

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ ਗਲੈ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat kee ni(n)dhaa garabh meh galai ||
verses.translation: Slandering the devotees, he rots in the womb.

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਰਾਜ ਤੇ ਟਲੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bhagat kee ni(n)dhaa raaj te Talai ||2||
verses.translation: Slandering the devotees, he loses his realm and power. ||2||
The slanderer finds no salvation at all.
He eats only that which he himself has planted.
He is worse than a thief, a lecher, or a gambler.
The slanderer places an unbearable burden upon his head. ||3||
The devotees of the Supreme Lord God are beyond hate and vengeance.
Whoever worships their feet is emancipated.
The Primal Lord God has deluded and confused the slanderer.
O Nanak, the record of one's past actions cannot be erased. ||4||21||34||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is for me the Vedas and the Sound-current of the Naad.
Through the Naam, my tasks are perfectly accomplished.
The Naam is my worship of deities.
The Naam is my service to the Guru. ||1||
The Perfect Guru has implanted the Naam within me.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਤਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sabh te uootam har har kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The highest task of all is the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||
The Naam is my cleansing bath and purification.
The Naam is my perfect donation of charity.
Those who repeat the Naam are totally purified.
Those who chant the Naam are my friends and Siblings of Destiny. ||2||
The Naam is my auspicious omen and good fortune.
The Naam is the sublime food which satisfies me.
The Naam is my good conduct.
The Naam is my immaculate occupation. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai man vasiaa prabh ek ||
verses.translation: All those humble beings whose minds are filled with the One God

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕ ॥
verses.translit: sagal janaa kee har har Tek ||
verses.translation: have the Support of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man tan naanak har gun gaau ||
verses.translation: O Nanak, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord with your mind and body.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Lord bestows His Name. ||4||22||35||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
You bless the poor with wealth, O Lord.
Countless sins are taken away, and the mind becomes immaculate and pure.
All the mind's desires are fulfilled, and one's tasks are perfectly accomplished.
You bestow Your Name upon Your devotee. ||1||
Service to the Lord, our Sovereign King, is fruitful and rewarding.

verses.original: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨਹਾਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: karan karaavanahaar suaamee taa te birathaa koi na jai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Our Lord and Master is the Creator, the Cause of causes; no one is turned away from His Door empty-handed. ||1||Pause||
God eradicates the disease from the diseased person.
God takes away the sorrows of the suffering.
And those who have no place at all - You seat them upon the place.
You link Your slave to devotional worship. ||2||
God bestows honor on the dishonored.
He makes the foolish and ignorant become clever and wise.
The fear of all fear disappears.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਅਪਨੇ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਬਸੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jan apane kai har man basai ||3||
verses.translation: The Lord dwells within the mind of His humble servant. ||3||
The Supreme Lord God is the Treasure of Peace.
The Ambrosial Name of the Lord is the essence of reality.
Granting His Grace, He enjoins the mortals to serve the Saints.
O Nanak, such a person merges in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||4||23||36||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t ma(n)ddal meh har man vasai ||
verses.translation: In the Realm of the Saints, the Lord dwells in the mind.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਦੁਰਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਨਸੈ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t ma(n)ddal meh dhurat sabh nasai ||
verses.translation: In the Realm of the Saints, all sins run away.
In the Realm of the Saints, one's lifestyle is immaculate.
In the Society of the Saints, one comes to love the One Lord. ||1||
That alone is called the Realm of the Saints,
where only the Glorious Praises of the Supreme Lord God are sung. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣੁ ਰਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t ma(n)ddal meh janam maran rahai ||
verses.translation: In the Realm of the Saints, birth and death are ended.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਮੰਡਲ ਮਹਿ ਜਮੁ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਕਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t ma(n)ddal meh jam kichhoo na kahai ||
verses.translation: In the Realm of the Saints, the Messenger of Death cannot touch the mortal.
In the Society of the Saints, one's speech becomes immaculate
In the realm of the saints, the Lord's Name is chanted. ||2||
The Realm of the Saints is the eternal, ever-stable place.
In the Realm of the Saints, sins are destroyed.
In the Realm of the Saints, the immaculate sermon is spoken.
In the Society of the Saints, the pain of egotism runs away. ||3||
The Realm of the Saints cannot be destroyed.
In the Realm of the Saints, is the Lord, the Treasure of Virtue.
The Realm of the Saints is the resting place of our Lord and Master.
O Nanak, He is woven into the fabric of His devotees, through and through. ||4||24||37||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
Why worry about disease, when the Lord Himself protects us?

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਦੂਖੁ ਸੰਤਾਪੁ ॥
verses.translit: tis jan hoi na dhookh sa(n)taap ||
verses.translation: That person whom the Lord protects, does not suffer pain and sorrow.
That person, upon whom God showers His Mercy
- Death hovering above him is turned away. ||1||
The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is forever our Help and Support.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਆਵੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਜਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jis cheet aavai tis sadhaa sukh hovai nikaT na aavai taa kai jaam ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: When He comes to mind, the mortal finds lasting peace, and the Messenger of Death cannot even approach him. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਇਹੁ ਨ ਸੋ ਤਬ ਕਿਨਹਿ ਉਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jab ih na so tab kineh upaiaa ||
verses.translation: When this being did not exist, who created him then?
What has been produced from the source?
He Himself kills, and He Himself rejuvenates.
He cherishes His devotees forever. ||2||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਹਾਥ ॥
verses.translit: sabh kichh jaanahu tis kai haath ||
verses.translation: Know that everything is in His Hands.
My God is the Master of the masterless.

verses.original: ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhukh bha(n)jan taa kaa hai naau ||
verses.translation: His Name is the Destroyer of pain.

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sukh paaveh tis ke gun gaau ||3||
verses.translation: Singing His Glorious Praises, you shall find peace. ||3||
O my Lord and Master, please listen to the prayer of Your Saint.
I place my soul, my breath of life and wealth before You.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਭ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਧਿਆਏ ॥
verses.translit: eih jag teraa sabh tujheh dhiaae ||
verses.translation: All this world is Yours; it meditates on You.
Please shower Nanak with Your Mercy and bless him with peace. ||4||25||38||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
With Your Support, I survive in the Dark Age of Kali Yuga.
With Your Support, I sing Your Glorious Praises.
With Your Support, death cannot even touch me.
With Your Support, my entanglements vanish. ||1||
In this world and the next, I have Your Support.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਏਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sabh meh raviaa saahib ek ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The One Lord, our Lord and Master, is all-pervading. ||1||Pause||
With Your Support, I celebrate blissfully.
With Your Support, I chant the Guru's Mantra.
With Your Support, I cross over the terrifying world-ocean.
The Perfect Lord, our Protector and Savior, is the Ocean of Peace. ||2||
With Your Support, I have no fear.
The True Lord is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.
With Your Support, my mind is filled with Your Power.
Here and there, You are my Court of Appeal. ||3||
I take Your Support, and place my faith in You.
All meditate on God, the Treasure of Virtue.

verses.original: ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: jap jap anadh kareh tere dhaasaa ||
verses.translation: Chanting and meditating on You, Your slaves celebrate in bliss.
Nanak meditates in remembrance on the True Lord, the Treasure of Virtue. ||4||26||39||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
First, I gave up slandering others.

verses.original: ਉਤਰਿ ਗਈ ਸਭ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਦਾ ॥
verses.translit: autar giee sabh man kee chi(n)dhaa ||
verses.translation: All the anxiety of my mind was dispelled.
Greed and attachment were totally banished.
I see God ever-present, close at hand; I have become a great devotee. ||1||
Such a renunciate is very rare.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam japai jan soi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Such a humble servant chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||
I have forsaken my egotistical intellect.
The love of sexual desire and anger has vanished.
I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
In the Company of the Holy, I am emancipated. ||2||
Enemy and friend are all the same to me.
The Perfect Lord God is permeating all.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਾਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kee aagiaa maan sukh paiaa ||
verses.translation: Accepting the Will of God, I have found peace.
The Perfect Guru has implanted the Name of the Lord within me. ||3||
That person, whom the Lord, in His Mercy, saves
that devotee chants and meditates on the Naam.

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਮਤਿ ਲਈ ॥
verses.translit: man pragaas gur te mat liee ||
verses.translation: That person, whose mind is illumined, and who obtains understanding through the Guru

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਈ ॥੪॥੨੭॥੪੦॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak taa kee pooree piee ||4||27||40||
verses.translation: - says Nanak, he is totally fulfilled. ||4||27||40||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
There is no peace in earning lots of money.
There is no peace in watching dances and plays.
There is no peace in conquering lots of countries.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sarab sukhaa har har gun gaae ||1||
verses.translation: All peace comes from singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||
You shall obtain peace, poise and bliss,

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਹਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat paieeaai vaddabhaagee gurmukh har har naam kahahu ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: when you find the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, by great good fortune. As Gurmukh, utter the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||
Mother, father, children and spouse - all place the mortal in bondage.
Religious rituals and actions done in ego place the mortal in bondage.
If the Lord, the Shatterer of bonds, abides in the mind,

verses.original: ਤਉ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਬਸੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tau sukh paavai nij ghar basai ||2||
verses.translation: then peace is obtained, dwelling in the home of the self deep within. ||2||
Everyone is a beggar; God is the Great Giver.
The Treasure of Virtue is the Infinite, Endless Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਰਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis no karam kare prabh apanaa ||
verses.translation: That person, unto whom God grants His Mercy

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਤਿਨੈ ਜਨਿ ਜਪਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har har naam tinai jan japanaa ||3||
verses.translation: - that humble being chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||
I offer my prayer to my Guru.
O Primal Lord God, Treasure of Virtue, please bless me with Your Grace.
Says Nanak, I have come to Your Sanctuary.
If it pleases You, please protect me, O Lord of the World. ||4||28||41||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
Meeting with the Guru, I have forsaken the love of duality.
As Gurmukh, I chant the Name of the Lord.
My anxiety is gone, and I am in love with the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
I was asleep for countless lifetimes, but I have now awakened. ||1||
Granting His Grace, He has linked me to His service.

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saadhoo sa(n)g sarab sukh paae ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all pleasures are found. ||1||Pause||
The Word of the Guru's Shabad has eradicated disease and evil.
My mind has absorbed the medicine of the Naam.
Meeting with the Guru, my mind is in bliss.
All treasures are in the Name of the Lord God. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਕੀ ਮਿਟੀ ਜਮ ਤ੍ਰਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: janam maran kee miTee jam traas ||
verses.translation: My fear of birth and death and the Messenger of Death has been dispelled.
In the Saadh Sangat, the inverted lotus of my heart has blossomed forth.
Singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, I have found eternal, abiding peace.
All my tasks are perfectly accomplished. ||3||
This human body, so difficult to obtain, is approved by the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਫਲ ਹੋਈ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: safal hoiee jap har har naam ||
verses.translation: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, it has become fruitful.
Says Nanak, God has blessed me with His Mercy.
With every breath and morsel of food, I meditate on the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||29||42||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sabh te uoochaa jaa kaa naau ||
verses.translation: His Name is the Highest of all.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sadhaa taa ke gun gaau ||
verses.translation: Sing His Glorious Praises, forever and ever.
Meditating in remembrance on Him, all pain is dispelled.
All pleasures come to dwell in the mind. ||1||
O my mind, meditate in remembrance on the True Lord.

verses.original: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: halat palat tumaree gat hoi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In this world and the next, you shall be saved. ||1||Pause||
The Immaculate Lord God is the Creator of all.
He gives sustenance to all beings and creatures.
He forgives millions of sins and mistakes in an instant.
Through loving devotional worship, one is emancipated forever. ||2||
True wealth and true glorious greatness,

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਤੇ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur poore te nihachal mat paiee ||
verses.translation: and eternal, unchanging wisdom, are obtained from the Perfect Guru.
When the Protector, the Savior Lord, bestows His Mercy,
all spiritual darkness is dispelled. ||3||
I focus my meditation on the Supreme Lord God.
The Lord of Nirvaanaa is totally pervading and permeating all.
Eradicating doubt and fear, I have met the Lord of the World.
The Guru has become merciful to Nanak. ||4||30||43||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
Meditating in remembrance on Him, the mind is illumined.
Suffering is eradicated, and one comes to dwell in peace and poise.
They alone receive it, unto whom God gives it.
They are blessed to serve the Perfect Guru. ||1||
All peace and comfort are in Your Name, God.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar mere man gaau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, O my mind, sing His Glorious Praises. ||1||Pause||
You shall receive the fruits of your desires,
when the Name of the Lord comes to dwell in the mind.
Meditating on the Lord, your comings and goings cease.

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਭਾਇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bhagat bhai prabh kee liv lai ||2||
verses.translation: Through loving devotional worship, lovingly focus your attention on God. ||2||
Sexual desire, anger and egotism are dispelled.
Love and attachment to Maya are broken.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਟੇਕ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kee Tek rahai dhin raat ||
verses.translation: Lean on God's Support, day and night.
The Supreme Lord God has given this gift. ||3||
Our Lord and Master is the Creator, the Cause of causes.
He is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of all hearts.
Bless me with Your Grace, Lord, and link me to Your service.
Slave Nanak has come to Your Sanctuary. ||4||31||44||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਲਾਜ ਮਰੈ ਜੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਲੇਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: laaj marai jo naam na levai ||
verses.translation: One who does not repeat the Naam, the Name of the Lord, shall die of shame.
Without the Name, how can he ever sleep in peace?

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਛਾਡਿ ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਚਾਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: har simaran chhaadd param gat chaahai ||
verses.translation: The mortal abandons meditative remembrance of the Lord, and then wishes for the state of supreme salvation;
but without roots, how can there be any branches? ||1||
O my mind, meditate on the Guru, the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਉਤਾਰੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: janam janam kee mail utaarai ba(n)dhan kaaT har sa(n)g milai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The filth of countless incarnations shall be washed away. Breaking your bonds, you shall be united with the Lord. ||1||Pause||
How can a stone be purified by bathing at a sacred shrine of pilgrimage?
The filth of egotism clings to the mind.
Millions of rituals and actions taken are the root of entanglements.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਪੂਲੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har ke bhajan bin birathaa pool ||2||
verses.translation: Without meditating and vibrating on the Lord, the mortal gathers only worthless bundles of straw. ||2||
Without eating, hunger is not satisfied.
When the disease is cured, then the pain goes away.
The mortal is engrossed in sexual desire, anger, greed and attachment.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨਾ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਪਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jin prabh keenaa so prabh nahee jaapiaa ||3||
verses.translation: He does not meditate on God, that God who created him. ||3||

verses.original: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਧੰਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhan dhan saadh dha(n)n har naau ||
verses.translation: Blessed, blessed is the Holy Saint, and blessed is the Name of the Lord.
Twenty-four hours a day, sing the Kirtan, the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
Blessed is the devotee of the Lord, and blessed is the Creator Lord.
Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God, the Primal, the Infinite. ||4||32||45||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
When the Guru was totally pleased, my fear was taken away.
I enshrine the Name of the Immaculate Lord within my mind.
He is Merciful to the meek, forever Compassionate.
All my entanglements are finished. ||1||
I have found peace, poise, and myriads of pleasures.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਟੇ ਭੈ ਭਰਮਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨ ਭਨੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)g miTe bhai bharamaa a(n)mrit har har rasan bhane ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, fear and doubt are dispelled. My tongue chants the Ambrosial Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||Pause||
I have fallen in love with the Lord's Lotus Feet.
In an instant, the terrible demons are destroyed.

verses.original: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਾਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: aaTh pahar har har jap jaap ||
verses.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, I meditate and chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
The Guru is Himself the Savior Lord, the Lord of the Universe. ||2||
He Himself cherishes His servant forever.
He watches over every breath of His humble devotee.
Tell me, what is the nature of human beings?

verses.original: ਜਮ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਥ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jam te raakhai dhe kar haath ||3||
verses.translation: The Lord extends His Hand, and saves them from the Messenger of Death. ||3||
Immaculate is the Glory, and Immaculate is the way of life,
of those who remember the Supreme Lord God in their minds.
The Guru, in His Mercy, has granted this Gift.
Nanak has obtained the treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||33||46||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
My Guru is the All-powerful Lord, the Creator, the Cause of causes.
He is the Soul, the Breath of Life, the Giver of Peace, always near.
He is the Destroyer of fear, the Eternal, Unchanging, Sovereign Lord King.
Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, all fear is dispelled. ||1||
Wherever I look, is the Protection of Your Sanctuary.

verses.original: ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bal bal jaiee satigur charanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Feet of the True Guru. ||1||Pause||
My tasks are perfectly accomplished, meeting the Divine Guru.
He is the Giver of all rewards. Serving Him, I am immaculate.
He reaches out with His Hand to His slaves.
The Name of the Lord abides in their hearts. ||2||
They are forever in bliss, and do not suffer at all.
No pain, sorrow or disease afflicts them.
Everything is Yours, O Creator Lord.
The Guru is the Supreme Lord God, the Inaccessible and Infinite. ||3||
His Glorious Grandeur is immaculate, and the Bani of His Word is wonderful!
The Perfect Supreme Lord God is pleasing to my mind.
He is permeating the waters, the lands and the skies.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੩੪॥੪੭॥
verses.translit: naanak sabh kichh prabh te hoi ||4||34||47||
verses.translation: O Nanak, everything comes from God. ||4||34||47||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ਰਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਰਣੇ ॥
verses.translit: man tan raataa raam ra(n)g charane ||
verses.translation: My mind and body are imbued with the Love of the Lord's Feet.
All the desires of my mind have been perfectly fulfilled.
Twenty-four hours a day, I sing of the Lord God.
The True Guru has imparted this perfect wisdom. ||1||
Very fortunate are those who love the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਤਰੈ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tis kai sa(n)g tarai sa(n)saar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Associating with them, we cross over the world-ocean. ||1||Pause||
They are spiritual teachers, who meditate in remembrance on the One Lord.
Wealthy are those who have a discriminating intellect.
Noble are those who remember their Lord and Master in meditation.
Honorable are those who understand their own selves. ||2||
By Guru's Grace, I have obtained the supreme status.
Day and night I meditate on the Glories of God.
My bonds are broken, and my hopes are fulfilled.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਰਿਦ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har ke charan ridh maeh nivaasaa ||3||
verses.translation: The Feet of the Lord now abide in my heart. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak jaa ke pooran karamaa ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, one whose karma is perfect

verses.original: ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਆਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: so jan aaiaa prabh kee saranaa ||
verses.translation: that humble being enters the Sanctuary of God.
He himself is pure, and he sanctifies all.
His tongue chants the Name of the Lord, the Source of Nectar. ||4||35||48||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਕਿਛੁ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: naam lait kichh bighan na laagai ||
verses.translation: Repeating the Naam, the Name of the Lord, no obstacles block the way.
Listening to the Naam, the Messenger of Death runs far away.
Repeating the Naam, all pains vanish.
Chanting the Naam, the Lord's Lotus Feet dwell within. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਿਰਬਿਘਨ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: nirabighan bhagat bhaj har har naau ||
verses.translation: Meditating, vibrating the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is unobstructed devotional worship.

verses.original: ਰਸਕਿ ਰਸਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: rasak rasak har ke gun gaau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord with loving affection and energy. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਕਿਛੁ ਚਾਖੁ ਨ ਜੋਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: har simarat kichh chaakh na johai ||
verses.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, the Eye of Death cannot see you.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੈਤ ਦੇਉ ਨ ਪੋਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: har simarat dhait dheau na pohai ||
verses.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, demons and ghosts shall not touch you.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਮੋਹੁ ਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਬਧੈ ॥
verses.translit: har simarat moh maan na badhai ||
verses.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, attachment and pride shall not bind you.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਰੁਧੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har simarat garabh jon na rudhai ||2||
verses.translation: Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, you shall not be consigned to the womb of reincarnation. ||2||
Any time is a good time to meditate in remembrance on the Lord.
Among the masses, only a few meditate in remembrance on the Lord.
Social class or no social class, anyone may meditate on the Lord.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜਾਪੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jo jaapai tis kee gat hoi ||3||
verses.translation: Whoever meditates on Him is emancipated. ||3||
Chant the Name of the Lord in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: har ke naam kaa pooran ra(n)g ||
verses.translation: Perfect is the Love of the Lord's Name.
O God, shower Your Mercy on Nanak,
that he may think of you with each and every breath. ||4||36||49||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
He Himself is the Shaastras, and He Himself is the Vedas.
He knows the secrets of each and every heart.

verses.original: ਜੋਤਿ ਸਰੂਪ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਵਥੁ ॥
verses.translit: jot saroop jaa kee sabh vath ||
verses.translation: He is the Embodiment of Light; all beings belong to Him.
The Creator, the Cause of causes, the Perfect All-powerful Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਓਟ ਗਹਹੁ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: prabh kee oT gahahu man mere ||
verses.translation: Grab hold of the Support of God, O my mind.

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਰਾਧਹੁ ਦੁਸਮਨ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal gurmukh aaraadhahu dhusaman dhookh na aavai nere ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, worship and adore His Lotus Feet; enemies and pains shall not even approach you. ||1||Pause||
He Himself is the Essence of the forests and fields, and all the three worlds.
The universe is strung on His Thread.
He is the Uniter of Shiva and Shakti - mind and matter.
He Himself is in the detachment of Nirvaanaa, and He Himself is the Enjoyer. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਤਤ ਤਤ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jat kat pekhau tat tat soi ||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, there He is.
Without Him, there is no one at all.
In the Love of the Naam, the world-ocean is crossed.
Nanak sings His Glorious Praises in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||3||

verses.original: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਭੁਗਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਵਸਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit: mukat bhugat jugat vas jaa kai ||
verses.translation: Liberation, the ways and means of enjoyment and union are under His Control.

verses.original: ਊਣਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਛੁ ਜਨ ਤਾ ਕੈ ॥
verses.translit: uoonaa naahee kichh jan taa kai ||
verses.translation: His humble servant lacks nothing.
That person, with whom the Lord, in His Mercy, is pleased
- O slave Nanak, that humble servant is blessed. ||4||37||50||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
The minds of the Lord's devotee are filled with bliss.
They become stable and permanent, and all their anxiety is gone.

verses.original: ਭੈ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਗਏ ਖਿਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhai bhram binas ge khin maeh ||
verses.translation: Their fears and doubts are dispelled in an instant.
The Supreme Lord God comes to dwell in their minds. ||1||
The Lord is forever the Help and Support of the Saints.

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭ ਠਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: ghar baahar naale paramesar rav rahiaa pooran sabh Thai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Inside the home of the heart, and outside as well, the Transcendent Lord is always with us, permeating and pervading all places. ||1||Pause||
The Lord of the World is my wealth, property, youth and ways and means.
He continually cherishes and brings peace to my soul and breath of life.

verses.original: ਅਪਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਦੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਹਾਥ ॥
verses.translit: apane dhaas kau dhe raakhai haath ||
verses.translation: He reaches out with His Hand and saves His slave.

verses.original: ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਛੋਡੈ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸਾਥ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: nimakh na chhoddai sadh hee saath ||2||
verses.translation: He does not abandon us, even for an instant; He is always with us. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: har saa preetam avar na koi ||
verses.translation: There is no other Beloved like the Lord.
The True Lord takes care of all.
The Lord is our Mother, Father, Son and Relation.
Since the beginning of time, and throughout the ages, His devotees sing His Glorious Praises. ||3||

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਧਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਾ ਮਨਿ ਜੋਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: tis kee dhar prabh kaa man jor ||
verses.translation: My mind is filled with the Support and the Power of the Lord.
Without the Lord, there is no other at all.
Nanak's mind is encouraged by this hope,
that God will accomplish my objectives in life. ||4||38||51||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਭੈ ਕਉ ਭਉ ਪੜਿਆ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: bhai kau bhau paRiaa simarat har naam ||
verses.translation: Fear itself becomes afraid, when the mortal remembers the Lord's Name in meditation.

verses.original: ਸਗਲ ਬਿਆਧਿ ਮਿਟੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਕੀ ਦਾਸ ਕੇ ਹੋਏ ਪੂਰਨ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sagal biaadh miTee tirahu gun kee dhaas ke hoe pooran kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: All the diseases of the three gunas - the three qualities - are cured, and tasks of the Lord's slaves are perfectly accomplished. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਕ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਪੂਰਨ ਧਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: har ke lok sadhaa gun gaaveh tin kau miliaa pooran dhaam ||
verses.translation: The people of the Lord always sing His Glorious Praises; they attain His Perfect Mansion.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਕਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਬਾਂਛੈ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤੀ ਹੋਇ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਜਾਮ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan kaa dharas baa(n)chhai dhin raatee hoi puneet dharam rai jaam ||1||
verses.translation: Even the Righteous Judge of Dharma and the Messenger of Death yearn, day and night, to be sanctified by the Blessed Vision of the Lord's humble servant. ||1||

verses.original: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮਦ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅਭਿਮਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh lobh madh ni(n)dhaa saadhasa(n)g miTiaa abhimaan ||
verses.translation: Sexual desire, anger, intoxication, egotism, slander and egotistical pride are eradicted in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਐਸੇ ਸੰਤ ਭੇਟਹਿ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨ ॥੨॥੩੯॥੫੨॥
verses.translit: aaise sa(n)t bheTeh vaddabhaagee naanak tin kai sadh kurabaan ||2||39||52||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, such Saints are met. Nanak is forever a sacrifice to them. ||2||39||52||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
One who harbors the five thieves, becomes the embodiment of these five.
He gets up each day and tells lies.
He applies ceremonial religious marks to his body, but practices hypocrisy.

verses.original: ਝੁਰਿ ਝੁਰਿ ਪਚੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਰੰਡ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jhur jhur pachai jaise tria ra(n)dd ||1||
verses.translation: He wastes away in sadness and pain, like a lonely widow. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਸਭ ਝੂਠੁ ॥
verses.translit: har ke naam binaa sabh jhooTh ||
verses.translation: Without the Name of the Lord, everything is false.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂਠੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur poore mukat na paieeaai saachee dharageh saakat mooTh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without the Perfect Guru, liberation is not obtained. In the Court of the True Lord, the faithless cynic is plundered. ||1||Pause||
One who does not know the Lord's Creative Power is polluted.

verses.original: ਲੀਪਿਐ ਥਾਇ ਨ ਸੁਚਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: leepiaai thai na such har maanai ||
verses.translation: Ritualistically plastering one's kitchen square does not make it pure in the Eyes of the Lord.
If a person is polluted within, he may wash himself everyday on the outside,
but in the Court of the True Lord, he forfeits his honor. ||2||
He works for the sake of Maya,
but he never places his feet on the right path.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਚੀਤਿ ਨ ਆਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: jin keeaa tis cheet na aanai ||
verses.translation: He never even remembers the One who created him.
He speaks falsehood, only falsehood, with his mouth. ||3||
That person, unto whom the Creator Lord shows Mercy,
deals with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗਾ ਰੰਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: har naam bhagat siau laagaa ra(n)g ||
verses.translation: One who lovingly worships the Lord's Name,

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਨਹੀ ਭੰਗੁ ॥੪॥੪੦॥੫੩॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak tis jan nahee bha(n)g ||4||40||53||
verses.translation: says Nanak - no obstacles ever block his way. ||4||40||53||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
The entire universe curses the slanderer.
False are the dealings of the slanderer.
The slanderer's lifestyle is filthy and polluted.
The Lord is the Saving Grace and the Protector of His slave. ||1||
The slanderer dies with the rest of the slanderers.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਜਨ ਰਾਖੇ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਕੜਕਿਓ ਕਾਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: paarabraham paramesar jan raakhe ni(n)dhak kai sir kaRakio kaal ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, protects and saves His humble servant. Death roars and thunders over the head of the slanderer. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: ni(n)dhak kaa kahiaa koi na maanai ||
verses.translation: No one belives what the slanderer says.
The slanderer tells lies, and later regrets and repents.
He wrings his hands, and hits his head against the ground.
The Lord does not forgive the slanderer. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਮਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa dhaas kichh buraa na maagai ||
verses.translation: The Lord's slave does not wish anyone ill.
The slanderer suffers, as if stabbed by a spear.
Like a crane, he spreads his feathers, to look like a swan.

verses.original: ਮੁਖ ਤੇ ਬੋਲਿਆ ਤਾਂ ਕਢਿਆ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: mukh te boliaa taa(n) kaddiaa beechaar ||3||
verses.translation: When he speaks with his mouth, then he is exposed and driven out. ||3||
The Creator is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: har jan karai su nihachal hoi ||
verses.translation: That person, whom the Lord makes His Own, becomes stable and steady.
The Lord's slave is true in the Court of the Lord.
Servant Nanak speaks, after contemplating the essence of reality. ||4||41||54||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
With my palms pressed together, I offer this prayer.

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਧਨੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau pi(n)dd dhan tis kee raas ||
verses.translation: My soul, body and wealth are His property.
He is the Creator, my Lord and Master.
Millions of times, I am a sacrifice to Him. ||1||
The dust of the feet of the Holy brings purity.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕੇ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਮੈਲੁ ਹਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man ke bikaar miTeh prabh simarat janam janam kee mail haree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Remembering God in meditation, the mind's corruption is eradicated, and the filth of countless incarnations is washed away. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਮਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai gireh meh sagal nidhaan ||
verses.translation: All treasures are in His household.
Serving Him, the mortal attains honor.
He is the Fulfiller of the mind's desires.
He is the Support of the soul and the breath of life of His devotees. ||2||
His Light shines in each and every heart.
Chanting and meditating on God, the Treasure of Virtue, His devotees live.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kee sev na birathee jai ||
verses.translation: Service to Him does not go in vain.
Deep within your mind and body, meditate on the One Lord. ||3||
Following the Guru's Teachings, compassion and contentment are found.
This Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the immaculate object.
Please grant Your Grace, O Lord, and attach me to the hem of Your robe.
Nanak meditates continually on the Lord's Lotus Feet. ||4||42||55||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
The True Guru has listened to my prayer.
All my affairs have been resolved.
Deep within my mind and body, I meditate on God.
The Perfect Guru has dispelled all my fears. ||1||
The All-powerful Divine Guru is the Greatest of all.

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sabh sukh paiee tis kee sev || rahaau ||
verses.translation: Serving Him, I obtain all comforts. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kaa keeaa sabh kichh hoi ||
verses.translation: Everything is done by Him.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਅਮਰੁ ਨ ਮੇਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: tis kaa amar na meTai koi ||
verses.translation: No one can erase His Eternal Decree.
The Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, is incomparably beautiful.

verses.original: ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਰੂਪੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: safal moorat gur tis kaa roop ||2||
verses.translation: The Guru is the Image of Fulfillment, the Embodiment of the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਸੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai a(n)tar basai har naam ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord abides deep within him.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਪੇਖੈ ਸੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: jo jo pekhai su braham giaan ||
verses.translation: Wherever he looks, he sees the Wisdom of God.

verses.original: ਬੀਸ ਬਿਸੁਏ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: bees bisue jaa kai man paragaas ||
verses.translation: His mind is totally enlightened and illuminated.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਾ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tis jan kai paarabraham kaa nivaas ||3||
verses.translation: Within that person, the Supreme Lord God abides. ||3||

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਕਰੀ ਨਮਸਕਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: tis gur kau sadh karee namasakaar ||
verses.translation: I humbly bow to that Guru forever.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਜਾਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: tis gur kau sadh jaau balihaar ||
verses.translation: I am forever a sacrifice to that Guru.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਧੋਇ ਧੋਇ ਪੀਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: satigur ke charan dhoi dhoi peevaa ||
verses.translation: I wash the feet of the Guru, and drink in this water.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਸਦ ਜੀਵਾ ॥੪॥੪੩॥੫੬॥
verses.translit: gur naanak jap jap sadh jeevaa ||4||43||56||
verses.translation: Chanting and meditating forever on Guru Nanak, I live. ||4||43||56||

verses.translit: raag bhairau mahalaa panjavaa paRataal ghar teejaa
verses.translation: Raag Bhairao, Fifth Mehla, Partaal, Third House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਪਰਤਿਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਕਵਨ ਗੁਨ ਗਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: paratipaal prabh kirapaal kavan gun ganee ||
verses.translation: God is the Compassionate Cherisher. Who can count His Glorious Virtues?

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਰੰਗ ਬਹੁ ਤਰੰਗ ਸਰਬ ਕੋ ਧਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: anik ra(n)g bahu tara(n)g sarab ko dhanee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Countless colors, and countless waves of joy; He is the Master of all. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਗਿਆਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਧਿਆਨ ਅਨਿਕ ਜਾਪ ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ॥
verses.translit: anik giaan anik dhiaan anik jaap jaap taap ||
verses.translation: Endless spiritual wisdom, endless meditations, endless chants, intense meditations and austere self-disciplines.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਗੁਨਿਤ ਧੁਨਿਤ ਲਲਿਤ ਅਨਿਕ ਧਾਰ ਮੁਨੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: anik gunit dhunit lalit anik dhaar munee ||1||
verses.translation: Countless virtues, musical notes and playful sports; countless silent sages enshrine Him in their hearts. ||1||

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਨਾਦ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਾਜ ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਅਨਿਕ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਅਨਿਕ ਦੋਖ ਅਨਿਕ ਰੋਗ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਜਸ ਸੁਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: anik naadh anik baaj nimakh nimakh anik savaiaadh anik dhokh anik rog miTeh jas sunee ||
verses.translation: Countless melodies, countless instruments, countless tastes, each and every instant. Countless mistakes and countless diseases are removed by hearing His Praise.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇਵ ਅਪਾਰ ਦੇਵ ਤਟਹ ਖਟਹ ਬਰਤ ਪੂਜਾ ਗਵਨ ਭਵਨ ਜਾਤ੍ਰ ਕਰਨ ਸਗਲ ਫਲ ਪੁਨੀ ॥੨॥੧॥੫੭॥੮॥੨੧॥੭॥੫੭॥੯੩॥
verses.translit: naanak sev apaar dhev taTeh khaTeh barat poojaa gavan bhavan jaatr karan sagal fal punee ||2||1||57||8||21||7||57||93||
verses.translation: O Nanak, serving the Infinite, Divine Lord, one earns all the rewards and merits of performing the six rituals, fasts, worship services, pilgrimages to sacred rivers, and journeys to sacred shrines. ||2||1||57||8||21||7||57||93||

verses.translit: bhairau asaTapadheeaa mahalaa pehilaa ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Bhairao, Ashtpadheeyaa, First Mehla, Second House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਆਤਮ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਾਮ ਮਹਿ ਆਤਮੁ ਚੀਨਸਿ ਗੁਰ ਬੀਚਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: aatam meh raam raam meh aatam cheenas gur beechaaraa ||
verses.translation: The Lord is in the soul, and the soul is in the Lord. This is realized through the Guru's Teachings.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਟੈ ਹਉ ਮਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat baanee sabadh pachhaanee dhukh kaaTai hau maaraa ||1||
verses.translation: The Ambrosial Word of the Guru's Bani is realized through the Word of the Shabad. Sorrow is dispelled, and egotism is eliminated. ||1||
O Nanak, the disease of egotism is so very deadly.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾਂ ਤਹ ਏਕਾ ਬੇਦਨ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਧੁਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jeh dhekhaa(n) teh ekaa bedhan aape bakhasai sabadh dhure ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, I see the pain of the same disease. The Primal Lord Himself bestows the Shabad of His Word. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਪਰਖੇ ਪਰਖਣਹਾਰੈ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਸੂਲਾਕੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: aape parakhe parakhanahaarai bahur soolaak na hoiee ||
verses.translation: When the Appraiser Himself appraises the mortal, then he is not tested again.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਭਈ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jin kau nadhar bhiee gur mele prabh bhaanaa sach soiee ||2||
verses.translation: Those who are blessed with His Grace meet with the Guru. They alone are true, who are pleasing to God. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉਣੁ ਪਾਣੀ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਰੋਗੀ ਰੋਗੀ ਧਰਤਿ ਸਭੋਗੀ ॥
verses.translit: paun paanee baisa(n)tar rogee rogee dharat sabhogee ||
verses.translation: Air, water and fire are diseased; the world with its enjoyments is diseased.

verses.original: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੇਹ ਸਿ ਰੋਗੀ ਰੋਗੀ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸੰਜੋਗੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: maat pitaa maiaa dheh s rogee rogee kuTa(n)b sa(n)jogee ||3||
verses.translation: Mother, father, Maya and the body are diseased; those united with their relatives are diseased. ||3||

verses.original: ਰੋਗੀ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਬਿਸਨੁ ਸਰੁਦ੍ਰਾ ਰੋਗੀ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: rogee brahamaa bisan sarudhraa rogee sagal sa(n)saaraa ||
verses.translation: Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva are diseased; the whole world is diseased.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪਦੁ ਚੀਨਿ ਭਏ ਸੇ ਮੁਕਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਾ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: har padh cheen bhe se mukate gur kaa sabadh veechaaraa ||4||
verses.translation: Those who remember the Lord's Feet and contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad are liberated. ||4||

verses.original: ਰੋਗੀ ਸਾਤ ਸਮੁੰਦ ਸਨਦੀਆ ਖੰਡ ਪਤਾਲ ਸਿ ਰੋਗਿ ਭਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: rogee saat samu(n)dh sanadheeaa kha(n)dd pataal s rog bhare ||
verses.translation: The seven seas are diseased, along with the rivers; the continents and the nether regions of the underworlds are full of disease.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਕ ਸਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ਸਰਬੀ ਥਾਈ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: har ke lok s saach suhele sarabee thaiee nadhar kare ||5||
verses.translation: The people of the Lord dwell in Truth and peace; He blesses them with His Grace everywhere. ||5||

verses.original: ਰੋਗੀ ਖਟ ਦਰਸਨ ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ਨਾਨਾ ਹਠੀ ਅਨੇਕਾ ॥
verses.translit: rogee khaT dharasan bhekhadhaaree naanaa haThee anekaa ||
verses.translation: The six Shaastras are diseased, as are the many who follow the different religious orders.

verses.original: ਬੇਦ ਕਤੇਬ ਕਰਹਿ ਕਹ ਬਪੁਰੇ ਨਹ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਇਕ ਏਕਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: bedh kateb kareh keh bapure neh boojheh ik ekaa ||6||
verses.translation: What can the poor Vedas and Bibles do? People do not understand the One and Only Lord. ||6||

verses.original: ਮਿਠ ਰਸੁ ਖਾਇ ਸੁ ਰੋਗਿ ਭਰੀਜੈ ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: miTh ras khai su rog bhareejai ka(n)dh mool sukh naahee ||
verses.translation: Eating sweet treats, the mortal is filled with disease; he finds no peace at all.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ਚਲਹਿ ਅਨ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਹੀ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: naam visaar chaleh an maarag a(n)t kaal pachhutaahee ||7||
verses.translation: Forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, they walk on other paths, and at the very last moment, they regret and repent. ||7||

verses.original: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਭਰਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਨ ਛੂਟਸਿ ਪੜਿਆ ਬਾਦੁ ਬਿਬਾਦੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: teerath bharamai rog na chhooTas paRiaa baadh bibaadh bhiaa ||
verses.translation: Wandering around at sacred shrines of pilgrimage, the mortal is not cured of his disease. Reading scripture, he gets involved in useless arguments.

verses.original: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਸੁ ਅਧਿਕ ਵਡੇਰਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਮੁਹਤਾਜੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: dhubidhaa rogu su adhik vadderaa maiaa kaa muhataaj bhiaa ||8||
verses.translation: The disease of duality is so very deadly; it causes dependence on Maya. ||8||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੈ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh saachaa sabadh salaahai man saachaa tis rog giaa ||
verses.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh and praises the True Shabad with the True Lord in his mind is cured of his disease.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਕਰਮਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ਪਇਆ ॥੯॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak har jan anadhin niramal jin kau karam neesaan piaa ||9||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the humble servant of the Lord is immaculate, night and day; he bears the insignia of the Lord's Grace. ||9||1||
Bhairao, Third Mehla, Second House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
The Creator has staged His Wondrous Play.
I listen to the Unstruck Sound-current of the Shabad, and the Bani of His Word.
The self-willed manmukhs are deluded and confused, while the Gurmukhs understand.
The Creator creates the Cause that causes. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa sabadh merai a(n)tar dhiaan ||
verses.translation: Deep within my being, I meditate on the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਹਉ ਕਬਹੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hau kabahu na chhoddau har kaa naam ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I shall never forsake the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
Prahlaad's father sent him to school, to learn to read.
He took his writing tablet and went to the teacher.
He said, ""I shall not read anything except the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੀ ਪਟੀਆ ਲਿਖਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: meree paTeeaa likh dheh gobi(n)dh muraar ||2||
verses.translation: Write the Lord's Name on my tablet.""||2||
Prahlaad's mother said to her son,
"I advise you not to read anything except what you are taught."

verses.original: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: nirabhau dhaataa har jeeau merai naal ||
verses.translation: He answered, ""The Great Giver, my Fearless Lord God is always with me.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਛੋਡਉ ਤਉ ਕੁਲਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਗਾਲਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: je har chhoddau tau kul laagai gaal ||3||
verses.translation: If I were to forsake the Lord, then my family would be disgraced.""||3||
"Prahlaad has corrupted all the other students.

verses.original: ਹਮਾਰਾ ਕਹਿਆ ਨ ਸੁਣੈ ਆਪਣੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: hamaaraa kahiaa na sunai aapane kaaraj savaare ||
verses.translation: He does not listen to what I say, and he does his own thing.
He instigated devotional worship in the townspeople.""

verses.original: ਦੁਸਟ ਸਭਾ ਕਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਵਸਾਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: dhusaT sabhaa kaa kichh na vasaiee ||4||
verses.translation: The gathering of the wicked people could not do anything against him. ||4||
Sanda and Marka, his teachers, made the complaint.
All the demons kept trying in vain.

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat janaa kee pat raakhai soiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord protected His humble devotee, and preserved his honor.
What can be done by mere created beings? ||5||
Because of his past karma, the demon ruled over his kingdom.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਤਿਨਿ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har na boojhai tin aap bhulaiaa ||
verses.translation: He did not realize the Lord; the Lord Himself confused him.
He started an argument with his son Prahlaad.

verses.original: ਅੰਧਾ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਕਾਲੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਆਇਆ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: a(n)dhaa na boojhai kaal neRai aaiaa ||6||
verses.translation: The blind one did not understand that his death was approaching. ||6||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦੁ ਕੋਠੇ ਵਿਚਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਬਾਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਤਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: prahalaadh koThe vich raakhiaa baar dheeaa taalaa ||
verses.translation: Prahlaad was placed in a cell, and the door was locked.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਡਰਈ ਮੇਰੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: nirabhau baalak mool na ddariee merai a(n)tar gur gopaalaa ||
verses.translation: The fearless child was not afraid at all. He said, ""Within my being, is the Guru, the Lord of the World.""

verses.original: ਕੀਤਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਰੀਕੀ ਕਰੈ ਅਨਹੋਦਾ ਨਾਉ ਧਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: keetaa hovai sareekee karai anahodhaa naau dharaiaa ||
verses.translation: The created being tried to compete with his Creator, but he assumed this name in vain.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋੁ ਆਇ ਪਹੁਤਾ ਜਨ ਸਿਉ ਵਾਦੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: jo dhur likhiaa suo aai pahutaa jan siau vaadh rachaiaa ||7||
verses.translation: That which was predestined for him has come to pass; he started an argument with the Lord's humble servant. ||7||
The father raised the club to strike down Prahlaad, saying,
"Where is your God, the Lord of the Universe, now?"
He replied, ""The Life of the World, the Great Giver, is my Help and Support in the end.
Wherever I look, I see Him permeating and prevailing.""||8||
Tearing down the pillars, the Lord Himself appeared.
The egotistical demon was killed and destroyed.
The minds of the devotees were filled with bliss, and congratulations poured in.
He blessed His servant with glorious greatness. ||9||
He created birth, death and attachment.
The Creator has ordained coming and going in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਹਲਾਦ ਕੈ ਕਾਰਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: prahalaadh kai kaaraj har aap dhikhaiaa ||
verses.translation: For the sake of Prahlaad, the Lord Himself appeared.
The word of the devotee came true. ||10||

verses.original: ਦੇਵ ਕੁਲੀ ਲਖਿਮੀ ਕਉ ਕਰਹਿ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: dhev kulee lakhimee kau kareh jaikaar ||
verses.translation: The gods proclaimed the victory of Lakshmi, and said,
"O mother, make this form of the Man-lion disappear!"

verses.original: ਲਖਿਮੀ ਭਉ ਕਰੈ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: lakhimee bhau karai na saakai jai ||
verses.translation: Lakshmi was afraid, and did not approach.
The humble servant Prahlaad came and fell at the Lord's Feet. ||11||
The True Guru implanted the treasure of the Naam within.
Power, property and all Maya is false.
But still, the greedy people continue clinging to them.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: har ke naam bin dharageh milai sajai ||12||
verses.translation: Without the Name of the Lord, the mortals are punished in His Court. ||12||

verses.original: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: kahai naanak sabh ko kare karaiaa ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, everyone acts as the Lord makes them act.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: se paravaan jinee har siau chit laiaa ||
verses.translation: They alone are approved and accepted, who focus their consciousness on the Lord.
He has made His devotees His Own.
The Creator has appeared in His Own Form. ||13||1||2||
Bhairao, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur sevaa te a(n)mirat fal paiaa haumai tirasan bujhaiee ||
verses.translation: Serving the Guru, I obtain the Ambrosial Fruit; my egotism and desire have been quenched.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਹ੍ਰਿਦੈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਮਨਸਾ ਮਨਹਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam hiradhai man vasiaa manasaa maneh samaiee ||1||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord dwells within my heart and mind, and the desires of my mind are quieted. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau kirapaa karahu mere piaare ||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord, my Beloved, please bless me with Your Mercy.

verses.original: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਦੀਨ ਜਨੁ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: anadhin har gun dheen jan maa(n)gai gur kai sabadh udhaare ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Night and day, Your humble servant begs for Your Glorious Praises; through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he is saved. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਜਮੁ ਜੋਹਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਰਤੀ ਅੰਚ ਦੂਖ ਨ ਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa kau jam joh na saakai ratee a(n)ch dhookh na laiee ||
verses.translation: The Messenger of Death cannot even touch the humble Saints; it does not cause them even an iota of suffering or pain.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਤਰਹਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੁਲ ਤਾਰਹਿ ਜੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: aap tareh sagale kul taareh jo teree saranaiee ||2||
verses.translation: Those who enter Your Sanctuary, Lord, save themselves, and save all their ancestors as well. ||2||

verses.original: ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਹਿ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਏਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: bhagataa kee paij rakheh too aape eh teree vaddiaaiee ||
verses.translation: You Yourself save the honor of Your devotees; this is Your Glory, O Lord.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਦੁਖ ਕਾਟਹਿ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਰਤੀ ਨ ਰਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: janam janam ke kilavikh dhukh kaaTeh dhubidhaa ratee na raiee ||3||
verses.translation: You cleanse them of the sins and the pains of countless incarnations; You love them without even an iota of duality. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਮੂੜ ਮੁਗਧ ਕਿਛੁ ਬੂਝਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ham mooR mugadh kichh boojheh naahee too aape dheh bujhaiee ||
verses.translation: I am foolish and ignorant, and understand nothing. You Yourself bless me with understanding.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਕਰਸੀ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕਰਣਾ ਜਾਈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: jo tudh bhaavai soiee karasee avar na karanaa jaiee ||4||
verses.translation: You do whatever You please; nothing else can be done at all. ||4||

verses.original: ਜਗਤੁ ਉਪਾਇ ਤੁਧੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਲਾਇਆ ਭੂੰਡੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jagat upai tudh dha(n)dhai laiaa bhoo(n)ddee kaar kamaiee ||
verses.translation: Creating the world, You have linked all to their tasks - even the evil deeds which men do.

verses.original: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਜੂਐ ਹਾਰਿਆ ਸਬਦੈ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: janam padhaarath jooaai haariaa sabadhai surat na paiee ||5||
verses.translation: They lose this precious human life in the gamble, and do not understand the Word of the Shabad. ||5||

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh mareh tin kichhoo na soojhai dhuramat agiaan a(n)dhaaraa ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs die, understanding nothing; they are enveloped by the darkness of evil-mindedness and ignorance.

verses.original: ਭਵਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਕਬ ਹੀ ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਏ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰਾ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: bhavajal paar na paaveh kab hee ddoob mue bin gur sir bhaaraa ||6||
verses.translation: They do not cross over the terrible world-ocean; without the Guru, they drown and die. ||6||

verses.original: ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: saachai sabadh rate jan saache har prabh aap milaae ||
verses.translation: True are those humble beings who are imbued with the True Shabad; the Lord God unites them with Himself.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਤੀ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: gur kee baanee sabadh pachhaatee saach rahe liv laae ||7||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Bani, they come to understand the Shabad. They remain lovingly focused on the True Lord. ||7||

verses.original: ਤੂੰ ਆਪਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਤੇਰੇ ਜਨ ਹੈ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: too(n) aap niramal tere jan hai niramal gur kai sabadh veechaare ||
verses.translation: You Yourself are Immaculate and Pure, and pure are Your humble servants who contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੮॥੨॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak tin kai sadh balihaarai raam naam ur dhaare ||8||2||3||
verses.translation: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to those, who enshrine the Lord's Name within their hearts. ||8||2||3||

verses.translit: bhairau mahalaa panjavaa asaTapadheeaa ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Bhairao, Fifth Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa, Second House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸੋਈ ਵਡ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis naam ridhai soiee vadd raajaa ||
verses.translation: He alone is a great king, who keeps the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within his heart.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਕਾਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis naam ridhai tis poore kaajaa ||
verses.translation: One who keeps the Naam in his heart - his tasks are perfectly accomplished.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤਿਨਿ ਕੋਟਿ ਧਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: jis naam ridhai tin koT dhan paae ||
verses.translation: One who keeps the Naam in his heart, obtains millions of treasures.
Without the Naam, life is useless. ||1||

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: tis saalaahee jis har dhan raas ||
verses.translation: I praise that person, who has the capital of the Lord's Wealth.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹਾਥੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: so vaddabhaagee jis gur masatak haath ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He is very fortunate, on whose forehead the Guru has placed His Hand. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਕੋਟ ਕਈ ਸੈਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis naam ridhai tis koT kiee sainaa ||
verses.translation: One who keeps the Naam in his heart, has many millions of armies on his side.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੈਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis naam ridhai tis sahaj sukhainaa ||
verses.translation: One who keeps the Naam in his heart, enjoys peace and poise.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸੋ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੂਆ ॥
verses.translit: jis naam ridhai so seetal hooaa ||
verses.translation: One who keeps the Naam in his heart becomes cool and calm.
Without the Naam, both life and death are cursed. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸੋ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis naam ridhai so jeevan mukataa ||
verses.translation: One who keeps the Naam in his heart is Jivan-mukta, liberated while yet alive.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਜੁਗਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis naam ridhai tis sabh hee jugataa ||
verses.translation: One who keeps the Naam in his heart knows all ways and means.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤਿਨਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jis naam ridhai tin nau nidh paiee ||
verses.translation: One who keeps the Naam in his heart obtains the nine treasures.
Without the Naam, the mortal wanders, coming and going in reincarnation. ||3||
One who keeps the Naam in his heart is carefree and independent.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis naam ridhai tis sadh hee laahaa ||
verses.translation: One who keeps the Naam in his heart always earns a profit.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਵਡ ਪਰਵਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis naam ridhai tis vadd paravaaraa ||
verses.translation: One who keeps the Naam in his heart has a large family.
Without the Naam, the mortal is just an ignorant, self-willed manmukh. ||4||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਆਸਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: jis naam ridhai tis nihachal aasan ||
verses.translation: One who keeps the Naam in his heart has a permanent position.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਤਖਤਿ ਨਿਵਾਸਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: jis naam ridhai tis takhat nivaasan ||
verses.translation: One who keeps the Naam in his heart is seated on the throne.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸੋ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: jis naam ridhai so saachaa saahu ||
verses.translation: One who keeps the Naam in his heart is the true king.
Without the Naam, no one has any honor or respect. ||5||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸੋ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਜਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis naam ridhai so sabh meh jaataa ||
verses.translation: One who keeps the Naam in his heart is famous everywhere.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis naam ridhai so purakh bidhaataa ||
verses.translation: One who keeps the Naam in his heart is the Embodiment of the Creator Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸੋ ਸਭ ਤੇ ਊਚਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis naam ridhai so sabh te uoochaa ||
verses.translation: One who keeps the Naam in his heart is the highest of all.
Without the Naam, the mortal wanders in reincarnation. ||6||

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿ ਪਹਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis naam ridhai tis pragaT pahaaraa ||
verses.translation: One who keeps the Naam in his heart sees the Lord manifested in His Creation.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਅੰਧਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jis naam ridhai tis miTiaa a(n)dhaaraa ||
verses.translation: One who keeps the Naam in his heart - his darkness is dispelled.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਸੋ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: jis naam ridhai so purakh paravaan ||
verses.translation: One who keeps the Naam in his heart is approved and accepted.
Without the Naam, the mortal continues coming and going in reincarnation. ||7||

verses.original: ਤਿਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: tin naam paiaa jis bhio kirapaal ||
verses.translation: He alone receives the Naam, who is blessed by the Lord's Mercy.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, the Lord of the World is understood.
Coming and going in reincarnation ends, and peace is found.
Says Nanak, my essence has merged in the Essence of the Lord. ||8||1||4||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
He created millions of incarnations of Vishnu.
He created millions of universes as places to practice righteousness.
He created and destroyed millions of Shivas.
He employed millions of Brahmas to create the worlds. ||1||
Such is my Lord and Master, the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਗੁਣ ਬਿਸਥਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: baran na saakau gun bisathaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I cannot even describe His Many Virtues. ||1||Pause||
Millions of Mayas are His maid-servants.
Millions of souls are His beds.
Millions of universes are the limbs of His Being.
Millions of devotees abide with the Lord. ||2||
Millions of kings with their crowns and canopies bow before Him.
Millions of Indras stand at His Door.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: koT baiku(n)Th jaa kee dhirasaTee maeh ||
verses.translation: Millions of heavenly paradises are within the scope of His Vision.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਨਾਮ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: koT naam jaa kee keemat naeh ||3||
verses.translation: Millions of His Names cannot even be appraised. ||3||

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਪੂਰੀਅਤ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਨਾਦ ॥
verses.translit: koT pooreeat hai jaa kai naadh ||
verses.translation: Millions of celestial sounds resound for Him.
His Wondrous Plays are enacted on millions of stages.
Millions of Shaktis and Shivas are obedient to Him.
He gives sustenance and support to millions of beings. ||4||

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਮਝਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: koT teerath jaa ke charan majhaar ||
verses.translation: In His Feet are millions of sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
Millions chant His Sacred and Beautiful Name.
Millions of worshippers worship Him.
Millions of expanses are His; there is no other at all. ||5||

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੰਸ ॥
verses.translit: koT mahimaa jaa kee niramal ha(n)s ||
verses.translation: Millions of swan-souls sing His Immaculate Praises.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਕਰਤ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਸ ॥
verses.translit: koT usatat jaa kee karat brahama(n)s ||
verses.translation: Millions of Brahma's sons sing His Praises.
He creates and destroys millions, in an instant.

verses.original: ਕੋਟਿ ਗੁਣਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਗਣੇ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: koT gunaa tere gane na jaeh ||6||
verses.translation: Millions are Your Virtues, Lord - they cannot even be counted. ||6||
Millions of spiritual teachers teach His spiritual wisdom.
Millions of meditators focus on His meditation.
Millions of austere penitents practice austerities.
Millions of silent sages dwell in silence. ||7||

verses.original: ਅਵਿਗਤ ਨਾਥੁ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਘਟ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥
verses.translit: avigat naath agochar suaamee || poor rahiaa ghaT a(n)tarajaamee ||
verses.translation: Our Eternal, Imperishable, Incomprehensible Lord and Master, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is permeating all hearts.
Wherever I look, I see Your Dwelling, O Lord.
The Guru has blessed Nanak with enlightenment. ||8||2||5||
Bhairao, Fifth Mehla:
The True Guru has blessed me with this gift.
He has given me the Priceless Jewel of the Lord's Name.
Now, I intuitively enjoy endless pleasures and wondrous play.
God has spontaneously met with Nanak. ||1||
Says Nanak, True is the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise.

verses.original: ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਚੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bahur bahur tis sa(n)g man raachee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Again and again, my mind remains immersed in it. ||1||Pause||
Spontaneously, I feed on the Love of God.
Spontaneously, I take God's Name.
Spontaneously, I am saved by the Word of the Shabad.
Spontaneously, my treasures are filled to overflowing. ||2||
Spontaneously, my works are perfectly accomplished.
Spontaneously, I am rid of sorrow.
Spontaneously, my enemies have become friends.

verses.original: ਅਚਿੰਤੋ ਹੀ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਤਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: achi(n)to hee ih man vas keetaa ||3||
verses.translation: Spontaneously, I have brought my mind under control. ||3||
Spontaneously, God has comforted me.
Spontaneously, my hopes have been fulfilled.
Spontaneously, I have totally realized the essence of reality.

verses.original: ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਹਮ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਮੰਤੁ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: achi(n)t ham kau gur dheeno ma(n)t ||4||
verses.translation: Spontaneously, I have been blessed with the Guru's Mantra. ||4||
Spontaneously, I am rid of hatred.
Spontaneously, my darkness has been dispelled.
Spontaneously, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praise seems so sweet to my mind.

verses.original: ਅਚਿੰਤੋ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: achi(n)to hee prabh ghaT ghaT ddeeThaa ||5||
verses.translation: Spontaneously, I behold God in each and every heart. ||5||
Spontaneously, all my doubts have been dispelled.
Spontaneously, peace and celestial harmony fill my mind.
Spontaneously, the Unstruck Melody of the Sound-current resounds within me.
Spontaneously, the Lord of the Universe has revealed Himself to me. ||6||
Spontaneously, my mind has been pleased and appeased.
I have spontaneously realized the Eternal, Unchanging Lord.
Spontaneously, all wisdom and knowledge has welled up within me.

verses.original: ਅਚਿੰਤ ਚਰੀ ਹਥਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਟੇਕਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: achi(n)t charee hath har har Tekaa ||7||
verses.translation: Spontaneously, the Support of the Lord, Har, Har, has come into my hands. ||7||
Spontaneously, God has recorded my pre-ordained destiny.
Spontaneously, the One Lord and Master God has met me.
Spontaneously, all my cares and worries have been taken away.
Nanak, Nanak, Nanak, has merged into the Image of God. ||8||3||6||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ॥ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: bhairau baanee bhagataa kee || kabeer jeeau ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Bhairao, The Word Of The Devotees, Kabeer Jee, First House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: eih dhan mere har ko naau ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord - this alone is my wealth.

verses.original: ਗਾਂਠਿ ਨ ਬਾਧਉ ਬੇਚਿ ਨ ਖਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gaa(n)Th na baadhau bech na khaau ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I do not tie it up to hide it, nor do I sell it to make my living. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਨਾਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਖੇਤੀ ਨਾਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਬਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: naau mere khetee naau mere baaree ||
verses.translation: The Name is my crop, and the Name is my field.
As Your humble servant, I perform devotional worship to You; I seek Your Sanctuary. ||1||

verses.original: ਨਾਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਨਾਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਪੂੰਜੀ ॥
verses.translit: naau mere maiaa naau mere poo(n)jee ||
verses.translation: The Name is Maya and wealth for me; the Name is my capital.
I do not forsake You; I do not know any other at all. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਾਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਬੰਧਿਪ ਨਾਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: naau mere ba(n)dhip naau mere bhaiee ||
verses.translation: The Name is my family, the Name is my brother.

verses.original: ਨਾਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੰਗਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naau mere sa(n)g a(n)t hoi sakhaiee ||3||
verses.translation: The Name is my companion, who will help me in the end. ||3||
One whom the Lord keeps detached from Maya

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਹਉ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਦਾਸੁ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer hau taa ko dhaas ||4||1||
verses.translation: - says Kabeer, I am his slave. ||4||1||
Naked we come, and naked we go.
No one, not even the kings and queens, shall remain. ||1||
The Sovereign Lord is the nine treasures for me.

verses.original: ਸੰਪੈ ਹੇਤੁ ਕਲਤੁ ਧਨੁ ਤੇਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)pai het kalat dhan terai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The possessions and the spouse to which the mortal is lovingly attached, are Your wealth, O Lord. ||1||Pause||
They do not come with the mortal, and they do not go with him.
What good does it do him, if he has elephants tied up at his doorway? ||2||
The fortress of Sri Lanka was made out of gold,
but what could the foolish Raawan take with him when he left? ||3||
Says Kabeer, think of doing some good deeds.
In the end, the gambler shall depart empty-handed. ||4||2||
Brahma is polluted, and Indra is polluted.
The sun is polluted, and the moon is polluted. ||1||
This world is polluted with pollution.

verses.original: ਇਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: eik har niramal jaa kaa a(n)t na paar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Only the One Lord is Immaculate; He has no end or limitation. ||1||Pause||
The rulers of kingdoms are polluted.
Nights and days, and the days of the month are polluted. ||2||
The pearl is polluted, the diamond is polluted.
Wind, fire and water are polluted. ||3||
Shiva, Shankara and Mahaysh are polluted.
The Siddhas, seekers and strivers, and those who wear religious robes, are polluted. ||4||
The Yogis and wandering hermits with their matted hair are polluted.
The body, along with the swan-soul, is polluted. ||5||

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਤੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਨ ॥ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਤੇ ਜੋ ਰਾਮਹਿ ਜਾਨ ॥੬॥੩॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer te jan paravaan || niramal te jo raameh jaan ||6||3||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, those humble beings are approved and pure, who know the Lord. ||6||3||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਕਾ ਕਿਬਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਹੀ ॥
verses.translit: man kar makaa kibalaa kar dhehee ||
verses.translation: Let your mind be Mecca, and your body the temple of worship.
Let the Supreme Guru be the One who speaks. ||1||
O Mullah, utter the call to prayer.
The one mosque has ten doors. ||1||Pause||
So slaughter your evil nature, doubt and cruelty;
consume the five demons and you shall be blessed with contentment. ||2||
Hindus and Muslims have the same One Lord and Master.

verses.original: ਕਹ ਕਰੈ ਮੁਲਾਂ ਕਹ ਕਰੈ ਸੇਖ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: keh karai mulaa(n) keh karai sekh ||3||
verses.translation: What can the Mullah do, and what can the Shaykh do? ||3||
Says Kabeer, I have gone insane.
Slaughtering, slaughtering my mind, I have merged into the Celestial Lord. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਗੰਗਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਲਿਤਾ ਬਿਗਰੀ ॥ ਸੋ ਸਲਿਤਾ ਗੰਗਾ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਬਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ga(n)gaa kai sa(n)g salitaa bigaree || so salitaa ga(n)gaa hoi nibaree ||1||
verses.translation: When the stream flows into the Ganges, then it becomes the Ganges. ||1||
Just so, Kabeer has changed.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੁ ਭਇਓ ਅਨ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saach bhio an kateh na jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He has become the Embodiment of Truth, and he does not go anywhere else. ||1||Pause||
Associating with the sandalwood tree, the tree nearby is changed;
that tree begins to smell just like the sandalwood tree. ||2||
Coming into contact with the philosophers' stone, copper is transformed;
that copper is transformed into gold. ||3||
In the Society of the Saints, Kabeer is transformed;
that Kabeer is transformed into the Lord. ||4||5||
Some apply ceremonial marks to their foreheads, hold malas in their hands, and wear religious robes.
Some people think that the Lord is a play-thing. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਉ ਹਉ ਬਉਰਾ ਤਉ ਰਾਮ ਤੋਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: jau hau bauraa tau raam toraa ||
verses.translation: If I am insane, then I am Yours, O Lord.

verses.original: ਲੋਗੁ ਮਰਮੁ ਕਹ ਜਾਨੈ ਮੋਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: log maram keh jaanai moraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: How can people know my secret? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੋਰਉ ਨ ਪਾਤੀ ਪੂਜਉ ਨ ਦੇਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: torau na paatee poojau na dhevaa ||
verses.translation: I do not pick leaves as offerings, and I do not worship idols.
Without devotional worship of the Lord, service is useless. ||2||
I worship the True Guru; forever and ever, I surrender to Him.
By such service, I find peace in the Court of the Lord. ||3||
People say that Kabeer has gone insane.
Only the Lord realizes the secret of Kabeer. ||4||6||
Turning away from the world, I have forgotten both my social class and ancestry.
My weaving now is in the most profound celestial stillness. ||1||
I have no quarrel with anyone.
I have abandoned both the Pandits, the Hindu religious scholars, and the Mullahs, the Muslim priests. ||1||Pause||
I weave and weave, and wear what I weave.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਨਹੀ ਆਪੁ ਤਹਾ ਹੋਇ ਗਾਵਉ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jeh nahee aap tahaa hoi gaavau ||2||
verses.translation: Where egotism does not exist, there I sing God's Praises. ||2||
Whatever the Pandits and Mullahs have written,

verses.original: ਛਾਡਿ ਚਲੇ ਹਮ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਲੀਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: chhaadd chale ham kachhoo na leeaa ||3||
verses.translation: I reject; I do not accept any of it. ||3||
My heart is pure, and so I have seen the Lord within.
Searching, searching within the self, Kabeer has met the Lord. ||4||7||
No one respects the poor man.

verses.original: ਲਾਖ ਜਤਨ ਕਰੈ ਓਹੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਧਰੇਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: laakh jatan karai oh chit na dharei ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He may make thousands of efforts, but no one pays any attention to him. ||1||Pause||
When the poor man goes to the rich man,
and sits right in front of him, the rich man turns his back on him. ||1||
But when the rich man goes to the poor man,
the poor man welcomes him with respect. ||2||
The poor man and the rich man are both brothers.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਕਲਾ ਨ ਮੇਟੀ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: prabh kee kalaa na meTee jaiee ||3||
verses.translation: God's pre-ordained plan cannot be erased. ||3||
Says Kabeer, he alone is poor,

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੮॥
verses.translit: jaa ke hiradhai naam na hoiee ||4||8||
verses.translation: who does not have the Naam, the Name of the Lord, in his heart. ||4||8||
Serving the Guru, devotional worship is practiced.
Then, this human body is obtained.
Even the gods long for this human body.

verses.original: ਸੋ ਦੇਹੀ ਭਜੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: so dhehee bhaj har kee sev ||1||
verses.translation: So vibrate that human body, and think of serving the Lord. ||1||
Vibrate, and meditate on the Lord of the Universe, and never forget Him.

verses.original: ਮਾਨਸ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਏਹੀ ਲਾਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: maanas janam kaa ehee laahu ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: This is the blessed opportunity of this human incarnation. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜਰਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਨਹੀ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jab lag jaraa rog nahee aaiaa ||
verses.translation: As long as the disease of old age has not come to the body,

verses.original: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਕਾਲਿ ਗ੍ਰਸੀ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jab lag kaal grasee nahee kaiaa ||
verses.translation: and as long as death has not come and seized the body,

verses.original: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਬਿਕਲ ਭਈ ਨਹੀ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: jab lag bikal bhiee nahee baanee ||
verses.translation: and as long as your voice has not lost its power,
O mortal being, vibrate and meditate on the Lord of the World. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਬ ਨ ਭਜਸਿ ਭਜਸਿ ਕਬ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: ab na bhajas bhajas kab bhaiee ||
verses.translation: If you do not vibrate and meditate on Him now, when will you, O Sibing of Destiny?
When the end comes, you will not be able to vibrate and meditate on Him.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਅਬ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: jo kichh kareh soiee ab saar ||
verses.translation: Whatever you have to do - now is the best time to do it.
Otherwise, you shall regret and repent afterwards, and you shall not be carried across to the other side. ||3||
He alone is a servant, whom the Lord enjoins to His service.
He alone attains the Immaculate Divine Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਖੁਲੑੇ ਕਪਾਟ ॥
verses.translit: gur mil taa ke khul(h)e kapaaT ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Guru, his doors are opened wide,
and he does not have to journey again on the path of reincarnation. ||4||

verses.original: ਇਹੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਇਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਬਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: eihee teraa aausar ieh teree baar ||
verses.translation: This is your chance, and this is your time.
Look deep into your own heart, and reflect on this.
