Says Kabeer, you can win or lose.
In so many ways, I have proclaimed this out loud. ||5||1||9||

verses.original: ਸਿਵ ਕੀ ਪੁਰੀ ਬਸੈ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: siv kee puree basai budh saar ||
verses.translation: In the City of God, sublime understanding prevails.

verses.original: ਤਹ ਤੁਮੑ ਮਿਲਿ ਕੈ ਕਰਹੁ ਬਿਚਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: teh tum(h) mil kai karahu bichaar ||
verses.translation: There, you shall meet with the Lord, and reflect on Him.
Thus, you shall understand this world and the next.

verses.original: ਕਉਨੁ ਕਰਮ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਰੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kaun karam meraa kar kar marai ||1||
verses.translation: What is the use of claiming that you own everything, if you only die in the end? ||1||
I focus my meditation on my inner self, deep within.

verses.original: ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੋਰਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: raajaa raam naam moraa braham giaan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Sovereign Lord is my spiritual wisdom. ||1||Pause||
In the first chakra, the root chakra, I have grasped the reins and tied them.
I have firmly placed the moon above the sun.
The sun blazes forth at the western gate.
Through the central channel of the Shushmanaa, it rises up above my head. ||2||
There is a stone at that western gate,
and above that stone, is another window.
Above that window is the Tenth Gate.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥੩॥੨॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer taa kaa a(n)t na paar ||3||2||10||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, it has no end or limitation. ||3||2||10||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਮੁਲਾਂ ਜੋ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਲਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: so mulaa(n) jo man siau larai ||
verses.translation: He alone is a Mullah, who struggles with his mind,
and through the Guru's Teachings, fights with death.
He crushes the pride of the Messenger of Death.
Unto that Mullah, I ever offer greetings of respect. ||1||
God is present, right here at hand; why do you say that He is far away?
Tie up your disturbing passions, and find the Beauteous Lord. ||1||Pause||
He alone is a Qazi, who contemplates the human body,
and through the fire of the body, is illumined by God.
He does not lose his semen, even in his dreams;

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਕਾਜੀ ਕਉ ਜਰਾ ਨ ਮਰਨਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tis kaajee kau jaraa na maranaa ||2||
verses.translation: for such a Qazi, there is no old age or death. ||2||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਸੁਰਤਾਨੁ ਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਸਰ ਤਾਨੈ ॥
verses.translit: so surataanu ju dhui sar taanai ||
verses.translation: He alone is a sultan and a king, who shoots the two arrows,
gathers in his outgoing mind,
and assembles his army in the realm of the mind's sky, the Tenth Gate.
The canopy of royalty waves over such a sultan. ||3||
The Yogi cries out, ""Gorakh, Gorakh"".
The Hindu utters the Name of Raam.
The Muslim has only One God.
The Lord and Master of Kabeer is all-pervading. ||4||3||11||
Fifth Mehla:
Those who call a stone their god
their service is useless.
Those who fall at the feet of a stone god
- their work is wasted in vain. ||1||
My Lord and Master speaks forever.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sarab jeeaa kau prabh dhaan dhetaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: God gives His gifts to all living beings. ||1||Pause||
The Divine Lord is within the self, but the spiritually blind one does not know this.
Deluded by doubt, he is caught in the noose.

verses.original: ਨ ਪਾਥਰੁ ਬੋਲੈ ਨਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: n paathar bolai naa kichh dhei ||
verses.translation: The stone does not speak; it does not give anything to anyone.
Such religious rituals are useless; such service is fruitless. ||2||
If a corpse is anointed with sandalwood oil,

verses.original: ਉਸ ਤੇ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਵਨ ਫਲ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: aus te kahahu kavan fal paavai ||
verses.translation: what good does it do?

verses.original: ਜੇ ਮਿਰਤਕ ਕਉ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਰੁਲਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: je mritak kau bisaTaa maeh rulaiee ||
verses.translation: If a corpse is rolled in manure,

verses.original: ਤਾਂ ਮਿਰਤਕ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਘਟਿ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: taa(n) mritak kaa kiaa ghaT jaiee ||3||
verses.translation: what does it lose from this? ||3||
Says Kabeer, I proclaim this out loud
behold, and understand, you ignorant, faithless cynic.
The love of duality has ruined countless homes.
The Lord's devotees are forever in bliss. ||4||4||12||

verses.original: ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਮੀਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਬੇਧੇ ॥
verses.translit: jal meh meen maiaa ke bedhe ||
verses.translation: The fish in the water is attached to Maya.
The moth fluttering around the lamp is pierced through by Maya.
The sexual desire of Maya afflicts the elephant.
The snakes and bumble bees are destroyed through Maya. ||1||
Such are the enticements of Maya, O Siblings of Destiny.
As many living beings are there are, have been deceived. ||1||Pause||
The birds and the deer are imbued with Maya.
Sugar is a deadly trap for the flies.
Horses and camels are absorbed in Maya.
The eighty-four Siddhas, the beings of miraculous spiritual powers, play in Maya. ||2||
The six celibates are slaves of Maya.
So are the nine masters of Yoga, and the sun and the moon.
The austere disciplinarians and the Rishis are asleep in Maya.

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਅਰੁ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: maiaa meh kaal ar pa(n)ch dhootaa ||3||
verses.translation: Death and the five demons are in Maya. ||3||
Dogs and jackals are imbued with Maya.
Monkeys, leopards and lions,
cats, sheep, foxes,
trees and roots are planted in Maya. ||4||
Even the gods are drenched with Maya,
as are the oceans, the sky and the earth.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਿਸੁ ਉਦਰੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer jis udhar tis maiaa ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, whoever has a belly to fill, is under the spell of Maya.
The mortal is emancipated only when he meets the Holy Saint. ||5||5||13||
As long as he cries out, Mine! Mine!,

verses.original: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਕਾਜੁ ਏਕੁ ਨਹੀ ਸਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: tab lag kaaj ek nahee sarai ||
verses.translation: none of his tasks is accomplished.
When such possessiveness is erased and removed,
then God comes and resolves his affairs. ||1||
Contemplate such spiritual wisdom, O mortal man.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਨ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har kee na simarahu dhukh bha(n)janaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Why not meditate in remembrance on the Lord, the Destroyer of pain? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਸਿੰਘੁ ਰਹੈ ਬਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jab lag si(n)gh rahai ban maeh ||
verses.translation: As long as the tiger lives in the forest,

verses.original: ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਬਨੁ ਫੂਲੈ ਹੀ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: tab lag ban foolai hee naeh ||
verses.translation: the forest does not flower.

verses.original: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਸਿਆਰੁ ਸਿੰਘ ਕਉ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jab hee siaar si(n)gh kau khai ||
verses.translation: But when the jackal eats the tiger,
then the entire forest flowers. ||2||
The victorious are drowned, while the defeated swim across.
By Guru's Grace, one crosses over and is saved.
Slave Kabeer speaks and teaches:
remain lovingly absorbed, attuned to the Lord alone. ||3||6||14||

verses.original: ਸਤਰਿ ਸੈਇ ਸਲਾਰ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਕੇ ॥
verses.translit: satar sai salaar hai jaa ke ||
verses.translation: He has 7,000 commanders,
and hundreds of thousands of prophets;
He is said to have 88,000,000 shaykhs,

verses.original: ਛਪਨ ਕੋਟਿ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਖੇਲ ਖਾਸੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: chhapan koT jaa ke khel khaasee ||1||
verses.translation: and 56,000,000 attendants. ||1||
I am meek and poor - what chance do I have of being heard there?

verses.original: ਮਜਲਸਿ ਦੂਰਿ ਮਹਲੁ ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: majalas dhoor mahal ko paavai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: His Court is so far away; only a rare few attain the Mansion of His Presence. ||1||Pause||
He has 33,000,000 play-houses.
His beings wander insanely through 8.4 million incarnations.

verses.original: ਬਾਬਾ ਆਦਮ ਕਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: baabaa aadham kau kichh nadhar dhikhaiee ||
verses.translation: Even to Adam, only a glimpse of grace was shown.
who then lived in paradise for a long time. ||2||

verses.original: ਦਿਲ ਖਲਹਲੁ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਜਰਦ ਰੂ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhil khalahal jaa kai jaradh roo baanee ||
verses.translation: Pale are the faces of those whose hearts are disturbed.
They have forsaken their Bible, and practice Satanic evil.
One who blames the world, and is angry with people,
shall receive the fruits of his own actions. ||3||
You are the Great Giver, O Lord; I am forever a beggar at Your Door.
If I were to deny You, then I would be a wretched sinner.
Slave Kabeer has entered Your Shelter.
Keep me near You, O Merciful Lord God - that is heaven for me. ||4||7||15||

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਚਲਨ ਕਹਤ ਹੈ ਊਹਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: sabh koiee chalan kahat hai uoohaa(n) ||
verses.translation: Everyone speaks of going there,

verses.original: ਨਾ ਜਾਨਉ ਬੈਕੁੰਠੁ ਹੈ ਕਹਾਂ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naa jaanau baiku(n)Th hai kahaa(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: but I do not even know where heaven is. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਆਪ ਆਪ ਕਾ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥
verses.translit: aap aap kaa maram na jaanaa(n) ||
verses.translation: One who does not even know the mystery of his own self,
speaks of heaven, but it is only talk. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਮਨ ਬੈਕੁੰਠ ਕੀ ਆਸ ॥
verses.translit: jab lag man baiku(n)Th kee aas ||
verses.translation: As long as the mortal hopes for heaven,
he will not dwell at the Lord's Feet. ||2||
Heaven is not a fort with moats and ramparts, and walls plastered with mud;
I do not know what heaven's gate is like. ||3||
Says Kabeer, now what more can I say?
The Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is heaven itself. ||4||8||16||
How can the beautiful fortress be conquered, O Siblings of Destiny?

verses.original: ਦੋਵਰ ਕੋਟ ਅਰੁ ਤੇਵਰ ਖਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhovar koT ar tevar khaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: It has double walls and triple moats. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪਾਂਚ ਪਚੀਸ ਮੋਹ ਮਦ ਮਤਸਰ ਆਡੀ ਪਰਬਲ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: paa(n)ch pachees moh madh matasar aaddee parabal maiaa ||
verses.translation: It is defended by the five elements, the twenty-five categories, attachment, pride, jealousy and the awesomely powerful Maya.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਗਰੀਬ ਕੋ ਜੋਰੁ ਨ ਪਹੁਚੈ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਉ ਰਘੁਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan gareeb ko jor na pahuchai kahaa karau raghuraiaa ||1||
verses.translation: The poor mortal being does not have the strength to conquer it; what should I do now, O Lord? ||1||

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕਿਵਾਰੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਦਰਵਾਨੀ ਪਾਪੁ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਦਰਵਾਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: kaam kivaaree dhukh sukh dharavaanee paap pu(n)n dharavaajaa ||
verses.translation: Sexual desire is the window, pain and pleasure are the gate-keepers, virtue and sin are the gates.

verses.original: ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨੁ ਮਹਾ ਬਡ ਦੁੰਦਰ ਤਹ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਵਾਸੀ ਰਾਜਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: karodh pradhaan mahaa badd dhu(n)dhar teh man maavaasee raajaa ||2||
verses.translation: Anger is the great supreme commander, full of argument and strife, and the mind is the rebel king there. ||2||

verses.original: ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਸਨਾਹ ਟੋਪੁ ਮਮਤਾ ਕੋ ਕੁਬੁਧਿ ਕਮਾਨ ਚਢਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: savaiaadh sanaeh Top mamataa ko kubudh kamaan chaddaiee ||
verses.translation: Their armor is the pleasure of tastes and flavors, their helmets are worldly attachments; they take aim with their bows of corrupt intellect.

verses.original: ਤਿਸਨਾ ਤੀਰ ਰਹੇ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਇਉ ਗਢੁ ਲੀਓ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: tisanaa teer rahe ghaT bheetar iau gadd leeo na jaiee ||3||
verses.translation: The greed that fills their hearts is the arrow; with these things, their fortress is impregnable. ||3||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਲੀਤਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਹਵਾਈ ਗੋਲਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਚਲਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: prem paleetaa surat havaiee golaa giaan chalaiaa ||
verses.translation: But I have made divine love the fuse, and deep meditation the bomb; I have launched the rocket of spiritual wisdom.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਗਨਿ ਸਹਜੇ ਪਰਜਾਲੀ ਏਕਹਿ ਚੋਟ ਸਿਝਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: braham agan sahaje parajaalee ekeh choT sijhaiaa ||4||
verses.translation: The fire of God is lit by intuition, and with one shot, the fortress is taken. ||4||

verses.original: ਸਤੁ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਲੈ ਲਰਨੇ ਲਾਗਾ ਤੋਰੇ ਦੁਇ ਦਰਵਾਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: sat sa(n)tokh lai larane laagaa tore dhui dharavaajaa ||
verses.translation: Taking truth and contentment with me, I begin the battle and storm both the gates.

verses.original: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਅਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਤੇ ਪਕਰਿਓ ਗਢ ਕੋ ਰਾਜਾ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: saadhasa(n)gat ar gur kee kirapaa te pakario gadd ko raajaa ||5||
verses.translation: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and by Guru's Grace, I have captured the king of the fortress. ||5||

verses.original: ਭਗਵਤ ਭੀਰਿ ਸਕਤਿ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕੀ ਕਟੀ ਕਾਲ ਭੈ ਫਾਸੀ ॥
verses.translit: bhagavat bheer sakat simaran kee kaTee kaal bhai faasee ||
verses.translation: With the army of God's devotees, and Shakti, the power of meditation, I have snapped the noose of the fear of death.

verses.original: ਦਾਸੁ ਕਮੀਰੁ ਚੜਿੑਓ ਗੜੑ ਊਪਰਿ ਰਾਜੁ ਲੀਓ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੬॥੯॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: dhaas kameer chaRi(h)o gaR(h) uoopar raaj leeo abinaasee ||6||9||17||
verses.translation: Slave Kabeer has climbed to the top of the fortress; I have obtained the eternal, imperishable domain. ||6||9||17||
The mother Ganges is deep and profound.
Tied up in chains, they took Kabeer there. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਨ ਡਿਗੈ ਤਨੁ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਡਰਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man na ddigai tan kaahe kau ddarai ||
verses.translation: My mind was not shaken; why should my body be afraid?

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਚਿਤੁ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਮਾਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal chit rahio samai || rahaau ||
verses.translation: My consciousness remained immersed in the Lotus Feet of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੰਗਾ ਕੀ ਲਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਟੁਟੀ ਜੰਜੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: ga(n)gaa kee lahar meree TuTee ja(n)jeer ||
verses.translation: The waves of the Ganges broke the chains,
and Kabeer was seated on a deer skin. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕੰਬੀਰ ਕੋਊ ਸੰਗ ਨ ਸਾਥ ॥
verses.translit: keh ka(n)beer kouoo sa(n)g na saath ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, I have no friend or companion.
On the water, and on the land, the Lord is my Protector. ||3||10||18||

verses.translit: bhairau kabeer jeeau asaTapadhee ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Bhairao, Kabeer Jee, Ashtpadheeyaa, Second House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
God constructed a fortress, inaccessible and unreachable, in which He dwells.
There, His Divine Light radiates forth.
Lightning blazes, and bliss prevails there,
where the Eternally Young Lord God abides. ||1||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਜੀਉ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: eih jeeau raam naam liv laagai ||
verses.translation: This soul is lovingly attuned to the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਜਰਾ ਮਰਨੁ ਛੂਟੈ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaraa maran chhooTai bhram bhaagai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: It is saved from old age and death, and its doubt runs away. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਅਬਰਨ ਬਰਨ ਸਿਉ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: abaran baran siau man hee preet ||
verses.translation: Those who believe in high and low social classes,
only sing songs and chants of egotism.
The Unstruck Sound-current of the Shabad, the Word of God, resounds in that place,
where the Supreme Lord God abides. ||2||
He creates planets, solar systems and galaxies;
He destroys the three worlds, the three gods and the three qualities.
The Inaccessible and Unfathomable Lord God dwells in the heart.

verses.original: ਪਾਰੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਧਰਨੀਧਰ ਮੰਤ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: paar na paavai ko dharaneedhar ma(n)t ||3||
verses.translation: No one can find the limits or the secrets of the Lord of the World. ||3||
The Lord shines forth in the plantain flower and the sunshine.
He dwells in the pollen of the lotus flower.
The Lord's secret is within the twelve petals of the heart-lotus.
The Supreme Lord, the Lord of Lakshmi dwells there. ||4||
He is like the sky, stretching across the lower, upper and middle realms.
In the profoundly silent celestial realm, He radiates forth.
Neither the sun nor the moon are there,
but the Primal Immaculate Lord celebrates there. ||5||
Know that He is in the universe, and in the body as well.
Take your cleansing bath in the Mansarovar Lake.

verses.original: ਸੋਹੰ ਸੋ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੈ ਜਾਪ ॥
verses.translit: soha(n) so jaa kau hai jaap ||
verses.translation: Chant ""Sohang"" - ""He is me.""

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਲਿਪਤ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਪੁੰਨ ਅਰੁ ਪਾਪ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: jaa kau lipat na hoi pu(n)n ar paap ||6||
verses.translation: He is not affected by either virtue or vice. ||6||
He is not affected by either high or low social class, sunshine or shade.

verses.original: ਅਵਰ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: avar na paieeaai gur kee saam ||
verses.translation: He is in the Guru's Sanctuary, and nowhere else.

verses.original: ਟਾਰੀ ਨ ਟਰੈ ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: Taaree na Tarai aavai na jai ||
verses.translation: He is not diverted by diversions, comings or goings.
Remain intuitively absorbed in the celestial void. ||7||
One who knows the Lord in the mind
whatever he says, comes to pass.
One who firmly implants the Lord's Divine Light, and His Mantra within the mind
- says Kabeer, such a mortal crosses over to the other side. ||8||1||
Millions of suns shine for Him,
millions of Shivas and Kailash mountains.

verses.original: ਦੁਰਗਾ ਕੋਟਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਮਰਦਨੁ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhuragaa koT jaa kai maradhan karai ||
verses.translation: Millions of Durga goddesses massage His Feet.
Millions of Brahmas chant the Vedas for Him. ||1||
When I beg, I beg only from the Lord.

verses.original: ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸਿਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: aan dhev siau naahee kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I have nothing to do with any other deities. ||1||Pause||
Millions of moons twinkle in the sky.
Three hundred thirty million gods eat the Lord's offerings.
The nine stars, a million times over, stand at His Door.
Millions of Righteous Judges of Dharma are His gate-keepers. ||2||
Millions of winds blow around Him in the four directions.
Millions of serpents prepare His bed.
Millions of oceans are His water-carriers.
The eighteen million loads of vegetation are His Hair. ||3||
Millions of treasurers fill His Treasury.
Millions of Lakshmis adorn themselves for Him.
Many millions of vices and virtues look up to Him.

verses.original: ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਕੋਟਿ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਹਿ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: ei(n)dhr koT jaa ke sevaa kareh ||4||
verses.translation: Millions of Indras serve Him. ||4||
Fifty-six million clouds are His.
In each and every village, His infinite fame has spread.
Wild demons with dishevelled hair move about.
The Lord plays in countless ways. ||5||
Millions of charitable feasts are held in His Court,
and millions of celestial singers celebrate His victory.
Millions of sciences all sing His Praises.

verses.original: ਤਊ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਲਹੈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: tuoo paarabraham kaa a(n)t na lahai ||6||
verses.translation: Even so, the limits of the Supreme Lord God cannot be found. ||6||

verses.original: ਬਾਵਨ ਕੋਟਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਰੋਮਾਵਲੀ ॥ ਰਾਵਨ ਸੈਨਾ ਜਹ ਤੇ ਛਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: baavan koT jaa kai romaavalee || raavan sainaa jeh te chhalee ||
verses.translation: Rama, with millions of monkeys, conquered Raawan's army.
Billions of Puraanas greatly praise Him;
He humbled the pride of Duyodhan. ||7||

verses.original: ਕੰਦ੍ਰਪ ਕੋਟਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਧਰਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: ka(n)dhrap koT jaa kai lavai na dhareh ||
verses.translation: Millions of gods of love cannot compete with Him.
He steals the hearts of mortal beings.
Says Kabeer, please hear me, O Lord of the World.
I beg for the blessing of fearless dignity. ||8||2||18||20||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਬਾਣੀ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੧
verses.translit: bhairau baanee naamadheau jeeau kee ghar pehilaa
verses.translation: Bhairao, The Word Of Naam Dayv Jee, First House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
O my tongue, I will cut you into a hundred pieces,
if you do not chant the Name of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਰੰਗੀ ਲੇ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ra(n)gee le jihabaa har kai nai ||
verses.translation: O my tongue, be imbued with the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਸੁਰੰਗ ਰੰਗੀਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sura(n)g ra(n)geele har har dhiaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and imbue yourself with this most excellent color. ||1||Pause||
O my tongue, other occupations are false.

verses.original: ਨਿਰਬਾਣ ਪਦੁ ਇਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: nirabaan padh ik har ko naam ||2||
verses.translation: The state of Nirvaanaa comes only through the Lord's Name. ||2||
The performance of countless millions of other devotions
is not equal to even one devotion to the Name of the Lord. ||3||
Prays Naam Dayv, this is my occupation.
O Lord, Your Forms are endless. ||4||1||
One who stays away from others' wealth and others' spouses
- the Lord abides near that person. ||1||
Those who do not meditate and vibrate on the Lord

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਮੈ ਨ ਕਰਉ ਦਰਸਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tin kaa mai na karau dharasanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: - I do not even want to see them. ||1||Pause||
Those whose inner beings are not in harmony with the Lord,
are nothing more than beasts. ||2||
Prays Naam Dayv, a man without a nose
does not look handsome, even if he has the thirty-two beauty marks. ||3||2||

verses.original: ਦੂਧੁ ਕਟੋਰੈ ਗਡਵੈ ਪਾਨੀ ॥ ਕਪਲ ਗਾਇ ਨਾਮੈ ਦੁਹਿ ਆਨੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhoodh kaTorai gaddavai paanee || kapal gai naamai dhuh aanee ||1||
verses.translation: Naam Dayv milked the brown cow, and brought a cup of milk and a jug of water to his family god. ||1||
"Please drink this milk, O my Sovereign Lord God.
Drink this milk and my mind will be happy.

verses.original: ਨਾਹੀ ਤ ਘਰ ਕੋ ਬਾਪੁ ਰਿਸਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naahee ta ghar ko baap risai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Otherwise, my father will be angry with me.""||1||Pause||
Taking the golden cup, Naam Dayv filled it with the ambrosial milk,
and placed it before the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਏਕੁ ਭਗਤੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਬਸੈ ॥ ਨਾਮੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਰਾਇਨੁ ਹਸੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: ek bhagat mere hiradhe basai || naame dhekh narain hasai ||3||
verses.translation: The Lord looked upon Naam Dayv and smiled. ""This one devotee abides within my heart.""||3||
The Lord drank the milk, and the devotee returned home.
Thus did Naam Dayv come to receive the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||4||3||
I am crazy - the Lord is my Husband.

verses.original: ਰਚਿ ਰਚਿ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਕਰਉ ਸਿੰਗਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: rach rach taa kau karau si(n)gaar ||1||
verses.translation: I decorate and adorn myself for Him. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਲੇ ਨਿੰਦਉ ਭਲੇ ਨਿੰਦਉ ਭਲੇ ਨਿੰਦਉ ਲੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: bhale ni(n)dhau bhale ni(n)dhau bhale ni(n)dhau log ||
verses.translation: Slander me well, slander me well, slander me well, O people.

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tan man raam piaare jog ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My body and mind are united with my Beloved Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਾਦੁ ਬਿਬਾਦੁ ਕਾਹੂ ਸਿਉ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
verses.translit: baadh bibaadh kaahoo siau na keejai ||
verses.translation: Do not engage in any arguments or debates with anyone.
With your tongue, savor the Lord's sublime essence. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਬ ਜੀਅ ਜਾਨਿ ਐਸੀ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
verses.translit: ab jeea jaan aaisee ban aaiee ||
verses.translation: Now, I know within my soul, that such an arrangement has been made;
I will meet with my Lord by the beat of the drum. ||3||
Anyone can praise or slander me.
Naam Dayv has met the Lord. ||4||4||

verses.original: ਕਬਹੂ ਖੀਰਿ ਖਾਡ ਘੀਉ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: kabahoo kheer khaadd gheeau na bhaavai ||
verses.translation: Sometimes, people do not appreciate milk, sugar and ghee.
Sometimes, they have to beg for bread from door to door.
Sometimes, they have to pick out the grain from the chaff. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ ਰੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jiau raam raakhai tiau raheeaai re bhaiee ||
verses.translation: As the Lord keeps us, so do we live, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਥਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har kee mahimaa kichh kathan na jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Glory cannot even be described. ||1||Pause||
Sometimes, people prance around on horses.
Sometimes, they do not even have shoes for their feet. ||2||
Sometimes, people sleep on cozy beds with white sheets.
Sometimes, they do not even have straw to put down on the ground. ||3||
Naam Dayv prays, only the Naam, the Name of the Lord, can save us.

verses.original: ਜਿਹ ਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤਿਹ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੈ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: jeh gur milai teh paar utaarai ||4||5||
verses.translation: One who meets the Guru, is carried across to the other side. ||4||5||
Laughing and playing, I came to Your Temple, O Lord.
While Naam Dayv was worshipping, he was grabbed and driven out. ||1||
I am of a low social class, O Lord;

verses.original: ਛੀਪੇ ਕੇ ਜਨਮਿ ਕਾਹੇ ਕਉ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: chheepe ke janam kaahe kau aaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: why was I born into a family of fabric dyers? ||1||Pause||
I picked up my blanket and went back,
to sit behind the temple. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: jiau jiau naamaa har gun ucharai ||
verses.translation: As Naam Dayv uttered the Glorious Praises of the Lord,
the temple turned around to face the Lord's humble devotee. ||3||6||
Bhairao, Naam Dayv Jee, Second House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
As the hungry person loves food,
and the thirsty person is obsessed with water,
and as the fool is attached to his family
- just so, the Lord is very dear to Naam Dayv. ||1||
Naam Dayv is in love with the Lord.
He has naturally and intuitively become detached from the world. ||1||Pause||
Like the woman who falls in love with another man,
and the greedy man who loves only wealth,
and the sexually promiscuous man who loves women and sex,
just so, Naam Dayv is in love with the Lord. ||2||
But that alone is real love, which the Lord Himself inspires;
by Guru's Grace, duality is eradicated.
Such love never breaks; through it, the mortal remains merged in the Lord.
Naam Dayv has focused his consciousness on the True Name. ||3||
Like the love between the child and its mother,
so is my mind imbued with the Lord.
Prays Naam Dayv, I am in love with the Lord.
The Lord of the Universe abides within my consciousness. ||4||1||7||
The blind fool abandons the wife of his own home,
and has an affair with another woman.
He is like the parrot, who is pleased to see the simbal tree;
but in the end, he dies, stuck to it. ||1||
The home of the sinner is on fire.

verses.original: ਜਲਤ ਰਹੈ ਮਿਟਵੈ ਕਬ ਨਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jalat rahai miTavai kab naeh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: It keeps burning, and the fire cannot be extinguished. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਦੇਖੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har kee bhagat na dhekhai jai ||
verses.translation: He does not go to see where the Lord is being worshipped.
He abandons the Lord's Path, and takes the wrong path.
He forgets the Primal Lord God, and is caught in the cycle of reincarnation.
He throws away the Ambrosial Nectar, and gathers poison to eat. ||2||
He is like the prostitute, who comes to dance,
wearing beautiful clothes, decorated and adorned.
She dances to the beat, exciting the breath of those who watch her.

verses.original: ਵਾ ਕੇ ਗਲੇ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਫਾਸ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: vaa ke gale jam kaa hai faas ||3||
verses.translation: But the noose of the Messenger of Death is around her neck. ||3||
One who has good karma recorded on his forehead,

verses.original: ਸੋ ਭਜਿ ਪਰਿ ਹੈ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: so bhaj par hai gur kee saranaa ||
verses.translation: hurries to enter the Guru's Sanctuary.
Says Naam Dayv, consider this:
O Saints, this is the way to cross over to the other side. ||4||2||8||
Sanda and Marka went and complained to Harnaakhash,

verses.original: ਪੜੈ ਨਹੀ ਹਮ ਹੀ ਪਚਿ ਹਾਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: paRai nahee ham hee pach haare ||
verses.translation: "Your son does not read his lessons. We are tired of trying to teach him.

verses.original: ਰਾਮੁ ਕਹੈ ਕਰ ਤਾਲ ਬਜਾਵੈ ਚਟੀਆ ਸਭੈ ਬਿਗਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: raam kahai kar taal bajaavai chaTeeaa sabhai bigaare ||1||
verses.translation: He chants the Lord's Name, clapping his hands to keep the beat; he has spoiled all the other students. ||1||
He chants the Lord's Name,

verses.original: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਕੋ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਧਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hiradhai har jee ko simaran dharai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: and he has enshrined meditative remembrance of the Lord within his heart.""||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਸੁਧਾ ਬਸਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਸਭ ਰਾਜੇ ਬਿਨਤੀ ਕਰੈ ਪਟਰਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: basudhaa bas keenee sabh raaje binatee karai paTaraanee ||
verses.translation: "Your father the king has conquered the whole world", said his mother the queen.

verses.original: ਪੂਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ ਕਹਿਆ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਨੈ ਤਿਨਿ ਤਉ ਅਉਰੈ ਠਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: poot prahilaadh kahiaa nahee maanai tin tau aaurai Thaanee ||2||
verses.translation: "O Prahlad my son, you do not obey him, so he has decided to deal with you in another way."||2||

verses.original: ਦੁਸਟ ਸਭਾ ਮਿਲਿ ਮੰਤਰ ਉਪਾਇਆ ਕਰਸਹ ਅਉਧ ਘਨੇਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: dhusaT sabhaa mil ma(n)tar upaiaa karaseh aaudh ghaneree ||
verses.translation: The council of villians met and resolved to send Prahlaad into the life hereafter.

verses.original: ਗਿਰਿ ਤਰ ਜਲੁ ਜੁਆਲਾ ਭੈ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਫੇਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gir tar jal juaalaa bhai raakhio raajaa raam maiaa feree ||3||
verses.translation: Prahlaad was thrown off a mountain, into the water, and into a fire, but the Sovereign Lord God saved him, by changing the laws of nature. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਾਢਿ ਖੜਗੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਭੈ ਕੋਪਿਓ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਤਾਉ ਜੁ ਤੁਹਿ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: kaadd khaRag kaal bhai kopio moh bataau ju tuh raakhai ||
verses.translation: Harnaakhash thundered with rage and threatened to kill Prahlaad. ""Tell me, who can save you?""

verses.original: ਪੀਤ ਪੀਤਾਂਬਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਧਣੀ ਥੰਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਖੈ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: peet peetaa(n)bar tirabhavan dhanee tha(n)bh maeh har bhaakhai ||4||
verses.translation: Prahlaad answered, ""The Lord, the Master of the three worlds, is contained even in this pillar to which I am tied.""||4||

verses.original: ਹਰਨਾਖਸੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਖਹ ਬਿਦਾਰਿਓ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਕੀਏ ਸਨਾਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: haranaakhas jin nakheh bidhaario sur nar ke'ee sanaathaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord who tore Harnaakhash apart with His nails proclaimed Himself the Lord of gods and men.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਹਮ ਨਰਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਵਹ ਰਾਮੁ ਅਭੈ ਪਦ ਦਾਤਾ ॥੫॥੩॥੯॥
verses.translit: keh naamadheau ham narahar dhiaaveh raam abhai padh dhaataa ||5||3||9||
verses.translation: Says Naam Dayv, I meditate on the Lord, the Man-lion, the Giver of fearless dignity. ||5||3||9||
The Sultan said, ""Listen, Naam Dayv:
let me see the actions of your Lord.""||1||
The Sultan arrested Naam Dayv,
and said, ""Let me see your Beloved Lord.""||1||Pause||
"Bring this dead cow back to life.
Otherwise, I shall cut off your head here and now.""||2||
Naam Dayv answered, ""O king, how can this happen?
No one can bring the dead back to life. ||3||
I cannot do anything by my own actions.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਹੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਹੋਇ ਹੈ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: kar hai raam hoi hai soi ||4||
verses.translation: Whatever the Lord does, that alone happens.""||4||
The arrogant king was enraged at this reply.
He incited an elephant to attack. ||5||
Naam Dayv's mother began to cry,

verses.original: ਛੋਡਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਕੀ ਨ ਭਜਹਿ ਖੁਦਾਇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: chhodd raam kee na bhajeh khudhai ||6||
verses.translation: and she said, ""Why don't you abandon your Lord Raam, and worship his Lord Allah?""||6||

verses.original: ਨ ਹਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਪੂੰਗੜਾ ਨ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: n hau teraa poo(n)gaRaa na too meree mai ||
verses.translation: Naam Dayv answered, ""I am not your son, and you are not my mother.

verses.original: ਪਿੰਡੁ ਪੜੈ ਤਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਇ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: pi(n)dd paRai tau har gun gai ||7||
verses.translation: Even if my body dies, I will still sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.""||7||
The elephant attacked him with his trunk,
but Naam Dayv was saved, protected by the Lord. ||8||
The king said, ""The Qazis and the Mullahs bow down to me,
but this Hindu has trampled my honor.""||9||
The people pleaded with the king, ""Hear our prayer, O king.
Here, take Naam Dayvs weight in gold, and release him.""||10||
The king replied, ""If I take the gold, then I will be consigned to hell,
by forsaking my faith and gathering worldly wealth.""||11||
With his feet in chains, Naam Dayv kept the beat with his hands,
singing the Praises of the Lord. ||12||
"Even if the Ganges and the Jamunaa rivers flow backwards,
I will still continue singing the Praises of the Lord.""||13||
Three hours passed,
and even then, the Lord of the three worlds had not come. ||14||
Playing on the instrument of the feathered wings,
the Lord of the Universe came, mounted on the eagle garura. ||15||
He cherished His devotee,
and the Lord came, mounted on the eagle garura. ||16||
The Lord said to him, ""If you wish, I shall turn the earth sideways.

verses.original: ਕਹਹਿ ਤ ਲੇ ਕਰਿ ਊਪਰਿ ਧਰਉ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit: kaheh ta le kar uoopar dharau ||17||
verses.translation: If you wish, I shall turn it upside down. ||17||

verses.original: ਕਹਹਿ ਤ ਮੁਈ ਗਊ ਦੇਉ ਜੀਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: kaheh ta muiee guoo dheau jeeaai ||
verses.translation: If you wish, I shall bring the dead cow back to life.
Everyone will see and be convinced.""||18||
Naam Dayv prayed, and milked the cow.
He brought the calf to the cow, and milked her. ||19||
When the pitcher was filled with milk,
Naam Dayv took it and placed it before the king. ||20||
The king went into his palace,
and his heart was troubled. ||21||
Through the Qazis and the Mullahs, the king offered his prayer,
"Forgive me, please, O Hindu; I am just a cow before you."||22||
Naam Dayv said, ""Listen, O king:
have I done this miracle? ||23||
The purpose of this miracle is
that you, O king, should walk on the path of truth and humility.""||24||
Naam Dayv became famous everywhere for this.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਸਭ ਨਾਮੇ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨੫॥
verses.translit: mil hi(n)dhoo sabh naame peh jaeh ||25||
verses.translation: The Hindus all went together to Naam Dayv. ||25||

verses.original: ਜਉ ਅਬ ਕੀ ਬਾਰ ਨ ਜੀਵੈ ਗਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jau ab kee baar na jeevai gai ||
verses.translation: If the cow had not been revived,
people would have lost faith in Naam Dayv. ||26||
The fame of Naam Dayv spread throughout the world.
The humble devotees were saved and carried across with him. ||27||
All sorts of troubles and pains afflicted the slanderer.
There is no difference between Naam Dayv and the Lord. ||28||1||10||
Second House:
By the Grace of the Divine Guru, one meets the Lord.
By the Grace of the Divine Guru, one is carried across to the other side.
By the Grace of the Divine Guru, one swims across to heaven.
By the Grace of the Divine Guru, one remains dead while yet alive. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: sat sat sat sat sat gurdhev ||
verses.translation: True, True, True True, True is the Divine Guru.

verses.original: ਝੂਠੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਝੂਠੁ ਆਨ ਸਭ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jhooTh jhooTh jhooTh jhooTh aan sabh sev ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: False, false, false, false is all other service. ||1||Pause||
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is implanted within.

verses.original: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਨ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jau gurdheau na dheh dhis dhaavai ||
verses.translation: When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one does not wander in the ten directions.
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, the five demons are kept far away.
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one does not die regretting. ||2||
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one is blessed with the Ambrosial Bani of the Word.
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one speaks the Unspoken Speech.
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one's body becomes like ambrosial nectar.
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one utters and chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one sees the three worlds.
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one understands the state of supreme dignity.
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one's head is in the Akaashic ethers.
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one is always congratulated everywhere. ||4||
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one remains detached forever.
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one forsakes the slander of others.
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one looks upon good and bad as the same.
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one has good destiny written on his forehead. ||5||
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, the wall of the body is not eroded.
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, the temple turns itself towards the mortal.
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one's home is constructed.
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one's bed is lifted up out of the water. ||6||
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one has bathed at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one's body is stamped with the sacred mark of Vishnu.
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one has performed the twelve devotional services.
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, all poison is transformed into fruit. ||7||
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, skepticism is shattered.

verses.original: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਤ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਛੂਟੈ ॥
verses.translit: jau gurdheau ta jam te chhooTai ||
verses.translation: When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one escapes from the Messenger of Death.
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one crosses over the terrifying world-ocean.

verses.original: ਜਉ ਗੁਰਦੇਉ ਤ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਮਰੈ ॥੮॥
verses.translit: jau gurdheau ta janam na marai ||8||
verses.translation: When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one is not subject to the cycle of reincarnation. ||8||
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one understands the rituals of the eighteen Puraanas.
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, it is as if one has made an offering of the eighten loads of vegetation.
When the Divine Guru grants His Grace, one needs no other place of rest.
Naam Dayv has entered the Sanctuary of the Guru. ||9||1||2||11||

verses.original: ਭੈਰਉ ਬਾਣੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੨
verses.translit: bhairau baanee ravidhaas jeeau kee ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Bhairao, The Word Of Ravi Daas Jee, Second House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Without seeing something, the yearning for it does not arise.
Whatever is seen, shall pass away.
Whoever chants and praises the Naam, the Name of the Lord,
is the true Yogi, free of desire. ||1||
When someone utters the Name of the Lord with love,

verses.original: ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਸੈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: paaras parasai dhubidhaa na hoiee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: it is as if he has touched the philosopher's stone; his sense of duality is eradicated. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੋ ਮੁਨਿ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਖਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: so mun man kee dhubidhaa khai ||
verses.translation: He alone is a silent sage, who destroys the duality of his mind.
Keeping the doors of his body closed, he merges in the Lord of the three worlds.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਕਾ ਸੁਭਾਉ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਕਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: man kaa subhaau sabh koiee karai ||
verses.translation: Everyone acts according to the inclinations of the mind.
Attuned to the Creator Lord, one remains free of fear. ||2||
Plants blossom forth to produce fruit.
When the fruit is produced, the flowers wither away.
For the sake of spiritual wisdom, people act and practice rituals.
When spiritual wisdom wells up, then actions are left behind. ||3||
For the sake of ghee, wise people churn milk.
Those who are Jivan-mukta, liberated while yet alive - are forever in the state of Nirvaanaa.
Says Ravi Daas, O you unfortunate people,

verses.original: ਰਿਦੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਕੀ ਨ ਜਪਸਿ ਅਭਾਗ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: ridhai raam kee na japas abhaag ||4||1||
verses.translation: why not meditate on the Lord with love in your heart? ||4||1||
Naam Dayv:
Come, O Lord of beautiful hair,
wearing the robes of a Sufi Saint. ||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਆਕਾਸ ਕੁਲਹ ਸਿਰਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਕਉਸੈ ਸਪਤ ਪਯਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: jin aakaas kuleh sir keenee kausai sapat payaalaa ||
verses.translation: Your cap is the realm of the Akaashic ethers; the seven nether worlds are Your sandals.

verses.original: ਚਮਰ ਪੋਸ ਕਾ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਨੇ ਗੁਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: chamar pos kaa ma(n)dhar teraa ieh bidh bane gupaalaa ||1||
verses.translation: The body covered with skin is Your temple; You are so beautiful, O Lord of the World. ||1||

verses.original: ਛਪਨ ਕੋਟਿ ਕਾ ਪੇਹਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੋਲਹ ਸਹਸ ਇਜਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: chhapan koT kaa pehan teraa soleh sahas ijaaraa ||
verses.translation: The fifty-six million clouds are Your gowns, the 16,000 milkmaids are your skirts.

verses.original: ਭਾਰ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਮੁਦਗਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਹਨਕ ਸਭ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bhaar aThaareh mudhagar teraa sahanak sabh sa(n)saaraa ||2||
verses.translation: The eighteen loads of vegetation is Your stick, and all the world is Your plate. ||2||

verses.original: ਦੇਹੀ ਮਹਜਿਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਮਉਲਾਨਾ ਸਹਜ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਗੁਜਾਰੈ ॥
verses.translit: dhehee mahajidh man maulaanaa sahaj nivaaj gujaarai ||
verses.translation: The human body is the mosque, and the mind is the priest, who peacefully leads the prayer.

verses.original: ਬੀਬੀ ਕਉਲਾ ਸਉ ਕਾਇਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਆਕਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: beebee kaulaa sau kain teraa nira(n)kaar aakaarai ||3||
verses.translation: You are married to Maya, O Formless Lord, and so You have taken form. ||3||

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਤ ਮੇਰੇ ਤਾਲ ਛਿਨਾਏ ਕਿਹ ਪਹਿ ਕਰਉ ਪੁਕਾਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat karat mere taal chhinaae keh peh karau pukaaraa ||
verses.translation: Performing devotional worship services to You, my cymbals were taken away; unto whom should I complain?

verses.original: ਨਾਮੇ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਫਿਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਬੇਦੇਸਵਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: naame kaa suaamee a(n)tarajaamee fire sagal bedhesavaa ||4||1||
verses.translation: Naam Dayv's Lord and Master, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, wanders everywhere; He has no specific home. ||4||1||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਦੁਤੁਕੇ
verses.translit: raag basa(n)t mahalaa pehilaa ghar pehilaa chaupadhe dhutuke
verses.translation: Raag Basant, First Mehla, First House, Chau-Padhay, Dho-Thukay:

verses.original: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
verses.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

verses.original: ਮਾਹਾ ਮਾਹ ਮੁਮਾਰਖੀ ਚੜਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਬਸੰਤੁ ॥
verses.translit: maahaa maeh mumaarakhee chaRiaa sadhaa basa(n)t ||
verses.translation: Among the months, blessed is this month, when spring always comes.

verses.original: ਪਰਫੜੁ ਚਿਤ ਸਮਾਲਿ ਸੋਇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: parafaR chit samaal soi sadhaa sadhaa gobi(n)dh ||1||
verses.translation: Blossom forth, O my consciousness, contemplating the Lord of the Universe, forever and ever. ||1||
O ignorant one, forget your egotistical intellect.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਮਨ ਗੁਣ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਣੁ ਲੈ ਸਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: haumai maar beechaar man gun vich gun lai saar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Subdue your ego, and contemplate Him in your mind; gather in the virtues of the Sublime, Virtuous Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਰਮ ਪੇਡੁ ਸਾਖਾ ਹਰੀ ਧਰਮੁ ਫੁਲੁ ਫਲੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: karam pedd saakhaa haree dharam ful fal giaan ||
verses.translation: Karma is the tree, the Lord's Name the branches, Dharmic faith the flowers, and spiritual wisdom the fruit.

verses.original: ਪਤ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਛਾਵ ਘਣੀ ਚੂਕਾ ਮਨ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: pat paraapat chhaav ghanee chookaa man abhimaan ||2||
verses.translation: Realization of the Lord are the leaves, and eradication of the pride of the mind is the shade. ||2||

verses.original: ਅਖੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕੰਨੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਆਖਣੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: akhee kudharat ka(n)nee baanee mukh aakhan sach naam ||
verses.translation: Whoever sees the Lord's Creative Power with his eyes, and hears the Guru's Bani with his ears, and utters the True Name with his mouth,

verses.original: ਪਤਿ ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਹੋਆ ਲਾਗਾ ਸਹਜਿ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: pat kaa dhan pooraa hoaa laagaa sahaj dhiaan ||3||
verses.translation: attains the perfect wealth of honor, and intuitively focuses his meditation on the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਾਹਾ ਰੁਤੀ ਆਵਣਾ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: maahaa rutee aavanaa vekhahu karam kamai ||
verses.translation: The months and the seasons come; see, and do your deeds.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰੇ ਨ ਸੂਕਹੀ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak hare na sookahee j gurmukh rahe samai ||4||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, those Gurmukhs who remain merged in the Lord do not wither away; they remain green forever. ||4||1||
First Mehla, Basant:
The season of spring, so delightful, has come.

verses.original: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਰਵਹਿ ਸਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਚਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: ra(n)g raate raveh s terai chai ||
verses.translation: Those who are imbued with love for You, O Lord, chant Your Name with joy.
Whom else should I worship? At whose feet should I bow? ||1||
I am the slave of Your slaves, O my Sovereign Lord King.

verses.original: ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਕਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jagajeevan jugat na milai kai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O Life of the Universe, there is no other way to meet You. ||1||Pause||
You have only One Form, and yet You have countless forms.
Which one should I worship? Before which one should I burn incense?

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਹਾ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: teraa a(n)t na paiaa kahaa pai ||
verses.translation: Your limits cannot be found. How can anyone find them?
I am the slave of Your slaves, O my Sovereign Lord King. ||2||
The cycles of years and the places of pilgrimage are Yours, O Lord.
Your Name is True, O Transcendent Lord God.
Your State cannot be known, O Eternal, Unchanging Lord God.
Although You are unknown, still we chant Your Name. ||3||
What can poor Nanak say?
All people praise the One Lord.
Nanak places his head on the feet of such people.

verses.original: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਜਾਉ ਜੇਤੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਵ ਹੈ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: balihaaree jaau jete tere naav hai ||4||2||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to Your Names, as many as there are, O Lord. ||4||2||
Basant, First Mehla:
The kitchen is golden, and the cooking pots are golden.
The lines marking the cooking square are silver.

verses.original: ਗੰਗਾ ਕਾ ਉਦਕੁ ਕਰੰਤੇ ਕੀ ਆਗਿ ॥
verses.translit: ga(n)gaa kaa udhak kara(n)te kee aag ||
verses.translation: The water is from the Ganges, and the firewood is sanctified.
The food is soft rice, cooked in milk. ||1||

verses.original: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਲੇਖੈ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: re man lekhai kabahoo na pai ||
verses.translation: O my mind, these things are worthless,

verses.original: ਜਾਮਿ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਸਾਚ ਨਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaam na bheejai saach nai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: if you are not drenched with the True Name. ||1||Pause||
One may have the eighteen Puraanas written in his own hand;
he may recite the four Vedas by heart,
and take ritual baths at holy festivals and give charitable donations;
he may observe the ritual fasts, and perform religious ceremonies day and night. ||2||
He may be a Qazi, a Mullah or a Shaykh,
a Yogi or a wandering hermit wearing saffron-colored robes;
he may be a householder, working at his job;
but without understanding the essence of devotional worship, all people are eventually bound and gagged, and driven along by the Messenger of Death. ||3||
Each person's karma is written on his forehead.
According to their deeds, they shall be judged.
Only the foolish and the ignorant issue commands.
O Nanak, the treasure of praise belongs to the True Lord alone. ||4||3||
Basant, Third Mehla:
A person may take off his clothes and be naked.
What Yoga does he practice by having matted and tangled hair?
If the mind is not pure, what use is it to hold the breath at the Tenth Gate?

verses.original: ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਵੈ ਮੂੜੑਾ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bhram bhram aavai mooR(h)aa vaaro vaar ||1||
verses.translation: The fool wanders and wanders, entering the cycle of reincarnation again and again. ||1||
Meditate on the One Lord, O my foolish mind,

verses.original: ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਇਕ ਖਿਨਾਂ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: paar utar jaeh ik khinaa(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: and you shall cross over to the other side in an instant. ||1||Pause||
Some recite and expound on the Simritees and the Shaastras;
some sing the Vedas and read the Puraanas;
but they practice hypocrisy and deception with their eyes and minds.
The Lord does not even come near them. ||2||
Even if someone practices such self-discipline,
compassion and devotional worship
- if he is filled with greed, and his mind is engrossed in corruption,
how can he find the Immaculate Lord? ||3||
What can the created being do?
The Lord Himself moves him.
If the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, then his doubts are dispelled.
If the mortal realizes the Hukam of the Lord's Command, he obtains the True Lord. ||4||
If someone's soul is polluted within,
what is the use of his traveling to sacred shrines of pilgrimage all over the world?
O Nanak, when one joins the Society of the True Guru,
then the bonds of the terrifying world-ocean are broken. ||5||4||
Basant, First Mehla:
All the worlds have been fascinated and enchanted by Your Maya, O Lord.

verses.original: ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੀਸੈ ਸਰਬ ਤੋਹ ॥
verses.translit: mai avar na dheesai sarab toh ||
verses.translation: I do not see any other at all - You are everywhere.
You are the Master of Yogis, the Divinity of the divine.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਸੇਵ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har naam milai gur charan sev ||1||
verses.translation: Serving at the Guru's Feet, the Name of the Lord is received. ||1||
O my Beauteous, Deep and Profound Beloved Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਤੂ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਸਰਬ ਪਾਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh raam naam gun gaae too apara(n)par sarab paal ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name. You are Infinite, the Cherisher of all. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਧ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: bin saadh na paieeaai har kaa sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: Without the Holy Saint, association with the Lord is not obtained.
Without the Guru, one's very fiber is stained with filth.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਨ ਸੁਧੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin har naam na sudh hoi ||
verses.translation: Without the Lord's Name, one cannot become pure.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, sing the Praises of the True Lord. ||2||
O Savior Lord, that person whom You have saved
- You lead him to meet the True Guru, and so take care of him.
You take away his poisonous egotism and attachment.
You dispel all his sufferings, O Sovereign Lord God. ||3||

verses.original: ਊਤਮ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਸਰੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: uootam gat mit har gun sareer ||
verses.translation: His state and condition are sublime; the Lord's Glorious Virtues permeate his body.
Through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, the diamond of the Lord's Name is revealed.

verses.original: ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਜਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: liv laagee naam taj dhoojaa bhaau ||
verses.translation: He is lovingly attuned to the Naam; he is rid of the love of duality.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥੪॥੫॥
verses.translit: jan naanak har gur gur milaau ||4||5||
verses.translation: O Lord, let servant Nanak meet the Guru. ||4||5||
Basant, First Mehla:
O my friends and companions, listen with love in your heart.
My Husband Lord is Incomparably Beautiful; He is always with me.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: oh alakh na lakheeaai kahahu kai ||
verses.translation: He is Unseen - He cannot be seen. How can I describe Him?
The Guru has shown me that my Sovereign Lord God is with me. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਿਲੁ ਸਖੀ ਸਹੇਲੀ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਬਨੇ ॥
verses.translit: mil sakhee sahelee har gun bane ||
verses.translation: Joining together with my friends and companions, I am adorned with the Lord's Glorious Virtues.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਗਿ ਖੇਲਹਿ ਵਰ ਕਾਮਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਖੋਜਤ ਮਨ ਮਨੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har prabh sa(n)g kheleh var kaaman gurmukh khojat man mane ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The sublime soul-brides play with their Lord God. The Gurmukhs look within themselves; their minds are filled with faith. ||1||Pause||
The self-willed manmukhs, suffering in separation, do not understand this mystery.

verses.original: ਓਹੁ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਾਵੈ ਸਰਬ ਪ੍ਰੇਉ ॥
verses.translit: oh ghaT ghaT raavai sarab preau ||
verses.translation: The Beloved Lord of all celebrates in each and every heart.
The Gurmukh is stable, knowing that God is always with him.
The Guru has implanted the Naam within me; I chant it, and meditate on it. ||2||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਭਾਉ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur bhagat na bhaau hoi ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, devotional love does not well up within.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਤ ਨ ਸੰਗੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur sa(n)t na sa(n)g dhei ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, one is not blessed with the Society of the Saints.
Without the Guru, the blind cry out, entangled in worldly affairs.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਮਲੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਖੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: man gurmukh niramal mal sabadh khoi ||3||
verses.translation: That mortal who becomes Gurmukh becomes immaculate; the Word of the Shabad washes away his filth. ||3||
Uniting with the Guru, the mortal conquers and subdues his mind.
Day and night, he savors the Yoga of devotional worship.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸੰਤ ਸਭਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਿਟੈ ਰੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: gur sa(n)t sabhaa dhukh miTai rog ||
verses.translation: Associating with the Saint Guru, suffering and sickness are ended.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਸਹਜ ਜੋਗੁ ॥੪॥੬॥
verses.translit: jan naanak har var sahaj jog ||4||6||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak merges with his Husband Lord, in the Yoga of intuitive ease. ||4||6||
Basant, First Mehla:
By His Creative Power, God fashioned the creation.
The King of kings Himself adminsters true justice.
The most sublime Word of the Guru's Teachings is always with us.
The wealth of the Lord's Name, the source of nectar, is easily acquired. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਤ ਬਿਸਰਸਿ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਬੋਲਿ ॥
verses.translit: mat bisaras re man raam bol ||
verses.translation: So chant the Name of the Lord; do not forget it, O my mind.

verses.original: ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਤੁਲਾਏ ਅਤੁਲੁ ਤੋਲਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: apara(n)par agam agochar gurmukh har aap tulaae atul tol ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord is Infinite, Inaccessible and Incomprehensible; His weight cannot be weighed, but He Himself allows the Gurmukh to weigh Him. ||1||Pause||
Your GurSikhs serve at the Guru's Feet.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵ ਤਰੇ ਤਜਿ ਮੇਰ ਤੋਰ ॥
verses.translit: gur sev tare taj mer tor ||
verses.translation: Serving the Guru, they are carried across; they have abandoned any distinction between 'mine' and 'yours'.
The slanderous and greedy people are hard-hearted.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਭਾਈ ਸਿ ਚੋਰ ਚੋਰ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur sev na bhaiee s chor chor ||2||
verses.translation: Those who do not love to serve the Guru are the most thieving of thieves. ||2||
When the Guru is pleased, He blesses the mortals with loving devotional worship of the Lord.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਮਹਲਿ ਠਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur tuThai paieeaai har mahal Thaau ||
verses.translation: When the Guru is pleased, the mortal obtains a place in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.
So renounce slander, and awaken in devotional worship of the Lord.
Devotion to the Lord is wonderful; it comes through good karma and destiny. ||3||
The Guru unites in union with the Lord, and grants the gift of the Name.
The Guru loves His Sikhs, day and night.

verses.original: ਫਲੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੁਸਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: fal naam paraapat gur tus dhei ||
verses.translation: They obtain the fruit of the Naam, when the Guru's favor is bestowed.
Says Nanak, those who receive it are very rare indeed. ||4||7||
Basant, Third Mehla, Ek-Thukay:
When it pleases our Lord and Master, His servant serves Him.
He remains dead while yet alive, and redeems all his ancestors. ||1||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਹਸੈ ॥
verses.translit: teree bhagat na chhoddau kiaa ko hasai ||
verses.translation: I shall not renounce Your devotional worship, O Lord; what does it matter if people laugh at me?

verses.original: ਸਾਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saach naam merai hiradhai vasai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The True Name abides within my heart. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜੈਸੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਗਲਤੁ ਰਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaise maiaa moh praanee galat rahai ||
verses.translation: Just as the mortal remains engrossed in attachment to Maya,

verses.original: ਤੈਸੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਵਤ ਰਹੈ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: taise sa(n)t jan raam naam ravat rahai ||2||
verses.translation: so does the Lord's humble Saint remain absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||2||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: mai moorakh mugadh uoopar karahu dhiaa ||
verses.translation: I am foolish and ignorant, O Lord; please be merciful to me.
May I remain in Your Sanctuary. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹਤੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੇ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਕਾਮਾ ॥
verses.translit: kahat naanak sa(n)saar ke nihafal kaamaa ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, worldly affairs are fruitless.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕੋ ਪਾਵੈ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੪॥੮॥
verses.translit: gur prasaadh ko paavai a(n)mirat naamaa ||4||8||
verses.translation: Only by Guru's Grace does one receive the Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||8||

verses.translit: mahalaa pehilaa basa(n)t hi(n)ddol ghar doojaa
verses.translation: First Mehla, Basant Hindol, Second House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਸਾਲ ਗ੍ਰਾਮ ਬਿਪ ਪੂਜਿ ਮਨਾਵਹੁ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤੁਲਸੀ ਮਾਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: saal graam bip pooj manaavahu sukirat tulasee maalaa ||
verses.translation: O Brahmin, you worship and believe in your stone-god, and wear your ceremonial rosary beads.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਬੇੜਾ ਬਾਂਧਹੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: raam naam jap beRaa baa(n)dhahu dhiaa karahu dhiaalaa ||1||
verses.translation: Chant the Name of the Lord. Build your boat, and pray, ""O Merciful Lord, please be merciful to me.""||1||
Why do you irrigate the barren, alkaline soil? You are wasting your life away!

verses.original: ਕਾਚੀ ਢਹਗਿ ਦਿਵਾਲ ਕਾਹੇ ਗਚੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kaachee ddahag dhivaal kaahe gach laavahu ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: This wall of mud is crumbling. Why bother to patch it with plaster? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਰ ਹਰਿਹਟ ਮਾਲ ਟਿੰਡ ਪਰੋਵਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਮਨੁ ਜੋਵਹੁ ॥
verses.translit: kar harihaT maal Ti(n)dd parovahu tis bheetar man jovahu ||
verses.translation: Let your hands be the buckets, strung on the chain, and yoke the mind as the ox to pull it; draw the water up from the well.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਿੰਚਹੁ ਭਰਹੁ ਕਿਆਰੇ ਤਉ ਮਾਲੀ ਕੇ ਹੋਵਹੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: a(n)mrit si(n)chahu bharahu kiaare tau maalee ke hovahu ||2||
verses.translation: Irrigate your fields with the Ambrosial Nectar, and you shall be owned by God the Gardener. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਦੁਇ ਕਰਹੁ ਬਸੋਲੇ ਗੋਡਹੁ ਧਰਤੀ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh dhui karahu basole goddahu dharatee bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Let sexual desire and anger be your two shovels, to dig up the dirt of your farm, O Siblings of Destiny.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਗੋਡਹੁ ਤਿਉ ਤੁਮੑ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨ ਮੇਟਿਆ ਜਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jiau goddahu tiau tum(h) sukh paavahu kirat na meTiaa jaiee ||3||
verses.translation: The more you dig, the more peace you shall find. Your past actions cannot be erased. ||3||

verses.original: ਬਗੁਲੇ ਤੇ ਫੁਨਿ ਹੰਸੁਲਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੇ ਤੂ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
verses.translit: bagule te fun ha(n)sulaa hovai je too kareh dhiaalaa ||
verses.translation: The crane is again transformed into a swan, if You so will, O Merciful Lord.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੯॥
verses.translit: pranavat naanak dhaasan dhaasaa dhiaa karahu dhiaalaa ||4||1||9||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, the slave of Your slaves: O Merciful Lord, have mercy on me. ||4||1||9||
Basant, First Mehla, Hindol:

verses.original: ਸਾਹੁਰੜੀ ਵਥੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਝੀ ਪੇਵਕੜੈ ਧਨ ਵਖੇ ॥
verses.translit: saahuraRee vath sabh kichh saajhee pevakaRai dhan vakhe ||
verses.translation: In the House of the Husband Lord - in the world hereafter, everything is jointly owned; but in this world - in the house of the soul-bride's parents, the soul-bride owns them separately.

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਕੁਚਜੀ ਦੋਸੁ ਨ ਦੇਊ ਜਾਣਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਰਖੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: aap kuchajee dhos na dheuoo jaanaa naahee rakhe ||1||
verses.translation: She herself is ill-mannered; how can she blame anyone else? She does not know how to take care of these things. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਹਉ ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: mere saahibaa hau aape bharam bhulaanee ||
verses.translation: O my Lord and Master, I am deluded by doubt.

verses.original: ਅਖਰ ਲਿਖੇ ਸੇਈ ਗਾਵਾ ਅਵਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: akhar likhe seiee gaavaa avar na jaanaa baanee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I sing the Word which You have written; I do not know any other Word. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਢਿ ਕਸੀਦਾ ਪਹਿਰਹਿ ਚੋਲੀ ਤਾਂ ਤੁਮੑ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: kadd kaseedhaa pahireh cholee taa(n) tum(h) jaanahu naaree ||
verses.translation: She alone is known as the Lord's bride, who embroiders her gown in the Name.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਘਰੁ ਰਾਖਹਿ ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਚਾਖਹਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: je ghar raakheh buraa na chaakheh hoveh ka(n)t piaaree ||2||
verses.translation: She who preserves and protects the home of her own heart and does not taste of evil, shall be the Beloved of her Husband Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਜੇ ਤੂੰ ਪੜਿਆ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਬੀਨਾ ਦੁਇ ਅਖਰ ਦੁਇ ਨਾਵਾ ॥
verses.translit: je too(n) paRiaa pa(n)ddit beenaa dhui akhar dhui naavaa ||
verses.translation: If you are a learned and wise religious scholar, then make a boat of the letters of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਏਕੁ ਲੰਘਾਏ ਜੇ ਕਰਿ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਵਾਂ ॥੩॥੨॥੧੦॥
verses.translit: pranavat naanak ek la(n)ghaae je kar sach samaavaa(n) ||3||2||10||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, the One Lord shall carry you across, if you merge in the True Lord. ||3||2||10||
Basant Hindol, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਰਾਜਾ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਨਗਰੀ ਕਾਚੀ ਦੁਸਟਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥
verses.translit: raajaa baalak nagaree kaachee dhusaTaa naal piaaro ||
verses.translation: The king is just a boy, and his city is vulnerable. He is in love with his wicked enemies.

verses.original: ਦੁਇ ਮਾਈ ਦੁਇ ਬਾਪਾ ਪੜੀਅਹਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: dhui maiee dhui baapaa paRe'eh pa(n)ddit karahu beechaaro ||1||
verses.translation: He reads of his two mothers and his two fathers; O Pandit, reflect on this. ||1||
O Master Pandit, teach me about this.
How can I obtain the Lord of life? ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਭੀਤਰਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਬਨਾਸਪਤਿ ਮਉਲੀ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਪੰਡੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: bheetar agan banaasapat maulee saagar pa(n)ddai paiaa ||
verses.translation: There is fire within the plants which bloom; the ocean is tied into a bundle.

verses.original: ਚੰਦੁ ਸੂਰਜੁ ਦੁਇ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਐਸਾ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: cha(n)dh sooraj dhui ghar hee bheetar aaisaa giaan na paiaa ||2||
verses.translation: The sun and the moon dwell in the same home in the sky. You have not obtained this knowledge. ||2||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਰਵੰਤਾ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਇਕ ਮਾਈ ਭੋਗੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
verses.translit: raam rava(n)taa jaaneeaai ik maiee bhog karei ||
verses.translation: One who knows the All-pervading Lord, eats up the one mother - Maya.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੇ ਲਖਣ ਜਾਣੀਅਹਿ ਖਿਮਾ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹੇਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: taa ke lakhan jaane'eeh khimaa dhan sa(n)grahei ||3||
verses.translation: Know that the sign of such a person is that he gathers the wealth of compassion. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹਿਆ ਸੁਣਹਿ ਨ ਖਾਇਆ ਮਾਨਹਿ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਹੀ ਸੇਤੀ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: kahiaa suneh na khaiaa maaneh tin(h)aa hee setee vaasaa ||
verses.translation: The mind lives with those who do not listen, and do not admit what they eat.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਣਵਤਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ਖਿਨੁ ਤੋਲਾ ਖਿਨੁ ਮਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੧॥
verses.translit: pranavat naanak dhaasan dhaasaa khin tolaa khin maasaa ||4||3||11||
verses.translation: Prays Nanak, the slave of the Lord's slave: one instant the mind is huge, and the next instant, it is tiny. ||4||3||11||
Basant Hindol, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਭੁਖ ਗਵਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: saachaa saahu guroo sukhadhaataa har mele bhukh gavaae ||
verses.translation: The Guru is the True Banker, the Giver of peace; He unites the mortal with the Lord, and satisfies his hunger.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa har bhagat dhiraRaae anadhin har gun gaae ||1||
verses.translation: Granting His Grace, He implants devotional worship of the Lord within; and then night and day, we sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਤ ਭੂਲਹਿ ਰੇ ਮਨ ਚੇਤਿ ਹਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: mat bhooleh re man chet haree ||
verses.translation: O my mind, do not forget the Lord; keep Him in your consciousness.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਤ੍ਰੈ ਲੋਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bin gur mukat naahee trai loiee gurmukh paieeaai naam haree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without the Guru, no one is liberated anywhere in the three worlds. The Gurmukh obtains the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਨਹੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਨਹੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: bin bhagatee nahee satigur paieeaai bin bhaagaa nahee bhagat haree ||
verses.translation: Without devotional worship, the True Guru is not obtained. Without good destiny, devotional worship of the Lord is not obtained.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਭਾਗਾ ਸਤਸੰਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਰਮਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bin bhaagaa satasa(n)g na paieeaai karam milai har naam haree ||2||
verses.translation: Without good destiny, the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, is not obtained. By the grace of one's good karma, the Lord's Name is received. ||2||

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਉਪਾਏ ਵੇਖੈ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT gupat upaae vekhai paragaT gurmukh sa(n)t janaa ||
verses.translation: In each and every heart, the Lord is hidden; He creates and watches over all. He reveals Himself in the humble, Saintly Gurmukhs.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਭੀਨੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਲੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har har kareh su har ra(n)g bheene har jal a(n)mirat naam manaa ||3||
verses.translation: Those who chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, are drenched with the Lord's Love. Their minds are drenched with the Ambrosial Water of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਤਖਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇ ਪਰਧਾਨ ਕੀਏ ॥
verses.translit: jin kau takhat milai vaddiaaiee gurmukh se paradhaan ke'ee ||
verses.translation: Those who are blessed with the glory of the Lord's Throne - those Gurmukhs are renowned as supreme.

verses.original: ਪਾਰਸੁ ਭੇਟਿ ਭਏ ਸੇ ਪਾਰਸ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਥੀਏ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੨॥
verses.translit: paaras bheT bhe se paaras naanak har gur sa(n)g the'ee ||4||4||12||
verses.translation: Touching the philosopher's stone, they themselves becomes the philosopher's stone; they become the companions of the Lord, the Guru. ||4||4||12||

verses.translit: basa(n)t mahalaa teejaa ghar pehilaa dhutuke
verses.translation: Basant, Third Mehla, First House, Dho-Thukay:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Throughout the months and the seasons, the Lord is always in bloom.
He rejuvenates all beings and creatures.
What can I say? I am just a worm.

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: teraa kinai na paiaa aadh a(n)t ||1||
verses.translation: No one has found Your beginning or Your end, O Lord. ||1||
Those who serve You, Lord,

verses.original: ਪਰਮ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਆਤਮ ਦੇਵ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: param sukh paaveh aatam dhev ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: obtain the greatest peace; their souls are so divine. ||1||Pause||
If the Lord is merciful, then the mortal is allowed to serve Him.
By Guru's Grace, he remains dead while yet alive.
Night and day, he chants the True Name;
in this way, he crosses over the treacherous world-ocean. ||2||
The Creator created both poison and nectar.

verses.original: ਸੰਸਾਰ ਬਿਰਖ ਕਉ ਦੁਇ ਫਲ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)saar birakh kau dhui fal laae ||
verses.translation: He attached these two fruits to the world-plant.
The Creator Himself is the Doer, the Cause of all.
He feeds all as He pleases. ||3||
O Nanak, when He casts His Glance of Grace,
He Himself bestows His Ambrosial Naam.
Thus, the desire for sin and corruption is ended.
The Lord Himself carries out His Own Will. ||4||1||
Basant, Third Mehla:
Those who are attuned to the True Lord's Name are happy and exalted.
Take pity on me, O God, Merciful to the meek.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਮੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: tis bin avar nahee mai koi ||
verses.translation: Without Him, I have no other at all.
As it pleases His Will, He keeps me. ||1||
The Guru, the Lord, is pleasing to my mind.

verses.original: ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਦਰਸਨ ਦੇਖੇ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਉ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: reh na sakau dharasan dhekhe bin sahaj milau gur mel milaae ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I cannot even survive, without the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. But I shall easily unite with the Guru, if He unites me in His Union. ||1||Pause||
The greedy mind is enticed by greed.
Forgetting the Lord, it regrets and repents in the end.
The separated ones are reunited, when they are inspired to serve the Guru.
They are blessed with the Lord's Name - such is the destiny written on their foreheads. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਉਣ ਪਾਣੀ ਕੀ ਇਹ ਦੇਹ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
verses.translit: paun paanee kee ieh dheh sareeraa ||
verses.translation: This body is built of air and water.
The body is afflicted with the terribly painful illness of egotism.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਦਾਰੂ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh raam naam dhaaroo gun gaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukh has the Medicine: singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name.
Granting His Grace, the Guru has cured the illness. ||3||
The four evils are the four rivers of fire flowing through the body.
It is burning in desire, and burning in egotism.
Those whom the Guru protects and saves are very fortunate.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਉਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
verses.translit: jan naanak ur har a(n)mrit dhaare ||4||2||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak enshrines the Ambrosial Name of the Lord in his heart. ||4||2||
Basant, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਲੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: har seve so har kaa log ||
verses.translation: One who serves the Lord is the Lord's person.

verses.original: ਸਾਚੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: saach sahaj kadhe na hovai sog ||
verses.translation: He dwells in intuitive peace, and never suffers in sorrow.

verses.original: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੁਏ ਨਾਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: manmukh mue naahee har man maeh ||
verses.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are dead; the Lord is not within their minds.

verses.original: ਮਰਿ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਭੀ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mar mar ja(n)meh bhee mar jaeh ||1||
verses.translation: They die and die again and again, and are reincarnated, only to die once more. ||1||

verses.original: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਜੀਵੇ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: se jan jeeve jin har man maeh ||
verses.translation: They alone are alive, whose minds are filled with the Lord.
They contemplate the True Lord, and are absorbed in the True Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: har na seveh te har te dhoor ||
verses.translation: Those who do not serve the Lord are far away from the Lord.
They wander in foreign lands, with dust thrown on their heads.
The Lord Himself enjoins His humble servants to serve Him.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਤਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tin sadhaa sukh hai til na tamai ||2||
verses.translation: They live in peace forever, and have no greed at all. ||2||
When the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, egotism is eradicated.
Then, the mortal is honored in the Court of the True Lord.
He sees the Dear Lord always close at hand, ever-present.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he sees the Lord pervading and permeating all. ||3||
The Lord cherishes all beings and creatures.
By Guru's Grace, contemplate Him forever.

verses.original: ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhar saachai pat siau ghar jai ||
verses.translation: You shall go to your true home in the Lord's Court with honor.
O Nanak, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, you shall be blessed with glorious greatness. ||4||3||
Basant, Third Mehla:
One who worships the Lord within his mind,
sees the One and Only Lord, and no other.
People in duality suffer terrible pain.
The True Guru has shown me the One Lord. ||1||
My God is in bloom, forever in spring.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਗਾਇ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: eih man mauliaa gai gun gobi(n)dh ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: This mind blossoms forth, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||
So consult the Guru, and reflect upon His wisdom;
then, you shall be in love with the True Lord God.
Abandon your self-conceit, and be His loving servant.
Then, the Life of the World shall come to dwell in your mind. ||2||
Worship Him with devotion, and see Him always ever-present, close at hand.
My God is forever permeating and pervading all.

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਕਾ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਭੇਉ ॥
verses.translit: eis bhagatee kaa koiee jaanai bheau ||
verses.translation: Only a rare few know the mystery of this devotional worship.
My God is the Enlightener of all souls. ||3||
The True Guru Himself unites us in His Union.
He Himself links our consciousness to the Lord, the Life of the World.
Thus, our minds and bodies are rejuvenated with intuitive ease.
O Nanak, through the Naam, the Name of the Lord, we remain attuned to the String of His Love. ||4||4||
Basant, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat vachhal har vasai man aai ||
verses.translation: The Lord is the Lover of His devotees; He dwells within their minds,
by Guru's Grace, with intuitive ease.
Through devotional worship, self-conceit is eradicated from within,
and then, one meets the True Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੁਆਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat soheh sadhaa har prabh dhuaar ||
verses.translation: His devotees are forever beauteous at the Door of the Lord God.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai het saachai prem piaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Loving the Guru, they have love and affection for the True Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat kare so jan niramal hoi ||
verses.translation: That humble being who worships the Lord with devotion becomes immaculate and pure.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, egotism is eradicated from within.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: har jeeau aap vasai man aai ||
verses.translation: The Dear Lord Himself comes to dwell within the mind,
and the mortal remains immersed in peace, tranquility and intuitive ease. ||2||
Those who are imbued with Truth, are forever in the bloom of spring.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਰਵਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੁਵਿੰਦ ॥
verses.translit: man tan hariaa rav gun guvi(n)dh ||
verses.translation: Their minds and bodies are rejuvenated, uttering the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.
Without the Lord's Name, the world is dry and parched.
It burns in the fire of desire, over and over again. ||3||

verses.original: ਸੋਈ ਕਰੇ ਜਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: soiee kare j har jeeau bhaavai ||
verses.translation: One who does only that which is pleasing to the Dear Lord

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਰੀਰਿ ਭਾਣੈ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa sukh sareer bhaanai chit laavai ||
verses.translation: - his body is forever at peace, and his consciousness is attached to the Lord's Will.
He serves His God with intuitive ease.
O Nanak, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, comes to abide in his mind. ||4||5||
Basant, Third Mehla:
Attachment to Maya is burnt away by the Word of the Shabad.
The mind and body are rejuvenated by the Love of the True Guru.
The tree bears fruit at the Lord's Door,
in love with the True Bani of the Guru's Word, and the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||
This mind is rejuvenated, with intuitive ease;

verses.original: ਸਚ ਫਲੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sach fal laagai satigur bhai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: loving the True Guru, it bears the fruit of truth. ||1||Pause||
He Himself is near, and He Himself is far away.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਦ ਹਜੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh vekhai sadh hajoor ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, He is seen to be ever-present, close at hand.
The plants have blossomed forth, giving a dense shade.
The Gurmukh blossoms forth, with intuitive ease. ||2||
Night and day, he sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, day and night.
The True Guru drives out sin and doubt from within.
Gazing upon the wonder of God's Creation, I am wonder-struck and amazed.
The Gurmukh obtains the Naam, the Name of the Lord, by His Grace. ||3||
The Creator Himself enjoys all delights.

verses.original: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਪਰੁ ਹੋਗ ॥
verses.translit: jo kichh kare soiee par hog ||
verses.translation: Whatever He does, surely comes to pass.
He is the Great Giver; He has no greed at all.
O Nanak, living the Word of the Shabad, the mortal meets with God. ||4||6||
Basant, Third Mehla:
By perfect destiny, one acts in truth.

verses.original: ਏਕੋ ਚੇਤੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: eko chetai fir jon na aavai ||
verses.translation: Remembering the One Lord, one does not have to enter the cycle of reincarnation.

verses.original: ਸਫਲ ਜਨਮੁ ਇਸੁ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: safal janam is jag meh aaiaa ||
verses.translation: Fruitful is the coming into the world, and the life of one
who remains intuitively absorbed in the True Name. ||1||
The Gurmukh acts, lovingly attuned to the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har naam sevahu vichahu aap gavai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Be dedicated to the Lord's Name, and eradicate self-conceit from within. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਹੈ ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: tis jan kee hai saachee baanee ||
verses.translation: True is the speech of that humble being;

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਗ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh jag maeh samaanee ||
verses.translation: through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, it is spread throughout the world.
Throughout the four ages, his fame and glory spread.
Imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the Lord's humble servant is recognized and renowned. ||2||

verses.original: ਇਕਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eik saachai sabadh rahe liv lai ||
verses.translation: Some remain lovingly attuned to the True Word of the Shabad.
True are those humble beings who love the True Lord.
They meditate on the True Lord, and behold Him near at hand, ever-present.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਪਗ ਪੰਕਜ ਧੂਰਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa kee pag pa(n)kaj dhoor ||3||
verses.translation: They are the dust of the lotus feet of the humble Saints. ||3||
There is only One Creator Lord; there is no other at all.
