Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, comes Union with the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਸਚੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਤਿਨਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: jin sach seviaa tin ras paiaa ||
verses.translation: Whoever serves the True Lord finds joy.
O Nanak, he is intuitively absorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||7||
Basant, Third Mehla:
The Lord's humble servant worships Him, and beholds Him ever-present, near at hand.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਪਗ ਪੰਕਜ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa kee pag pa(n)kaj dhoor ||
verses.translation: He is the dust of the lotus feet of the humble Saints.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਸਦ ਰਹਹਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: har setee sadh raheh liv lai ||
verses.translation: Those who remain lovingly attuned to the Lord forever
are blessed with understanding by the Perfect True Guru. ||1||

verses.original: ਦਾਸਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਈ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhaasaa kaa dhaas viralaa koiee hoi ||
verses.translation: How rare are those who become the slave of the Lord's slaves.
They attain the supreme status. ||1||Pause||
So serve the One Lord, and no other.
Serving Him, eternal peace is obtained.

verses.original: ਨਾ ਓਹੁ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: naa oh marai na aavai jai ||
verses.translation: He does not die; He does not come and go in reincarnation.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਕਿਉ ਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tis bin avar sevee kiau mai ||2||
verses.translation: Why should I serve any other than Him, O my mother? ||2||

verses.original: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਾਚੇ ਜਿਨੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: se jan saache jinee saach pachhaaniaa ||
verses.translation: True are those humble beings who realize the True Lord.
Conquering their self-conceit, they merge intuitively into the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
The Gurmukhs gather in the Naam.
Their minds are immaculate, and their reputations are immaculate. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਤੂ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: jin giaan keeaa tis har too jaan ||
verses.translation: Know the Lord, who gave you spiritual wisdom,
and realize the One God, through the True Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੈ ਤਾਂ ਸੁਧਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: har ras chaakhai taa(n) sudh hoi ||
verses.translation: When the mortal tastes the sublime essence of the Lord, he becomes pure and holy.
O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam - their reputations are true. ||4||8||
Basant, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਕੁਲਾਂ ਕਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਉਧਾਰੁ ॥
verses.translit: naam rate kulaa(n) kaa kareh udhaar ||
verses.translation: Those who are imbued with the Naam, the Name of the Lord - their generations are redeemed and saved.
True is their speech; they love the Naam.
Why have the wandering self-willed manmukhs even come into the world?
Forgetting the Naam, the mortals waste their lives away. ||1||
One who dies while yet alive, truly dies, and embellishes his death.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh saach ur dhaarai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he enshrines the True Lord within his heart. ||1||Pause||
Truth is the food of the Gurmukh; his body is sanctified and pure.
His mind is immaculate; he is forever the ocean of virtue.
He is not forced to come and go in the cycle of birth and death.
By Guru's Grace, he merges in the True Lord. ||2||
Serving the True Lord, one realizes Truth.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh har dhar neesaanai ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he goes to the Lord's Court with his banners flying proudly.
In the Court of the True Lord, he obtains true glory.
He comes to dwell in the home of his own inner being. ||3||
He cannot be fooled; He is the Truest of the True.

verses.original: ਹੋਰਿ ਸਭਿ ਭੂਲਹਿ ਦੂਜੈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: hor sabh bhooleh dhoojai pat khoi ||
verses.translation: All others are deluded; in duality, they lose their honor.
So serve the True Lord, through the True Bani of His Word.
O Nanak, through the Naam, merge in the True Lord. ||4||9||
Basant, Third Mehla:
Without the grace of good karma, all are deluded by doubt.
In attachment to Maya, they suffer in terrible pain.
The blind, self-willed manmukhs find no place of rest.

verses.original: ਬਿਸਟਾ ਕਾ ਕੀੜਾ ਬਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bisaTaa kaa keeRaa bisaTaa maeh samaiee ||1||
verses.translation: They are like maggots in manure, rotting away in manure. ||1||
That humble being who obeys the Hukam of the Lord's Command is accepted.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh naam neesaan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he is blessed with the insignia and the banner of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: saach rate jin(h)aa dhur likh paiaa ||
verses.translation: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny are imbued with the Naam.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam sadhaa man bhaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Name of the Lord is forever pleasing to their minds.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: satigur kee baanee sadhaa sukh hoi ||
verses.translation: Through the Bani, the Word of the True Guru, eternal peace is found.
Through it, one's light merges into the Light. ||2||
Only the Naam, the Name of the Lord, can save the world.
By Guru's Grace, one comes to love the Naam.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੈ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: bin naamai mukat kinai na paiee ||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, no one obtains liberation.

verses.original: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: poore gur te naam palai paiee ||3||
verses.translation: Through the Perfect Guru, the Naam is obtained. ||3||
He alone understands, whom the Lord Himself causes to understand.
Serving the True Guru, the Naam is implanted within.

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਇਕੁ ਜਾਤਾ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: jin ik jaataa se jan paravaan ||
verses.translation: Those humble beings who know the One Lord are approved and accepted.
O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, they go to the Lord's Court with His banner and insignia. ||4||10||
Basant, Third Mehla:
Granting His Grace, the Lord leads the mortal to meet the True Guru.
The Lord Himself comes to abide in his mind.
His intellect becomes steady and stable, and his mind is strengthened forever.
He sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord, the Ocean of Virtue. ||1||
Those who forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord - those mortals die eating poison.

verses.original: ਬ੍ਰਿਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: birathaa janam fir aaveh jai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Their lives are wasted uselessly, and they continue coming and going in reincarnation. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਭੇਖ ਕਰਹਿ ਮਨਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bahu bhekh kareh man saa(n)t na hoi ||
verses.translation: They wear all sorts of religious robes, but their minds are not at peace.
In great egotism, they lose their honor.
But those who realize the Word of the Shabad, are blessed by great good fortune.
They bring their distractible minds back home. ||2||
Within the home of the inner self is the inaccessible and infinite substance.
Those who find it, by following the Guru's Teachings, contemplate the Shabad.

verses.original: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: naam nav nidh paiee ghar hee maeh ||
verses.translation: Those who obtain the nine treasures of the Naam within the home of their own inner being,
are forever dyed in the color of the Lord's Love; they are absorbed in the Truth. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਕਰੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: aap kare kichh karan na jai ||
verses.translation: God Himself does everything; no one can do anything at all by himself.
When God so wills, He merges the mortal into Himself.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਨੇੜੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: tis te neRai naahee ko dhoor ||
verses.translation: All are near Him; no one is far away from Him.
O Nanak, the Naam is permeating and pervading everywhere. ||4||11||
Basant, Third Mehla:
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, remember the Lord with love,
and you shall remain satisfied by the sublime essence of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਕੋਟ ਕੋਟੰਤਰ ਕੇ ਪਾਪ ਜਲਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: koT koTa(n)tar ke paap jal jaeh ||
verses.translation: The sins of millions upon millions of lifetimes shall be burnt away.
Remaining dead while yet alive, you shall be absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਦਾਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: har kee dhaat har jeeau jaanai ||
verses.translation: The Dear Lord Himself knows His own bountiful blessings.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh ih man mauliaa har gunadhaataa naam vakhaanai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: This mind blossoms forth in the Guru's Shabad, chanting the Name of the Lord, the Giver of virtue. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਭਗਵੈ ਵੇਸਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bhagavai ves bhram mukat na hoi ||
verses.translation: No one is liberated by wandering around in saffron-colored robes.

verses.original: ਬਹੁ ਸੰਜਮਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: bahu sa(n)jam saa(n)t na paavai koi ||
verses.translation: Tranquility is not found by strict self-discipline.
But by following the Guru's Teachings, one is blessed to receive the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
By great good fortune, one finds the Lord. ||2||
In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, glorious greatness comes through the Lord's Name.
Through the Perfect Guru, it is obtained.
Those who are imbued with the Naam find everlasting peace.
But without the Naam, mortals burn in egotism. ||3||
By great good furtune, some contemplate the Lord's Name.
Through the Lord's Name, all sorrows are eradicated.
He dwells within the heart, and pervades the external universe as well.
O Nanak, the Creator Lord knows all. ||4||12||
Basant, Third Mehla, Ek-Thukay:
I am just a worm, created by You, O Lord.
If you bless me, then I chant Your Primal Mantra. ||1||
I chant and reflect on His Glorious Virtues, O my mother.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਲਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har jap har kai lagau pai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meditating on the Lord, I fall at the Lord's Feet. ||1||Pause||
By Guru's Grace, I am addicted to the favor of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
Why waste your life in hatred, vengeance and conflict? ||2||
When the Guru granted His Grace, my egotism was eradicated,
and then, I obtained the Lord's Name with intuitive ease. ||3||
The most lofty and exalted occupation is to contemplate the Word of the Shabad.
Nanak chants the True Name. ||4||1||13||
Basant, Third Mehla:
The season of spring has come, and all the plants have blossomed forth.
This mind blossoms forth, in association with the True Guru. ||1||
So meditate on the True Lord, O my foolish mind.

verses.original: ਤਾਂ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: taa(n) sukh paavahu mere manaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Only then shall you find peace, O my mind. ||1||Pause||
This mind blossoms forth, and I am in ecstasy.
I am blessed with the Ambrosial Fruit of the Naam, the Name of the Lord of the Universe. ||2||
Everyone speaks and says that the Lord is the One and Only.
By understanding the Hukam of His Command, we come to know the One Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਹੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: kahat naanak haumai kahai na koi ||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, no one can describe the Lord by speaking through ego.

verses.original: ਆਖਣੁ ਵੇਖਣੁ ਸਭੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੪॥
verses.translit: aakhan vekhan sabh saahib te hoi ||4||2||14||
verses.translation: All speech and insight comes from our Lord and Master. ||4||2||14||
Basant, Third Mehla:
All the ages were created by You, O Lord.
Meeting with the True Guru, one's intellect is awakened. ||1||
O Dear Lord, please blend me with Yourself;

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur kai sabadh sach naam samai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: let me merge in the True Name, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||Pause||
When the mind is in spring, all people are rejuvenated.

verses.original: ਫਲਹਿ ਫੁਲੀਅਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: faleh fule'eeh raam naam sukh hoi ||2||
verses.translation: Blossoming forth and flowering through the Lord's Name, peace is obtained. ||2||
Contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one is in spring forever,
with the Lord's Name enshrined in the heart. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਨਿ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: man basa(n)t tan man hariaa hoi ||
verses.translation: When the mind is in spring, the body and mind are rejuvenated.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੫॥
verses.translit: naanak ih tan birakh raam naam fal paae soi ||4||3||15||
verses.translation: O Nanak, this body is the tree which bears the fruit of the Lord's Name. ||4||3||15||
Basant, Third Mehla:

verses.original: ਤਿਨੑ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: tin(h) basa(n)t jo har gun gai ||
verses.translation: They alone are in the spring season, who sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
They come to worship the Lord with devotion, through their perfect destiny. ||1||

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਬਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਲਗੈ ਨ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: eis man kau basa(n)t kee lagai na soi ||
verses.translation: This mind is not even touched by spring.

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਜਲਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਦੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: eih man jaliaa dhoojai dhoi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: This mind is burnt by duality and double-mindedness. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਧੰਧੈ ਬਾਂਧਾ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eih man dha(n)dhai baa(n)dhaa karam kamai ||
verses.translation: This mind is entangled in worldly affairs, creating more and more karma.
Enchanted by Maya, it cries out in suffering forever. ||2||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਛੂਟੈ ਜਾਂ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟੈ ॥
verses.translit: eih man chhooTai jaa(n) satigur bheTai ||
verses.translation: This mind is released, only when it meets with the True Guru.

verses.original: ਜਮਕਾਲ ਕੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਨ ਫੇਟੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jamakaal kee fir aavai na feTai ||3||
verses.translation: Then, it does not suffer beatings by the Messenger of Death. ||3||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਛੂਟਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਲੀਆ ਛਡਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: eih man chhooTaa gur leeaa chhaddai ||
verses.translation: This mind is released, when the Guru emancipates it.
O Nanak, attachment to Maya is burnt away through the Word of the Shabad. ||4||4||16||
Basant, Third Mehla:
Spring has come, and all the plants are flowering.

verses.original: ਏਹਿ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਫੂਲਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: eh jeea ja(n)t fooleh har chit lai ||1||
verses.translation: These beings and creatures blossom forth when they focus their consciousness on the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: ein bidh ih man hariaa hoi ||
verses.translation: In this way, this mind is rejuvenated.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਕਢੈ ਧੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har har naam japai dhin raatee gurmukh haumai kaddai dhoi ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, day and night, egotism is removed and washed away from the Gurmukhs. ||1||Pause||
The True Guru speaks the Bani of the Word, and the Shabad, the Word of God.
This world blossoms forth in its greenery, through the love of the True Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਫਲ ਫੂਲ ਲਾਗੇ ਜਾਂ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਏ ॥
verses.translit: fal fool laage jaa(n) aape laae ||
verses.translation: The mortal blossoms forth in flower and fruit, when the Lord Himself so wills.
He is attached to the Lord, the Primal Root of all, when he finds the True Guru. ||3||
The Lord Himself is the season of spring; the whole world is His Garden.
O Nanak, this most unique devotional worship comes only by perfect destiny. ||4||5||17||

verses.translit: basa(n)t hi(n)ddol mahalaa teejaa ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Basant Hindol, Third Mehla, Second House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: gur kee baanee viTahu vaariaa bhaiee gur sabadh viTahu bal jaiee ||
verses.translation: I am a sacrifice to the Word of the Guru's Bani, O Siblings of Destiny. I am devoted and dedicated to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

verses.original: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਦ ਅਪਣਾ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur saalaahee sadh apanaa bhaiee gur charanee chit laiee ||1||
verses.translation: I praise my Guru forever, O Siblings of Destiny. I focus my consciousness on the Guru's Feet. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: mere man raam naam chit lai ||
verses.translation: O my mind, focus your consciousness on the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਇਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man tan teraa hariaa hovai ik har naamaa fal pai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Your mind and body shall blossom forth in lush greenery, and you shall obtain the fruit of the Name of the One Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਸੇ ਉਬਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਆਇ ॥
verses.translit: gur raakhe se ubare bhaiee har ras a(n)mrit peeaai ||
verses.translation: Those who are protected by the Guru are saved, O Siblings of Destiny. They drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Lord's sublime essence.

verses.original: ਵਿਚਹੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਉਠਿ ਗਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਖੁ ਵੁਠਾ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: vichahu haumai dhukh uTh giaa bhaiee sukh vuThaa man aai ||2||
verses.translation: The pain of egotism within is eradicated and banished, O Siblings of Destiny, and peace comes to dwell in their minds. ||2||

verses.original: ਧੁਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਜਿਨੑਾ ਨੋ ਬਖਸਿਓਨੁ ਭਾਈ ਸਬਦੇ ਲਇਅਨੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: dhur aape jin(h)aa no bakhasion bhaiee sabadhe lian milai ||
verses.translation: Those whom the Primal Lord Himself forgives, O Siblings of Destiny, are united with the Word of the Shabad.

verses.original: ਧੂੜਿ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਕੀ ਅਘੁਲੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: dhooR tin(h)aa kee aghuleeaai bhaiee satasa(n)gat mel milai ||3||
verses.translation: The dust of their feet brings emancipation; in the company of Sadh Sangat, the True Congregation, we are united with the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਏ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਭਾਈ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿਆ ਕੀਆ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: aap karaae kare aap bhaiee jin hariaa keeaa sabh koi ||
verses.translation: He Himself does, and causes all to be done, O Siblings of Destiny; He makes everything blossom forth in green abundance.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਸਦ ਵਸੈ ਭਾਈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੮॥੧੨॥੧੮॥੩੦॥
verses.translit: naanak man tan sukh sadh vasai bhaiee sabadh milaavaa hoi ||4||1||18||12||18||30||
verses.translation: O Nanak, peace fills their minds and bodies forever, O Siblings of Destiny; they are united with the Shabad. ||4||1||18||12||18||30||

verses.original: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਇਕ ਤੁਕੇ
verses.translit: raag basa(n)t mahalaa chauthhaa ghar pehilaa ik tuke
verses.translation: Raag Basant, Fourth Mehla, First House, Ik-Thukay:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Just as the light of the sun's rays spread out,

verses.original: ਤਿਉ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਮਈਆ ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tiau ghaT ghaT ramieeaa ot pot ||1||
verses.translation: the Lord permeates each and every heart, through and through. ||1||
The One Lord is permeating and pervading all places.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਮਿਲੀਐ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadhee mileeaai meree mai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, we merge with Him, O my mother. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT a(n)tar eko har soi ||
verses.translation: The One Lord is deep within each and every heart.
Meeting with the Guru, the One Lord becomes manifest, radiating forth. ||2||
The One and Only Lord is present and prevailing everywhere.
The greedy, faithless cynic thinks that God is far away. ||3||
The One and Only Lord permeates and pervades the world.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਏਕੋੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak har ekuo kare su hoi ||4||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, whatever the One Lord does comes to pass. ||4||1||
Basant, Fourth Mehla:
Day and night, the two calls are sent out.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਰਖਿ ਲਏ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: man har simarahu a(n)t sadhaa rakh le ||1||
verses.translation: O mortal, meditate in remembrance on the Lord, who protects you forever, and saves you in the end. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿ ਸਦਾ ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: har har chet sadhaa man mere ||
verses.translation: Concentrate forever on the Lord, Har, Har, O my mind.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਆਲਸੁ ਦੂਖ ਭੰਜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sabh aalas dhookh bha(n)j prabh paiaa gurmat gaavahu gun prabh kere ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: God the Destroyer of all depression and suffering is found, through the Guru's Teachings, singing the Glorious Praises of God. ||1||Pause||
The self-willed manmukhs die of their egotism, over and over again.

verses.original: ਕਾਲਿ ਦੈਤਿ ਸੰਘਾਰੇ ਜਮ ਪੁਰਿ ਗਏ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kaal dhait sa(n)ghaare jam pur ge ||2||
verses.translation: They are destroyed by Death's demons, and they must go to the City of Death. ||2||

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh har har har liv laage ||
verses.translation: The Gurmukhs are lovingly attached to the Lord, Har, Har, Har.
Their pains of both birth and death are taken away. ||3||

verses.original: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: bhagat janaa kau har kirapaa dhaaree ||
verses.translation: The Lord showers His Mercy on His humble devotees.
Guru Nanak has shown mercy to me; I have met the Lord, the Lord of the forest. ||4||2||

verses.translit: basa(n)t hi(n)ddol mahalaa chauthhaa ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Basant Hindol, Fourth Mehla, Second House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨ ਕੋਠੜੀ ਗੜ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਏਕ ਲੁਕਾਨੀ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam ratan koThaRee gaR ma(n)dhar ek lukaanee ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is a jewel, hidden in a chamber of the palace of the body-fortress.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਖੋਜੀਐ ਮਿਲਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: satigur milai ta khojeeaai mil jotee jot samaanee ||1||
verses.translation: When one meets the True Guru, then he searches and finds it, and his light merges with the Divine Light. ||1||
O Lord, lead me to meet with the Holy Person, the Guru.

verses.original: ਦੇਖਤ ਦਰਸੁ ਪਾਪ ਸਭਿ ਨਾਸਹਿ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਪਰਮ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: dhekhat dharas paap sabh naaseh pavitr param padh pai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, all my sins are erased, and I obtain the supreme, sublime, sanctified status. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਪੰਚ ਚੋਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਨਗਰੀਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਹਿਰਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)ch chor mil laage nagareeaa raam naam dhan hiriaa ||
verses.translation: The five thieves join together and plunder the body-village, stealing the wealth of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਖੋਜ ਪਰੇ ਤਬ ਪਕਰੇ ਧਨੁ ਸਾਬਤੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਉਬਰਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gurmat khoj pare tab pakare dhan saabat raas ubariaa ||2||
verses.translation: But through the Guru's Teachings, they are traced and caught, and this wealth is recovered intact. ||2||

verses.original: ਪਾਖੰਡ ਭਰਮ ਉਪਾਵ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: paakha(n)dd bharam upaav kar thaake ridh a(n)tar maiaa maiaa ||
verses.translation: Practicing hypocrisy and superstition, people have grown weary of the effort, but still, deep within their hearts, they yearn for Maya, Maya.

verses.original: ਸਾਧੂ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਪੁਰਖਪਤਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: saadhoo purakh purakhapat paiaa agiaan a(n)dher gavaiaa ||3||
verses.translation: By the Grace of the Holy Person, I have met with the Lord, the Primal Being, and the darkness of ignorance is dispelled. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਗੰਨਾਥ ਜਗਦੀਸ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਾਧੁ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaga(n)naath jagadhees gusaiee kar kirapaa saadh milaavai ||
verses.translation: The Lord, the Lord of the Earth, the Lord of the Universe, in His Mercy, leads me to meet the Holy Person, the Guru.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੪॥੧॥੩॥
verses.translit: naanak saa(n)t hovai man a(n)tar nit hiradhai har gun gaavai ||4||1||3||
verses.translation: O Nanak, peace then comes to abide deep within my mind, and I constantly sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord within my heart. ||4||1||3||
Basant, Fourth Mehla, Hindol:

verses.original: ਤੁਮੑ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ ਵਡ ਅਗਮ ਗੁਸਾਈ ਹਮ ਕੀਰੇ ਕਿਰਮ ਤੁਮਨਛੇ ॥
verses.translit: tum(h) vadd purakh vadd agam gusaiee ham keere kiram tumanachhe ||
verses.translation: You are the Great Supreme Being, the Vast and Inaccessible Lord of the World; I am a mere insect, a worm created by You.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣ ਹਮ ਬਨਛੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har dheen dhiaal karahu prabh kirapaa gur satigur charan ham banachhe ||1||
verses.translation: O Lord, Merciful to the meek, please grant Your Grace; O God, I long for the feet of the Guru, the True Guru. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜੀਉ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਕਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਛੇ ॥
verses.translit: gobi(n)dh jeeau satasa(n)gat mel kar kirapachhe ||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord of the Universe, please be merciful and unite me with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਮਲੁ ਭਰਿਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਨਛੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: janam janam ke kilavikh mal bhariaa mil sa(n)gat kar prabh hanachhe ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I was overflowing with the filthy sins of countless past lives. But joining the Sangat, God made me pure again. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੁਮੑਰਾ ਜਨੁ ਜਾਤਿ ਅਵਿਜਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵੀਛੇ ॥
verses.translit: tum(h)raa jan jaat avijaataa har japio patit paveechhe ||
verses.translation: Your humble servant, whether of high class or low class, O Lord - by meditating on You, the sinner becomes pure.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਓ ਸਗਲ ਭਵਨ ਤੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਿਨਛੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: har keeo sagal bhavan te uoopar har sobhaa har prabh dhinachhe ||2||
verses.translation: The Lord exalts and elevates him above the whole world, and the Lord God blesses him with the Lord's Glory. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਾਤਿ ਅਜਾਤਿ ਕੋਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਿਆਵੈ ਸਭਿ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਾਨਸ ਤਿਨਛੇ ॥
verses.translit: jaat ajaat koiee prabh dhiaavai sabh poore maanas tinachhe ||
verses.translation: Anyone who meditates on God, whether of high class or low class, will have all of his hopes and desires fulfilled.

verses.original: ਸੇ ਧੰਨਿ ਵਡੇ ਵਡ ਪੂਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਛੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: se dha(n)n vadde vadd poore har jan jin(h) har dhaario har urachhe ||3||
verses.translation: Those humble servants of the Lord who enshrine the Lord within their hearts, are blessed, and are made great and totally perfect. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਮ ਢੀਂਢੇ ਢੀਮ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਛੇ ॥
verses.translit: ham ddee(n)dde ddeem bahut at bhaaree har dhaar kirapaa prabh milachhe ||
verses.translation: I am so low, I am an utterly heavy lump of clay. Please shower Your Mercy on me, Lord, and unite me with Yourself.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਤੂਠੇ ਹਮ ਕੀਏ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵੀਛੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੪॥
verses.translit: jan naanak gur paiaa har tooThe ham ke'ee patit paveechhe ||4||2||4||
verses.translation: The Lord, in His Mercy, has led servant Nanak to find the Guru; I was a sinner, and now I have become immaculate and pure. ||||4||2||4||
Basant Hindol, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੇਰਾ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰਸਿ ਗੀਧੇ ॥
verses.translit: meraa ik khin manooaa reh na sakai nit har har naam ras geedhe ||
verses.translation: My mind cannot survive, even for an instant, without the Lord. I drink in continually the sublime essence of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਰਸਕਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਥਨਿ ਮਾਤਾ ਥਨਿ ਕਾਢੇ ਬਿਲਲ ਬਿਲੀਧੇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jiau baarik rasak pario than maataa than kaadde bilal bileedhe ||1||
verses.translation: It is like a baby, who joyfully sucks at his mother's breast; when the breast is withdrawn, he weeps and cries. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜੀਉ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਬੀਧੇ ॥
verses.translit: gobi(n)dh jeeau mere man tan naam har beedhe ||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord of the Universe, my mind and body are pierced through by the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰ ਹਰਿ ਸੀਧੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: vaddai bhaag gur satigur paiaa vich kaiaa nagar har seedhe ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By great good fortune, I have found the Guru, the True Guru, and in the body-village, the Lord has revealed Himself. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਨ ਕੇ ਸਾਸ ਸਾਸ ਹੈ ਜੇਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਰਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਹਰਿ ਬੀਧੇ ॥
verses.translit: jan ke saas saas hai jete har bireh prabhoo har beedhe ||
verses.translation: Each and every breath of the Lord's humble servant is pierced through with love of the Lord God.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਕਮਲ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਅਤਿ ਭਾਰੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਦੇਖੇ ਸੁਕਲੀਧੇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jiau jal kamal preet at bhaaree bin jal dhekhe sukaleedhe ||2||
verses.translation: As the lotus is totally in love with the water and withers away without seeing the water, so am I in love with the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਨ ਜਪਿਓ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਨਰਹਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਧੇ ॥
verses.translit: jan japio naam nira(n)jan narahar upadhes guroo har preedhe ||
verses.translation: The Lord's humble servant chants the Immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord; through the Guru's Teachings, the Lord reveals Himself.

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਲੁ ਨਿਕਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਲਿ ਨੀਧੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: janam janam kee haumai mal nikasee har a(n)mirat har jal needhe ||3||
verses.translation: The filth of egotism which stained me for countless lifetimes has been washed away, by the Ambrosial Water of the Ocean of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਮਰੇ ਕਰਮ ਨ ਬਿਚਰਹੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੁਮੑ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਹੁ ਅਪਨੀਧੇ ॥
verses.translit: hamare karam na bicharahu Thaakur tum(h) paij rakhahu apaneedhe ||
verses.translation: Please, do not take my karma into account, O my Lord and Master; please save the honor of Your slave.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁਣਿ ਬਿਨਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਵੀਧੇ ॥੪॥੩॥੫॥
verses.translit: har bhaavai sun binau benatee jan naanak saran paveedhe ||4||3||5||
verses.translation: O Lord, if it pleases You, hear my prayer; servant Nanak seeks Your Sanctuary. ||4||3||5||
Basant Hindol, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਬਹੁ ਧਾਵੈ ਤਿਲੁ ਘਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਵਾਸਾ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: man khin khin bharam bharam bahu dhaavai til ghar nahee vaasaa paieeaai ||
verses.translation: Each and every moment, my mind roams and rambles, and runs all over the place. It does not stay in its own home, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਿ ਅੰਕਸੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਸਿਰਿ ਧਾਰਿਓ ਘਰਿ ਮੰਦਰਿ ਆਣਿ ਵਸਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: gur a(n)kas sabadh dhaaroo sir dhaario ghar ma(n)dhar aan vasaieeaai ||1||
verses.translation: But when the bridle of the Shabad, the Word of God, is placed over its head, it returns to dwell in its own home. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜੀਉ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: gobi(n)dh jeeau satasa(n)gat mel har dhiaaieeaai ||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord of the Universe, lead me to join the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, so that I may meditate on You, Lord.

verses.original: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਇਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਗਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: haumai rog giaa sukh paiaa har sahaj samaadh lagaieeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am cured of the disease of egotism, and I have found peace; I have intuitively entered into the state of Samaadhi. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਰਤਨ ਲਾਲ ਬਹੁ ਮਾਣਕ ਲਾਦੇ ਮਨੁ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਆ ਲਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: ghar ratan laal bahu maanak laadhe man bhramiaa leh na sakaieeaai ||
verses.translation: This house is loaded with countless gems, jewels, rubies and emeralds, but the wandering mind cannot find them.

verses.original: ਜਿਉ ਓਡਾ ਕੂਪੁ ਗੁਹਜ ਖਿਨ ਕਾਢੈ ਤਿਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਲਹਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jiau oddaa koop guhaj khin kaaddai tiau satigur vasat lahaieeaai ||2||
verses.translation: As the water-diviner finds the hidden water, and the well is then dug in an instant, so do we find the object of the Name through the True Guru. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਿਨ ਐਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਧੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਨਰ ਜੀਵਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: jin aaisaa satigur saadh na paiaa te dhirag dhirag nar jeevaieeaai ||
verses.translation: Those who do not find such a Holy True Guru - cursed, cursed are the lives of those people.

verses.original: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪੁੰਨਿ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਕਉਡੀ ਬਦਲੈ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: janam padhaarath pu(n)n fal paiaa kauddee badhalai jaieeaai ||3||
verses.translation: The treasure of this human life is obtained when one's virtues bear fruit, but it is lost in exchange for a mere shell. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨ ਹਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲਾਈਐ ॥
verses.translit: madhusoodhan har dhaar prabh kirapaa kar kirapaa guroo milaieeaai ||
verses.translation: O Lord God, please be merciful to me; be merciful, and lead me to meet the Guru.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਰਬਾਣ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੪॥੬॥
verses.translit: jan naanak nirabaan padh paiaa mil saadhoo har gun gaieeaai ||4||4||6||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak has attained the state of Nirvaanaa; meeting with the Holy people, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||4||6||
Basant Hindol, Fourth Mehla:

verses.original: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੁ ਭਇਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਦੇਹ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਸੁੰਞੀ ਸੁੰਞੁ ॥
verses.translit: aavan jaan bhiaa dhukh bikhiaa dheh manmukh su(n)n(j)ee su(n)n(j) ||
verses.translation: Coming and going, he suffers the pains of vice and corruption; the body of the self-willed manmukh is desolate and vacant.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਚੇਤਿਆ ਜਮਿ ਪਕਰੇ ਕਾਲਿ ਸਲੁੰਞੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: raam naam khin pal nahee chetiaa jam pakare kaal salu(n)n(j) ||1||
verses.translation: He does not dwell on the Lord's Name, even for an instant, and so the Messenger of Death seizes him by his hair. ||1||

verses.original: ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜੀਉ ਬਿਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਮਤਾ ਮੁੰਞੁ ॥
verses.translit: gobi(n)dh jeeau bikh haumai mamataa mu(n)n(j) ||
verses.translation: O Dear Lord of the Universe, please rid me of the poison of egotism and attachment.

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਭੁੰਞੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat gur kee har piaaree mil sa(n)gat har ras bhu(n)n(j) ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Sat Sangat, Guru's True Congregation is so dear to the Lord. So join the Sangat, and taste the sublime essence of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਪੰਞੁ ॥
verses.translit: satasa(n)gat saadh dhiaa kar melahu saranaagat saadhoo pa(n)n(j) ||
verses.translation: Please be kind to me, and unite me with the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation of the Holy; I seek the Sanctuary of the Holy.

verses.original: ਹਮ ਡੁਬਦੇ ਪਾਥਰ ਕਾਢਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮੑ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਞੁ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ham ddubadhe paathar kaadd leh prabh tum(h) dheen dhiaal dhukh bha(n)n(j) ||2||
verses.translation: I am a heavy stone, sinking down - please lift me up and pull me out! O God, Merciful to the meek, You are the Destroyer of sorrow. ||2||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਲੰਞੁ ॥
verses.translit: har usatat dhaarahu ridh a(n)tar suaamee satasa(n)gat mil budh la(n)n(j) ||
verses.translation: I enshrine the Praises of my Lord and Master within my heart; joining the Sat Sangat, my intellect is enlightened.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਹਮ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਗਾਨੀ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਘੁਮਿ ਵੰਞੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har naamai ham preet lagaanee ham har viTahu ghum va(n)n(j) ||3||
verses.translation: I have fallen in love with the Lord's Name; I am a sacrifice to the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਜਨ ਕੇ ਪੂਰਿ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਲੰਞੁ ॥
verses.translit: jan ke poor manorath har prabh har naam dhevahu har la(n)n(j) ||
verses.translation: O Lord God, please fulfill the desires of Your humble servant; please bless me with Your Name, O Lord.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਹੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਦੀਓ ਹਰਿ ਭੰਞੁ ॥੪॥੫॥੭॥੧੨॥੧੮॥੭॥੩੭॥
verses.translit: jan naanak man tan anadh bhiaa hai gur ma(n)tr dheeo har bha(n)n(j) ||4||5||7||12||18||7||37||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak's mind and body are filled with ecstasy; the Guru has blessed him with the Mantra of the Lord's Name. ||4||5||7||12||18||7||37||

verses.translit: basa(n)t mahalaa panjavaa ghar pehilaa dhutuke
verses.translation: Basant, Fifth Mehla, First House, Du-Thukay:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
I serve the Guru, and humbly bow to Him.
Today is a day of celebration for me.
Today I am in supreme bliss.
My anxiety is dispelled, and I have met the Lord of the Universe. ||1||
Today, it is springtime in my household.

verses.original: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮੑ ਬੇਅੰਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gun gaae prabh tum(h) bea(n)t ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I sing Your Glorious Praises, O Infinite Lord God. ||1||Pause||
Today, I am celebrating the festival of Phalgun.
Joining with God's companions, I have begun to play.
I celebrate the festival of Holi by serving the Saints.
I am imbued with the deep crimson color of the Lord's Divine Love. ||2||
My mind and body have blossomed forth, in utter, incomparable beauty.
They do not dry out in either sunshine or shade;
they flourish in all seasons.
It is always springtime, when I meet with the Divine Guru. ||3||
The wish-fulfilling Elysian Tree has sprouted and grown.
It bears flowers and fruits, jewels of all sorts.
I am satisfied and fulfilled, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੪॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak har har har dhiaai ||4||1||
verses.translation: Servant Nanak meditates on the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||4||1||
Basant, Fifth Mehla:
The shopkeeper deals in merchandise for profit.
The gambler's consciousness is focused on gambling.
The opium addict lives by consuming opium.

verses.original: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tiau har jan jeevai har dhiaai ||1||
verses.translation: In the same way, the humble servant of the Lord lives by meditating on the Lord. ||1||
Everyone is absorbed in his own pleasures.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jit prabh laiaa tit tit lagai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He is attached to whatever God attaches him to. ||1||Pause||
When the clouds and the rain come, the peacocks dance.
Seeing the moon, the lotus blossoms.
When the mother sees her infant, she is happy.

verses.original: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਜਪਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tiau har jan jeeveh jap gobi(n)dh ||2||
verses.translation: In the same way, the humble servant of the Lord lives by meditating on the Lord of the Universe. ||2||
The tiger always wants to eat meat.
Gazing upon the battlefield, the warrior's mind is exalted.
The miser is totally in love with his wealth.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: har jan kau har har aadhaar ||3||
verses.translation: The humble servant of the Lord leans on the Support of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||
All love is contained in the Love of the One Lord.

verses.original: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਸੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sarab sukhaa sukh har kai nai ||
verses.translation: All comforts are contained in the Comfort of the Lord's Name.
He alone receives this treasure,
O Nanak, unto whom the Guru gives His gift. ||4||2||
Basant, Fifth Mehla:
He alone experiences this springtime of the soul, unto whom God grants His Grace.
He alone experiences this springtime of the soul, unto whom the Guru is merciful.

verses.original: ਮੰਗਲੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਏਕੁ ਕਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: ma(n)gal tis kai jis ek kaam ||
verses.translation: He alone is joyful, who works for the One Lord.

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tis sadh basa(n)t jis ridhai naam ||1||
verses.translation: He alone experiences this eternal springtime of the soul, within whose heart the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abides. ||1||
This spring comes only to those homes,

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਧੁਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai keeratan har dhunee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: in which the melody of the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises resounds. ||1||Pause||
O mortal, let your love for the Supreme Lord God blossom forth.
Practice spiritual wisdom, and consult the humble servants of the Lord.
He alone is an ascetic, who joins the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
He alone dwells in deep, continual meditation, who loves his Guru. ||2||
He alone is fearless, who has the Fear of God.
He alone is peaceful, whose doubts are dispelled.
He alone is a hermit, who heart is steady and stable.
He alone is steady and unmoving, who has found the true place. ||3||
He seeks the One Lord, and loves the One Lord.
He loves to gaze upon the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.
He intuitively enjoys the Love of the Lord.
Slave Nanak is a sacrifice to that humble being. ||4||3||
Basant, Fifth Mehla:
You gave us our soul, breath of life and body.
I am a fool, but You have made me beautiful, enshrining Your Light within me.
We are all beggars, O God; You are merciful to us.
Chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, we are uplifted and exalted. ||1||
O my Beloved, only You have the potency to act,

verses.original: ਹਉ ਪਾਵਉ ਤੁਮ ਤੇ ਸਗਲ ਥੋਕ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: hau paavau tum te sagal thok ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: and cause all to be done. ||1||Pause||
Chanting the Naam, the mortal is saved.
Chanting the Naam, sublime peace and poise are found.
Chanting the Naam, honor and glory are received.
Chanting the Naam, no obstacles shall block your way. ||2||
For this reason, you have been blessed with this body, so difficult to obtain.
O my Dear God, please bless me to speak the Naam.
This tranquil peace is found in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਰਿਦੈ ਜਪੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sadhaa ridhai japee prabh tero naam ||3||
verses.translation: May I always chant and meditate within my heart on Your Name, O God. ||3||
Other than You, there is no one at all.

verses.original: ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਖੇਲੁ ਤੁਝ ਮਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: sabh tero khel tujh meh samaeh ||
verses.translation: Everything is Your play; it all merges again into You.
As it pleases Your Will, save me, Lord.
O Nanak, peace is obtained by meeting with the Perfect Guru. ||4||4||
Basant, Fifth Mehla:
My Beloved God, my King is with me.
Gazing upon Him, I live, O my mother.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kai simaran dhukh na hoi ||
verses.translation: Remembering Him in meditation, there is no pain or suffering.
Please, take pity on me, and lead me on to meet Him. ||1||
My Beloved is the Support of my breath of life and mind.

verses.original: ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਸਭੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਧਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jeeau praan sabh tero dhan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: This soul, breath of life, and wealth are all Yours, O Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਖੋਜਹਿ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਦੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kau khojeh sur nar dhev ||
verses.translation: He is sought by the angels, mortals and divine beings.

verses.original: ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਖ ਨ ਲਹਹਿ ਭੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: mun jan sekh na laheh bhev ||
verses.translation: The silent sages, the humble, and the religious teachers do not understand His mystery.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kee gat mit kahee na jai ||
verses.translation: His state and extent cannot be described.

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT ghaT ghaT rahiaa samai ||2||
verses.translation: In each and every home of each and every heart, He is permeating and pervading. ||2||
His devotees are totally in bliss.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਭਗਤ ਕਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਖੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa ke bhagat kau naahee khai ||
verses.translation: His devotees cannot be destroyed.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਭਗਤ ਕਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਭੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa ke bhagat kau naahee bhai ||
verses.translation: His devotees are not afraid.

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਭਗਤ ਕਉ ਸਦਾ ਜੈ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jaa ke bhagat kau sadhaa jai ||3||
verses.translation: His devotees are victorious forever. ||3||
What Praises of Yours can I utter?
God, the Giver of peace, is all-pervading, permeating everywhere.
Nanak begs for this one gift.
Be merciful, and bless me with Your Name. ||4||5||
Basant, Fifth Mehla:
As the plant turns green upon receiving water,
just so, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, egotism is eradicated.
Just as the servant is encouraged by his ruler,
we are saved by the Guru. ||1||
You are the Great Giver, O Generous Lord God.
Each and every instant, I humbly bow to You. ||1||Pause||
Whoever enters the Saadh Sangat
that humble being is imbued with the Love of the Supreme Lord God.
He is liberated from bondage.
His devotees worship Him in adoration; they are united in His Union. ||2||
My eyes are content, gazing upon the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.
My tongue sings the Infinite Praises of God.
My thirst is quenched, by Guru's Grace.
My mind is satisfied, with the sublime taste of the Lord's subtle essence. ||3||
Your servant is committed to the service of Your Feet,
O Primal Infinite Divine Being.
Your Name is the Saving Grace of all.
Nanak has received this teasure. ||4||6||
Basant, Fifth Mehla:
You are the Great Giver; You continue to give.
You permeate and pervade my soul, and my breath of life.
You have given me all sorts of foods and dishes.

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਇਕੁ ਗੁਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਨ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: moh niragun ik gun na jaan ||1||
verses.translation: I am unworthy; I know none of Your Virtues at all. ||1||

verses.original: ਹਉ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਨਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: hau kachhoo na jaanau teree saar ||
verses.translation: I do not understand anything of Your Worth.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਕਰਿ ਗਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: too kar gat meree prabh dhiaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Save me, O my Merciful Lord God. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਜਾਪ ਨ ਤਾਪ ਨ ਕਰਮ ਕੀਤਿ ॥
verses.translit: jaap na taap na karam keet ||
verses.translation: I have not practiced meditation, austerities or good actions.
I do not know the way to meet You.
Within my mind, I have placed my hopes in the One Lord alone.
The Support of Your Name shall carry me across. ||2||
You are the Expert, O God, in all powers.
The fish cannot find the limits of the water.
You are Inaccessible and Unfathomable, the Highest of the High.
I am small, and You are so very Great. ||3||
Those who meditate on You are wealthy.
Those who attain You are rich.
Those who serve You are peaceful.
Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Saints. ||4||7||
Basant, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਤਿਸੁ ਤੂ ਸੇਵਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਤੂ ਕੀਆ ॥
verses.translit: tis too sev jin too keeaa ||
verses.translation: Serve the One who created You.
Worship the One who gave you life.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਚਾਕਰੁ ਹੋਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਡਾਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
verses.translit: tis kaa chaakar hoh fir ddaan na laagai ||
verses.translation: Become His servant, and you shall never again be punished.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਪੋਤਦਾਰੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: tis kee kar potadhaaree fir dhookh na laagai ||1||
verses.translation: Become His trustee, and you shall never again suffer sorrow. ||1||
That mortal who is blessed with such great good fortune,

verses.original: ਸੋ ਪਾਏ ਇਹੁ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: so paae ih padh nirabaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: attains this state of Nirvaanaa. ||1||Pause||
Life is wasted uselessly in the service of duality.

verses.original: ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਰਥਾ ॥
verses.translit: kachhoo na hoiee hai pooran arathaa ||
verses.translation: No efforts shall be rewarded, and no works brought to fruition.
It is so painful to serve only mortal beings.
Service to the Holy brings lasting peace and bliss. ||2||
If you long for eternal peace, O Siblings of Destiny,
then join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; this is the Guru's advice.
There, the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is meditated on.
In the Saadh Sangat, you shall be emancipated. ||3||
Among all essences, this is the essence of spiritual wisdom.
Among all meditations, meditation on the One Lord is the most sublime.
The Kirtan of the Lord's Praises is the ultimate melody.
Meeting with the Guru, Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||8||
Basant, Fifth Mehla:
Chanting His Name, one's mouth becomes pure.
Meditating in remembrance on Him, one's reputation becomes stainless.

verses.original: ਜਿਸੁ ਅਰਾਧੇ ਜਮੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਕਹੈ ॥
verses.translit: jis araadhe jam kichh na kahai ||
verses.translation: Worshipping Him in adoration, one is not tortured by the Messenger of Death.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਲਹੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jis kee sevaa sabh kichh lahai ||1||
verses.translation: Serving Him, everything is obtained. ||1||
The Lord's Name - chant the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਮਨ ਕੇ ਸਗਲ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tiaagahu man ke sagal kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Abandon all the desires of your mind. ||1||Pause||
He is the Support of the earth and the sky.

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT jis kaa hai pragaas ||
verses.translation: His Light illuminates each and every heart.
Meditating in remembrance on Him, even fallen sinners are sanctified;

verses.original: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਨ ਰੋਇ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: a(n)t kaal fir fir na roi ||2||
verses.translation: in the end, they will not weep and wail over and over again. ||2||
Among all religions, this is the ultimate religion.
Among all rituals and codes of conduct, this is above all.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਚਾਹਹਿ ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਦੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: jis kau chaaheh sur nar dhev ||
verses.translation: The angels, mortals and divine beings long for Him.
To find Him, commit yourself to the service of the Society of the Saints. ||3||
One whom the Primal Lord God blesses with His bounties,
obtains the treasure of the Lord.

verses.original: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: tis kee gat mit kahee na jai ||
verses.translation: His state and extent cannot be described.
Servant Nanak meditates on the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||9||
Basant, Fifth Mehla:
My mind and body are gripped by thirst and desire.
The Merciful Guru has fulfilled my hopes.
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, all my sins have been taken away.
I chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord; I am in love with the Name of the Lord. ||1||
By Guru's Grace, this spring of the soul has come.

verses.original: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: charan kamal hiradhai ur dhaare sadhaa sadhaa har jas sunaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I enshrine the Lord's Lotus Feet within my heart; I listen to the Lord's Praise, forever and ever. ||1||Pause||
Our All-powerful Lord and Master is the Doer of all, the Cause of all causes.
I am an orphan - I seek Your Sanctuary, God.
All beings and creatures take Your Support.
Be merciful, God, and save me. ||2||
God is the Destroyer of fear, the Remover of pain and suffering.

verses.original: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ॥
verses.translit: sur nar mun jan taa kee sev ||
verses.translation: The angelic beings and silent sages serve Him.

verses.original: ਧਰਣਿ ਅਕਾਸੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਕਲਾ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: dharan akaas jaa kee kalaa maeh ||
verses.translation: The earth and the sky are in His Power.
All beings eat what You give them. ||3||
O Merciful God, O Searcher of hearts,
please bless Your slave with Your Glance of Grace.
Please be kind and bless me with this gift,
that Nanak may live in Your Name. ||4||10||
Basant, Fifth Mehla:
Loving the Lord, one's sins are taken away.
Meditating on the Lord, one does not suffer at all.
Meditating on the Lord of the Universe, all darkness is dispelled.
Meditating in remembrance on the Lord, the cycle of reincarnation comes to an end. ||1||
The love of the Lord is springtime for me.

verses.original: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਸਿਉ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)t janaa siau sadhaa sa(n)g ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I am always with the humble Saints. ||1||Pause||
The Saints have shared the Teachings with me.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਭਗਤੁ ਸੋ ਧੰਨਿ ਦੇਸੁ ॥
verses.translit: jeh gobi(n)dh bhagat so dha(n)n dhes ||
verses.translation: Blessed is that country where the devotees of the Lord of the Universe dwell.
But that place where the Lord's devotees are not, is wilderness.
By Guru's Grace, realize the Lord in each and every heart. ||2||
Sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, and enjoy the nectar of His Love.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਪਾਪ ਕਰਤ ਤੂ ਸਦਾ ਸੰਗੁ ॥
verses.translit: man paap karat too sadhaa sa(n)g ||
verses.translation: O mortal, you must always restrain yourself from committing sins.
Behold the Creator Lord God near at hand.
Here and hereafter, God shall resolve your affairs. ||3||
I focus my meditation on the Lord's Lotus Feet.
Granting His Grace, God has blessed me with this Gift.

verses.original: ਤੇਰਿਆ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਬਾਛਉ ਧੂਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: teriaa sa(n)t janaa kee baachhau dhoor ||
verses.translation: I yearn for the dust of the feet of Your Saints.
Nanak meditates on his Lord and Master, who is ever-present, near at hand. ||4||11||
Basant, Fifth Mehla:
The True Transcendent Lord is always new, forever fresh.
By Guru's Grace, I continually chant His Name.
God is my Protector, my Mother and Father.
Meditating in remembrance on Him, I do not suffer in sorrow. ||1||

verses.original: ਖਸਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕ ਭਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: khasam dhiaaiee ik man ik bhai ||
verses.translation: I meditate on my Lord and Master, single-mindedly, with love.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸਦਾ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਹਿਬਿ ਰਖਿਆ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur poore kee sadhaa saranaiee saachai saahib rakhiaa ka(n)Th lai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I seek the Sanctuary of the Perfect Guru forever. My True Lord and Master hugs me close in His Embrace. ||1||Pause||
God Himself protects His humble servants.
The demons and wicked enemies have grown weary of struggling against Him.
Without the True Guru, there is no place to go.
Wandering through the lands and foreign countries, people only grow tired and suffer in pain. ||2||
The record of their past actions cannot be erased.
They harvest and eat what they have planted.
The Lord Himself is the Protector of His humble servants.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪਹੁਚਿ ਨ ਸਕਸਿ ਕੋਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: jan kau pahuch na sakas koi ||3||
verses.translation: No one can rival the humble servant of the Lord. ||3||

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਦਾਸ ਰਖੇ ਕਰਿ ਜਤਨੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
verses.translit: prabh dhaas rakhe kar jatan aap ||
verses.translation: By His own efforts, God protects His slave.
God's Glory is perfect and unbroken.
So sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe with your tongue forever.
Nanak lives by meditating on the Feet of the Lord. ||4||12||
Basant, Fifth Mehla:
Dwelling at the Guru's Feet, pain and suffering go away.
The Supreme Lord God has shown mercy to me.
All my desires and tasks are fulfilled.
Chanting the Lord's Name, Nanak lives. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਾ ਰੁਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: saa rut suhaavee jit har chit aavai ||
verses.translation: How beautiful is that season, when the Lord fills the mind.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੀਸੈ ਬਿਲਲਾਂਤੀ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: bin satigur dheesai bilalaa(n)tee saakat fir fir aavai jaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without the True Guru, the world weeps. The faithless cynic comes and goes in reincarnation, over and over again. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
verses.translit: se dhanava(n)t jin har prabh raas ||
verses.translation: They alone are rich, who have the Wealth of the Lord God.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, sexual desire and anger are eradicated.
Their fear is dispelled, and they attain the state of fearlessness.
Meeting with the Guru, Nanak meditates on his Lord and Master. ||2||
God dwells in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਹੋਈ ਪੂਰਨ ਆਸ ॥
verses.translit: har jap jap hoiee pooran aas ||
verses.translation: Chanting and meditating on the Lord, one's hopes are fulfilled.
God permeates and pervades the water, the land and the sky.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਹਿਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: gur mil naanak har har kahiaa ||3||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Guru, Nanak chants the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||

verses.original: ਅਸਟ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਏਹ ॥ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹ ॥
verses.translit: asaT sidh nav nidh eh || karam paraapat jis naam dheh ||
verses.translation: The eight miraculous spiritual powers and the nine treasures are contained in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. This is bestowed when God grants His Grace.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਜੀਵਹਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸ ॥
verses.translit: prabh jap jap jeeveh tere dhaas ||
verses.translation: Your slaves, O God, live by chanting and meditating on Your Name.
O Nanak, the heart-lotus of the Gurmukh blossoms forth. ||4||13||

verses.translit: basa(n)t mahalaa panjavaa ghar pehilaa ik tuke
verses.translation: Basant, Fifth Mehla, First House, Ik-Thukay:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Meditating on the Lord, all desires are fulfilled,
and the mortal is re-united with God, after having been separated for so long. ||1||
Meditate on the Lord of the Universe, who is worthy of meditation.

verses.original: ਜਿਤੁ ਰਵਿਐ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਭੋਗੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jit raviaai sukh sahaj bhog ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meditating on Him, enjoy celestial peace and poise. ||1||Pause||
Bestowing His Mercy, He blesses us with His Glance of Grace.
God Himself takes care of His slave. ||2||
My bed has been beautified by His Love.
God, the Giver of Peace, has come to meet me. ||3||
He does not consider my merits and demerits.
Nanak worships at the Feet of God. ||4||1||14||
Basant, Fifth Mehla:
The sins are erased, singing the Glories of God;
night and day, celestial joy wells up. ||1||
My mind has blossomed forth, by the touch of the Lord's Feet.

verses.original: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਾਧੂ ਜਨ ਭੇਟੇ ਨਿਤ ਰਾਤੌ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kar kirapaa saadhoo jan bheTe nit raatau har naam ra(n)g ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: By His Grace, He has led me to meet the Holy men, the humble servants of the Lord. I remain continually imbued with the love of the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||
In His Mercy, the Lord of the World has revealed Himself to me.
The Lord, Merciful to the meek, has attached me to the hem of His robe and saved me. ||2||
This mind has become the dust of the Holy;
I behold my Lord and Master, continually, ever-present. ||3||
Sexual desire, anger and desire have vanished.
O Nanak, God has become kind to me. ||4||2||15||
Basant, Fifth Mehla:
God Himself has cured the disease.
He laid on His Hands, and protected His child. ||1||
Celestial peace and tranquility fill my home forever, in this springtime of the soul.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ਆਏ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਰੂਪ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਤੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur poore kee saranee aae kaliaan roop jap har har ma(n)t ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I have sought the Sanctuary of the Perfect Guru; I chant the Mantra of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the Embodiment of emancipation. ||1||Pause||
God Himself has dispelled my sorrow and suffering.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਉ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਜਾਪਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: gur apune kau nit nit jaap ||2||
verses.translation: I meditate continually, continuously, on my Guru. ||2||
That humble being who chants Your Name,

verses.original: ਸਭਿ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: sabh fal paae nihachal gun gaau ||3||
verses.translation: obtains all fruits and rewards; singing the Glories of God, he becomes steady and stable. ||3||
O Nanak, the way of the devotees is good.
They meditate continually, continuously, on the Lord, the Giver of peace. ||4||3||16||
Basant, Fifth Mehla:
By His Will, He makes us happy.
He shows Mercy to His servant. ||1||
The Perfect Guru makes everything perfect.

verses.original: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦ ਮਹਿ ਦੀਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)mirat naam ridh meh dheeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He implants the Amrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, in the heart. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਰਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ॥
verses.translit: karam dharam meraa kachh na beechaario ||
verses.translation: He does not consider the karma of my actions, or my Dharma, my spiritual practice.
Taking me by the arm, He saves me and carries me across the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||
God has rid me of my filth, and made me stainless and pure.
I have sought the Sanctuary of the Perfect Guru. ||3||
He Himself does, and causes everything to be done.
By His Grace, O Nanak, He saves us. ||4||4||17||
Basant, Fifth Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Behold the flowers flowering, and the blossoms blossoming forth!
Renounce and abandon your egotism.
Grasp hold of His Lotus Feet.
Meet with God, O blessed one.
O my mind, remain conscious of the Lord. ||Pause||
The tender young plants smell so good,
while others remain like dry wood.
The season of spring has come;
it blossoms forth luxuriantly. ||1||
Now, the Dark Age of Kali Yuga has come.
Plant the Naam, the Name of the One Lord.
It is not the season to plant other seeds.
Do not wander lost in doubt and delusion.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਏ ॥ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਹੈ ਲੇਖਾ ॥
verses.translit: gur mile har paae || jis masatak hai lekhaa ||
verses.translation: One who has such destiny written on his forehead, shall meet with the Guru and find the Lord.
O mortal, this is the season of the Naam.

verses.original: ਗੁਨ ਕਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰੇ ॥੨॥੧੮॥
verses.translit: gun kahe naanak har hare har hare ||2||18||
verses.translation: Nanak utters the Glorious Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, Har. ||2||18||

verses.translit: basa(n)t mahalaa panjavaa ghar doojaa hi(n)ddol
verses.translation: Basant, Fifth Mehla, Second House, Hindol:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਹੋਇ ਇਕਤ੍ਰ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: hoi ikatr milahu mere bhaiee dhubidhaa dhoor karahu liv lai ||
verses.translation: Come and join together, O my Siblings of Destiny; dispel your sense of duality and let yourselves be lovingly absorbed in the Lord.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੈ ਕੇ ਹੋਵਹੁ ਜੋੜੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੈਸਹੁ ਸਫਾ ਵਿਛਾਇ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: har naamai ke hovahu joRee gurmukh baisahu safaa vichhai ||1||
verses.translation: Let yourselves be joined to the Name of the Lord; become Gurmukh, spread out your mat, and sit down. ||1||
In this way, throw the dice, O brothers.

verses.original: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਨਹ ਲਾਗੈ ਪੀਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gurmukh naam japahu dhin raatee a(n)t kaal neh laagai peer ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: As Gurmukh, chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord, day and night. At the very last moment, you shall not have to suffer in pain. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਤੁਮੑ ਚਉਪੜਿ ਸਾਜਹੁ ਸਤੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਤੁਮੑ ਸਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: karam dharam tum(h) chaupaR saajahu sat karahu tum(h) saaree ||
verses.translation: Let righteous actions be your gameboard, and let the truth be your dice.

verses.original: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਜੀਤਹੁ ਐਸੀ ਖੇਲ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kaam karodh lobh moh jeetahu aaisee khel har piaaree ||2||
verses.translation: Conquer sexual desire, anger, greed and worldly attachment; only such a game as this is dear to the Lord. ||2||

verses.original: ਉਠਿ ਇਸਨਾਨੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਪਰਭਾਤੇ ਸੋਏ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧੇ ॥
verses.translit: auTh isanaan karahu parabhaate soe har aaraadhe ||
verses.translation: Rise in the early hours of the morning, and take your cleansing bath. Before you go to bed at night, remember to worship the Lord.

verses.original: ਬਿਖੜੇ ਦਾਉ ਲੰਘਾਵੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: bikhaRe dhaau la(n)ghaavai meraa satigur sukh sahaj setee ghar jaate ||3||
verses.translation: My True Guru will assist you, even on your most difficult moves; you shall reach your true home in celestial peace and poise. ||3||

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਖੇਲੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਖੈ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: har aape khelai aape dhekhai har aape rachan rachaiaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself plays, and He Himself watches; the Lord Himself created the creation.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਖੇਲੈ ਸੋ ਜਿਣਿ ਬਾਜੀ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੯॥
verses.translit: jan naanak gurmukh jo nar khelai so jin baajee ghar aaiaa ||4||1||19||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, that person who plays this game as Gurmukh, wins the game of life, and returns to his true home. ||4||1||19||
Basant, Fifth Mehla, Hindol:

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਜਾਣਹਿ ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਜਾਣੈ ॥
verses.translit: teree kudharat toohai jaaneh aaur na dhoojaa jaanai ||
verses.translation: You alone know Your Creative Power, O Lord; no one else knows it.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਤੁਝੈ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: jis no kirapaa kareh mere piaare soiee tujhai pachhaanai ||1||
verses.translation: He alone realizes You, O my Beloved, unto whom You show Your Mercy. ||1||
I am a sacrifice to Your devotees.

verses.original: ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਾ ਰੰਗ ਤੇਰੇ ਆਪਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: thaan suhaavaa sadhaa prabh teraa ra(n)g tere aapaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Your place is eternally beautiful, God; Your wonders are infinite. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: teree sevaa tujh te hovai aaur na dhoojaa karataa ||
verses.translation: Only You Yourself can perform Your service. No one else can do it.

verses.original: ਭਗਤੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਸੋਈ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਤੂ ਰੰਗੁ ਧਰਤਾ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: bhagat teraa soiee tudh bhaavai jis no too ra(n)g dharataa ||2||
verses.translation: He alone is Your devotee, who is pleasing to You. You bless them with Your Love. ||2||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਵਡ ਦਾਤਾ ਤੂ ਵਡ ਦਾਨਾ ਅਉਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋ ਦੂਜਾ ॥
verses.translit: too vadd dhaataa too vadd dhaanaa aaur nahee ko dhoojaa ||
verses.translation: You are the Great Giver; You are so very Wise. There is no other like You.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਉ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਪੂਜਾ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: too samarath suaamee meraa hau kiaa jaanaa teree poojaa ||3||
verses.translation: You are my All-powerful Lord and Master; I do not know how to worship You. ||3||

verses.original: ਤੇਰਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੈ ਭਾਣਾ ॥
verses.translit: teraa mahal agochar mere piaare bikham teraa hai bhaanaa ||
verses.translation: Your Mansion is imperceptible, O my Beloved; it is so difficult to accept Your Will.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਢਹਿ ਪਇਆ ਦੁਆਰੈ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਮੁਗਧ ਅਜਾਣਾ ॥੪॥੨॥੨੦॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak ddeh piaa dhuaarai rakh levahu mugadh ajaanaa ||4||2||20||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, I have collapsed at Your Door, Lord. I am foolish and ignorant - please save me! ||4||2||20||
Basant Hindol, Fifth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮੂਲੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਆਪੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਭਰਮਿ ਬਿਆਪੀ ਅਹੰ ਮਨੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: mool na boojhai aap na soojhai bharam biaapee aha(n) manee ||1||
verses.translation: The mortal does not know the Primal Lord God; he does not understand hmself. He is engrossed in doubt and egotism. ||1||
My Father is the Supreme Lord God, my Master.
I am unworthy, but please save me anyway. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਓਪਤਿ ਪਰਲਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਹੋਵੈ ਇਹ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: opat paralau prabh te hovai ieh beechaaree har janee ||2||
verses.translation: Creation and destruction come only from God; this is what the Lord's humble servants believe. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕੇ ਜੋ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਸੇ ਗਨੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: naam prabhoo ke jo ra(n)g raate kal meh sukhe'ee se ganee ||3||
verses.translation: Only those who are imbued with God's Name are judged to be peaceful in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||3||

verses.original: ਅਵਰੁ ਉਪਾਉ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਸੂਝੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਰੀਐ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ॥੪॥੩॥੨੧॥
verses.translit: avar upaau na koiee soojhai naanak tareeaai gur bachanee ||4||3||21||
verses.translation: It is the Guru's Word that carries us across; Nanak cannot think of any other way. ||4||3||21||
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Raag Basant Hindol, Ninth Mehla:
O Holy Saints, know that this body is false.

verses.original: ਯਾ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜੋ ਰਾਮੁ ਬਸਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਚੋ ਤਾਹਿ ਪਛਾਨੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: yaa bheetar jo raam basat hai saacho taeh pachhaano ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The Lord who dwells within it - recognize that He alone is real. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਹੈ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਸੁਪਨੇ ਕੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਕਹਾ ਐਡਾਨੋ ॥
verses.translit: eih jag hai sa(n)pat supane kee dhekh kahaa aaiddaano ||
verses.translation: The wealth of this world is only a dream; why are you so proud of it?

verses.original: ਸੰਗਿ ਤਿਹਾਰੈ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਤਾਹਿ ਕਹਾ ਲਪਟਾਨੋ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sa(n)g tihaarai kachhoo na chaalai taeh kahaa lapaTaano ||1||
verses.translation: None of it shall go along with you in the end; why do you cling to it? ||1||

verses.original: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਦੋਊ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਉਰਿ ਆਨੋ ॥
verses.translit: ausatat ni(n)dhaa dhouoo parahar har keerat ur aano ||
verses.translation: Leave behind both praise and slander; enshrine the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises within your heart.

verses.original: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਮੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਏਕ ਪੁਰਖ ਭਗਵਾਨੋ ॥੨॥੧॥
verses.translit: jan naanak sabh hee mai pooran ek purakh bhagavaano ||2||1||
verses.translation: O servant Nanak, the One Primal Being, the Lord God, is totally permeating everywhere. ||2||1||
Basant, Ninth Mehla:
The heart of the sinner is filled with unfulfilled sexual desire.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਚੰਚਲੁ ਯਾ ਤੇ ਗਹਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man cha(n)chal yaa te gahio na jai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: He cannot control his fickle mind. ||1||Pause||
The Yogis, wandering ascetics and renunciates

verses.original: ਸਭ ਹੀ ਪਰਿ ਡਾਰੀ ਇਹ ਫਾਸ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: sabh hee par ddaaree ieh faas ||1||
verses.translation: - this net is cast over them all. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਿਹਿ ਜਿਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮੑਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: jeh jeh har ko naam sam(h)aar ||
verses.translation: Those who contemplate the Name of the Lord
cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||
Servant Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Lord.
Please bestow the blessing of Your Name, that he may continue to sing Your Glorious Praises. ||3||2||
Basant, Ninth Mehla:

verses.original: ਮਾਈ ਮੈ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
verses.translit: maiee mai dhan paio har naam ||
verses.translation: O mother, I have gathered the wealth of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਧਾਵਨ ਤੇ ਛੂਟਿਓ ਕਰਿ ਬੈਠੋ ਬਿਸਰਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: man mero dhaavan te chhooTio kar baiTho bisaraam ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: My mind has stopped its wanderings, and now, it has come to rest. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਭਾਗੀ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: maiaa mamataa tan te bhaagee upajio niramal giaan ||
verses.translation: Attachment to Maya has run away from my body, and immaculate spiritual wisdom has welled up within me.

verses.original: ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਏਹ ਪਰਸਿ ਨ ਸਾਕੈ ਗਹੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: lobh moh eh paras na saakai gahee bhagat bhagavaan ||1||
verses.translation: Greed and attachment cannot even touch me; I have grasped hold of devotional worship of the Lord. ||1||

verses.original: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕਾ ਸੰਸਾ ਚੂਕਾ ਰਤਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਬ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: janam janam kaa sa(n)saa chookaa ratan naam jab paiaa ||
verses.translation: The cynicism of countless lifetimes has been eradicated, since I obtained the jewel of the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਸਕਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਨਿਜ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tirasanaa sakal binaasee man te nij sukh maeh samaiaa ||2||
verses.translation: My mind was rid of all its desires, and I was absorbed in the peace of my own inner being. ||2||

verses.original: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹੋਤ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਸੋ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jaa kau hot dhiaal kirapaa nidh so gobi(n)dh gun gaavai ||
verses.translation: That person, unto whom the Merciful Lord shows compassion, sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੀ ਸੰਪੈ ਕੋਊ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥੩॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak ieh bidh kee sa(n)pai kouoo gurmukh paavai ||3||3||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, this wealth is gathered only by the Gurmukh. ||3||3||
Basant, Ninth Mehla:
O my mind, how can you forget the Lord's Name?

verses.original: ਤਨੁ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਜਮ ਸਿਉ ਪਰੈ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: tan binasai jam siau parai kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: When the body perishes, you shall have to deal with the Messenger of Death. ||1||Pause||
This world is just a hill of smoke.
What makes you think that it is real? ||1||
Wealth, spouse, property and household

verses.original: ਕਛੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਸਮਝ ਲੇਹ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: kachh sa(n)g na chaalai samajh leh ||2||
verses.translation: - none of them shall go along with you; you must know that this is true! ||2||
Only devotion to the Lord shall go with you.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਜੁ ਤਿਹ ਏਕ ਰੰਗਿ ॥੩॥੪॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak bhaj teh ek ra(n)g ||3||4||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, vibrate and meditate on the Lord with single-minded love. ||3||4||
Basant, Ninth Mehla:

verses.original: ਕਹਾ ਭੂਲਿਓ ਰੇ ਝੂਠੇ ਲੋਭ ਲਾਗ ॥
verses.translit: kahaa bhoolio re jhooThe lobh laag ||
verses.translation: Why do you wander lost, O mortal, attached to falsehood and greed?

verses.original: ਕਛੁ ਬਿਗਰਿਓ ਨਾਹਿਨ ਅਜਹੁ ਜਾਗ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: kachh bigario naahin ajahu jaag ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Nothing has been lost yet - there is still time to wake up! ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਸਮ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਕੈ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
verses.translit: sam supanai kai ih jag jaan ||
verses.translation: You must realize that this world is nothing more than a dream.
In an instant, it shall perish; know this as true. ||1||
The Lord constantly abides with you.
Night and day, vibrate and meditate on Him, O my friend. ||2||
At the very last instant, He shall be your Help and Support.

verses.original: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਨ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਗਾਇ ॥੩॥੫॥
verses.translit: kahu naanak gun taa ke gai ||3||5||
verses.translation: Says Nanak, sing His Praises. ||3||5||

verses.translit: basa(n)t mahalaa pehilaa asaTapadheeaa ghar pehilaa dhutukeeaa
verses.translation: Basant, First Mehla, Ashtpadheeyaa, First House, Du-Tukees:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
The world is a crow; it does not remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
Forgetting the Naam, it sees the bait, and pecks at it.
The mind wavers unsteadily, in guilt and deceit.
I have shattered my attachment to the false world. ||1||
The burden of sexual desire, anger and corruption is unbearable.

verses.original: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੈਸੇ ਗੁਨ ਚਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: naam binaa kaise gun chaar ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Without the Naam, how can the mortal maintain a virtuous lifestyle? ||1||Pause||
The world is like a house of sand, built on a whirlpool;
it is like a bubble formed by drops of rain.

verses.original: ਮਾਤ੍ਰ ਬੂੰਦ ਤੇ ਧਰਿ ਚਕੁ ਫੇਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: maatr boo(n)dh te dhar chak fer ||
verses.translation: It is formed from a mere drop, when the Lord's wheel turns round.
The lights of all souls are the servants of the Lord's Name. ||2||
My Supreme Guru has created everything.
I perform devotional worship service to You, and fall at Your Feet, O Lord.
Imbued with Your Name, I long to be Yours.
Those who do not let the Naam become manifest within themselves, depart like thieves in the end. ||3||
The mortal loses his honor, gathering sin and corruption.

verses.original: ਸਾਚ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੋ ਪਤਿ ਸਿਉ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: saach naam rato pat siau ghar jai ||
verses.translation: But imbued with the Lord's Name, you shall go to your true home with honor.
God does whatever He wills.
One who abides in the Fear of God, becomes fearless, O my mother. ||4||
The woman desires beauty and pleasure.
But betel leaves, garlands of flowers and sweet tastes lead only to disease.
The more she plays and enjoys, the more she suffers in sorrow.
But when she enters into the Sanctuary of God, whatever she wishes comes to pass. ||5||
She wears beautiful clothes with all sorts of decorations.
But the flowers turn to dust, and her beauty leads her into evil.
Hope and desire have blocked the doorway.
Without the Naam, one's hearth and home are deserted. ||6||
O princess, my daughter, run away from this place!
Chant the True Name, and embellish your days.
Serve your Beloved Lord God, and lean on the Support of His Love.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, abandon your thirst for corruption and poison. ||7||
My Fascinating Lord has fascinated my mind.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I have realized You, Lord.
Nanak stands longingly at God's Door.
I am content and satisfied with Your Name; please shower me with Your Mercy. ||8||1||
Basant, First Mehla:
The mind is deluded by doubt; it comes and goes in reincarnation.
It is lured by the poisonous lure of Maya.
It does not remain stable in the Love of the One Lord.
Like the fish, its neck is pierced by the hook. ||1||
The deluded mind is instructed by the True Name.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ਸਹਜ ਭਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur sabadh beechaare sahaj bhai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: It contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad, with intuitive ease. ||1||Pause||
The mind, deluded by doubt, buzzes around like a bumble bee.
The holes of the body are worthless, if the mind is filled with such great desire for corrupt passions.
It is like the elephant, trapped by its own sexual desire.
It is caught and held tight by the chains, and beaten on its head. ||2||
The mind is like a foolish frog, without devotional worship.
It is cursed and condemned in the Court of the Lord, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਤਾ ਕੈ ਜਾਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਤੀ ਨਾਮ ਲੀਨ ॥
verses.translit: taa kai jaat na paatee naam leen ||
verses.translation: He has no class or honor, and no one even mentions his name.
That person who lacks virtue - all of his pains and sorrows are his only companions. ||3||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਚਲੈ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਠਾਕਿ ਰਾਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: man chalai na jaiee Thaak raakh ||
verses.translation: His mind wanders out, and cannot be brought back or restrained.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸ ਰਾਤੇ ਪਤਿ ਨ ਸਾਖੁ ॥
verses.translit: bin har ras raate pat na saakh ||
verses.translation: Without being imbued with the sublime essence of the Lord, it has no honor or credit.
You Yourself are the Listener, Lord, and You Yourself are our Protector.
You are the Support of the earth; You Yourself behold and understand it. ||4||
When You Yourself make me wander, unto whom can I complain?
Meeting the Guru, I will tell Him of my pain, O my mother.
Abandoning my worthless demerits, now I practice virtue.
Imbued with the Word of the Guru's Shabad, I am absorbed in the True Lord. ||5||
Meeting with the True Guru, the intellect is elevated and exalted.
The mind becomes immaculate, and egotism is washed away.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਬੰਧਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: sadhaa mukat ba(n)dh na sakai koi ||
verses.translation: He is liberated forever, and no one can put him in bondage.

verses.original: ਸਦਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣੈ ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: sadhaa naam vakhaanai aaur na koi ||6||
verses.translation: He chants the Naam forever, and nothing else. ||6||

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man har kai bhaanai aavai jai ||
verses.translation: The mind comes and goes according to the Will of the Lord.

verses.original: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: sabh meh eko kichh kahan na jai ||
