verses.translation: The One Lord is contained amongst all; nothing else can be said.
The Hukam of His Command pervades everywhere, and all merge in His Command.
Pain and pleasure all come by His Will. ||7||

verses.original: ਤੂ ਅਭੁਲੁ ਨ ਭੂਲੌ ਕਦੇ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: too abhul na bhoolau kadhe naeh ||
verses.translation: You are infallible; You never make mistakes.
Those who listen to the Word of the Guru's Shabad - their intellects become deep and profound.
You, O my Great Lord and Master, are contained in the Shabad.
O Nanak, my mind is pleased, praising the True Lord. ||8||2||
Basant, First Mehla:

verses.original: ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਰ ਹੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: dharasan kee piaas jis nar hoi ||
verses.translation: That person, who thirsts for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan,
is absorbed in the One Lord, leaving duality behind.
His pains are taken away, as he churns and drinks in the Ambrosial Nectar.
The Gurmukh understands, and merges in the One Lord. ||1||
So many cry out for Your Darshan, Lord.

verses.original: ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋ ਚੀਨਸਿ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: viralaa ko cheenas gur sabadh milai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: How rare are those who realize the Word of the Guru's Shabad and merge with Him. ||1||Pause||
The Vedas say that we should chant the Name of the One Lord.
He is endless; who can find His limits?
There is only One Creator, who created the world.
Without any pillars, He supports the earth and the sky. ||2||
Spiritual wisdom and meditation are contained in the melody of the Bani, the Word of the One Lord.
The One Lord is Untouched and Unstained; His story is unspoken.
The Shabad, the Word, is the Insignia of the One True Lord.
Through the Perfect Guru, the Knowing Lord is known. ||3||
There is only one religion of Dharma; let everyone grasp this truth.
Through the Guru's Teachings, one becomes perfect, all the ages through.
Imbued with the Unmanifest Celestial Lord, and lovingly absorbed in the One,
the Gurmukh attains the invisible and infinite. ||4||
There is one celestial throne, and One Supreme King.
The Independent Lord God is pervading all places.
The three worlds are the creation of that Sublime Lord.
The One Creator of the Creation is Unfathomable and Incomprehensible. ||5||
His Form is One, and True is His Name.
True justice is administered there.
Those who practice Truth are honored and accepted.
They are honored in the Court of the True Lord. ||6||
Devotional worship of the One Lord is the expression of love for the One Lord.
Without the Fear of God and devotional worship of Him, the mortal comes and goes in reincarnation.
One who obtains this understanding from the Guru dwells like an honored guest in this world.
That humble being who is imbued with the sublime essence of the Lord is certified and approved. ||7||
I see Him here and there; I dwell on Him intuitively.

verses.original: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਭਾਵਉ ॥
verses.translit: tujh bin Thaakur kisai na bhaavau ||
verses.translation: I do not love any other than You, O Lord and Master.
O Nanak, my ego has been burnt away by the Word of the Shabad.
The True Guru has shown me the Blessed Vision of the True Lord. ||8||3||
Basant, First Mehla:
The fickle consciousness cannot find the Lord's limits.
It is caught in non-stop coming and going.
I am suffering and dying, O my Creator.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕੋ ਕਰੈ ਨ ਸਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: bin preetam ko karai na saaraa ||1||
verses.translation: No one cares for me, except my Beloved. ||1||
All are high and exalted; how can I call anyone low?

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਸਚਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਤੀਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: har bhagatee sach naam pateenaa ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Devotional worship of the Lord and the True Name has satisfied me. ||1||Pause||
I have taken all sorts of medicines; I am so tired of them.

verses.original: ਕਿਉ ਦੁਖੁ ਚੂਕੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਮੇਰੇ ॥
verses.translit: kiau dhukh chookai bin gur mere ||
verses.translation: How can this disease be cured, without my Guru?
Without devotional worship of the Lord, the pain is so great.
My Lord and Master is the Giver of pain and pleasure. ||2||
The disease is so deadly; how can I find the courage?
He knows my disease, and only He can take away the pain.
My mind and body are filled with faults and demerits.
I searched and searched, and found the Guru, O my brother! ||3||

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur kaa sabadh dhaaroo har naau ||
verses.translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad, and the Lord's Name are the cures.
As You keep me, so do I remain.
The world is sick; where should I look?
The Lord is Pure and Immaculate; Immaculate is His Name. ||4||

verses.original: ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਘਰੁ ਜੋ ਦੇਖਿ ਦਿਖਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: ghar meh ghar jo dhekh dhikhaavai ||
verses.translation: The Guru sees and reveals the Lord's home, deep within the home of the self;
He ushers the soul-bride into the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਚਿਤ ਮਹਿ ਚੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: man meh manooaa chit meh cheetaa ||
verses.translation: When the mind remains in the mind, and the consciousness in the consciousness,
such people of the Lord remain unattached. ||5||
They remain free of any desire for happiness or sorrow;
tasting the Amrit, the Ambrosial Nectar, they abide in the Lord's Name.
They recognize their own selves, and remain lovingly attuned to the Lord.
They are victorious on the battlefield of life, following the Guru's Teachings, and their pains run away. ||6||
The Guru has given me the True Ambrosial Nectar; I drink it in.
Of course, I have died, and now I am alive to live.
Please, protect me as Your Own, if it pleases You.
One who is Yours, merges into You. ||7||
Painful diseases afflict those who are sexually promiscuous.

verses.original: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਪੈ ॥
verses.translit: ghaT ghaT rav rahiaa prabh jaapai ||
verses.translation: God appears permeating and pervading in each and every heart.

verses.original: ਸੁਖ ਦੁਖ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਅਤੀਤਾ ॥
verses.translit: sukh dhukh hee te gur sabadh ateetaa ||
verses.translation: One who remains unattached, through the Word of the Guru's Shabad
- O Nanak, his heart and consciousness dwell upon and savor the Lord. ||8||4||
Basant, First Mehla, Ik-Tukee:
Do not make such a show of rubbing ashes on your body.
O naked Yogi, this is not the way of Yoga! ||1||

verses.original: ਮੂੜੑੇ ਕਾਹੇ ਬਿਸਾਰਿਓ ਤੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: mooR(h)e kaahe bisaario tai raam naam ||
verses.translation: You fool! How can you have forgotten the Lord's Name?

verses.original: ਅੰਤ ਕਾਲਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਆਵੈ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: a(n)t kaal terai aavai kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: At the very last moment, it and it alone shall be of any use to you. ||1||Pause||
Consult the Guru, reflect and think it over.
Wherever I look, I see the Lord of the World. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਿਆ ਹਉ ਆਖਾ ਜਾਂ ਕਛੂ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: kiaa hau aakhaa jaa(n) kachhoo naeh ||
verses.translation: What can I say? I am nothing.
All my status and honor are in Your Name. ||3||

verses.original: ਕਾਹੇ ਮਾਲੁ ਦਰਬੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਗਰਬਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: kaahe maal dharab dhekh garab jaeh ||
verses.translation: Why do you take such pride in gazing upon your property and wealth?
When you must leave, nothing shall go along with you. ||4||
So subdue the five thieves, and hold your consciousness in its place.
This is the basis of the way of Yoga. ||5||
Your mind is tied with the rope of egotism.

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਨ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: har na cheteh mooRe mukat jaeh ||6||
verses.translation: You do not even think of the Lord - you fool! He alone shall liberate you. ||6||

verses.original: ਮਤ ਹਰਿ ਵਿਸਰਿਐ ਜਮ ਵਸਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: mat har visariaai jam vas paeh ||
verses.translation: If you forget the Lord, you will fall into the clutches of the Messenger of Death.
At that very last moment, you fool, you shall be beaten. ||7||
Contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and be rid of your ego.
True Yoga shall come to dwell in your mind. ||8||

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦਿਤਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਚੇਤਹਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: jin jeeau pi(n)dd dhitaa tis cheteh naeh ||
verses.translation: He blessed you with body and soul, but you do not even think of Him.
You fool! Visiting graves and cremation grounds is not Yoga. ||9||
Nanak chants the sublime, glorious Bani of the Word.
Understand it, and appreciate it. ||10||5||
Basant, First Mehla:
In duality and evil-mindedness, the mortal acts blindly.
The self-willed manmukh wanders, lost in the darkness. ||1||
The blind man follows blind advice.

verses.original: ਗੁਰ ਕਰਣੀ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਭਾਗੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: gur karanee bin bharam na bhaagai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Unless one takes the Guru's Way, his doubt is not dispelled. ||1||Pause||
The manmukh is blind; he does not like the Guru's Teachings.
He has become a beast; he cannot get rid of his egotistical pride. ||2||
God created 8.4 million species of beings.
My Lord and Master, by the Pleasure of His Will, creates and destroys them. ||3||
All are deluded and confused, without the Word of the Shabad and good conduct.
He alone is instructed in this, who is blessed by the Guru, the Creator. ||4||
The Guru's servants are pleasing to our Lord and Master.
The Lord forgives them, and they no longer fear the Messenger of Death. ||5||
Those who love the One Lord with all their heart
- He dispels their doubts and unites them with Himself. ||6||
God is Independent, Endless and Infinite.
The Creator Lord is pleased with Truth. ||7||
O Nanak, the Guru instructs the mistaken soul.
He implants the Truth within him, and shows him the One Lord. ||8||6||
Basant, First Mehla:
He Himself is the bumble bee, the fruit and the vine.
He Himself unites us with the Sangat - the Congregation, and the Guru, our Best Friend. ||1||
O bumble bee, suck in that fragrance,
which causes the trees to flower, and the woods to grow lush foliage. ||1||Pause||
He Himself is Lakshmi, and He Himself is her husband.
He established the world by Word of His Shabad, and He Himself ravishes it. ||2||
He Himself is the calf, the cow and the milk.
He Himself is the Support of the body-mansion. ||3||
He Himself is the Deed, and He Himself is the Doer.
As Gurmukh, He contemplates Himself. ||4||
You create the creation, and gaze upon it, O Creator Lord.
You give Your Support to the uncounted beings and creatures. ||5||
You are the Profound, Unfathomable Ocean of Virtue.
You are the Unknowable, the Immaculate, the most Sublime Jewel. ||6||
You Yourself are the Creator, with the Potency to create.
You are the Independent Ruler, whose people are at peace. ||7||
Nanak is satisfied with the subtle taste of the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਜਨਮੁ ਬਾਦਿ ॥੮॥੭॥
verses.translit: bin har gur preetam janam baadh ||8||7||
verses.translation: Without the Beloved Lord and Master, life is meaningless. ||8||7||

verses.translit: basa(n)t hi(n)ddol mahalaa pehilaa ghar doojaa
verses.translation: Basant Hindol, First Mehla, Second House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਨਉ ਸਤ ਚਉਦਹ ਤੀਨਿ ਚਾਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਹਲਤਿ ਚਾਰਿ ਬਹਾਲੀ ॥
verses.translit: nau sat chaudheh teen chaar kar mahalat chaar bahaalee ||
verses.translation: The nine regions, the seven continents, the fourteen worlds, the three qualities and the four ages - You established them all through the four sources of creation, and You seated them in Your mansions.

verses.original: ਚਾਰੇ ਦੀਵੇ ਚਹੁ ਹਥਿ ਦੀਏ ਏਕਾ ਏਕਾ ਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: chaare dheeve chahu hath dhe'ee ekaa ekaa vaaree ||1||
verses.translation: He placed the four lamps, one by one, into the hands of the four ages. ||1||

verses.original: ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ਮਧੁਸੂਦਨ ਮਾਧੌ ਐਸੀ ਸਕਤਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: miharavaan madhusoodhan maadhau aaisee sakat tum(h)aaree ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: O Merciful Lord, Destroyer of demons, Lord of Lakshmi, such is Your Power - Your Shakti. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਲਸਕਰੁ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਸਿਕਦਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: ghar ghar lasakar paavak teraa dharam kare sikadhaaree ||
verses.translation: Your army is the fire in the home of each and every heart. And Dharma - righteous living is the ruling chieftain.

verses.original: ਧਰਤੀ ਦੇਗ ਮਿਲੈ ਇਕ ਵੇਰਾ ਭਾਗੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: dharatee dheg milai ik veraa bhaag teraa bha(n)ddaaree ||2||
verses.translation: The earth is Your great cooking pot; Your beings receive their portions only once. Destiny is Your gate-keeper. ||2||

verses.original: ਨਾ ਸਾਬੂਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਮੰਗੈ ਨਾਰਦੁ ਕਰੇ ਖੁਆਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: naa saaboor hovai fir ma(n)gai naaradh kare khuaaree ||
verses.translation: But the mortal becomes unsatisfied, and begs for more; his fickle mind brings him disgrace.

verses.original: ਲਬੁ ਅਧੇਰਾ ਬੰਦੀਖਾਨਾ ਅਉਗਣ ਪੈਰਿ ਲੁਹਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: lab adheraa ba(n)dheekhaanaa aaugan pair luhaaree ||3||
verses.translation: Greed is the dark dungeon, and demerits are the shackles on his feet. ||3||

verses.original: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਮਾਰ ਪਵੈ ਨਿਤ ਮੁਦਗਰ ਪਾਪੁ ਕਰੇ ਕੋੁਟਵਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: poo(n)jee maar pavai nit mudhagar paap kare kuoTavaaree ||
verses.translation: His wealth constantly batters him, and sin acts as the police officer.

verses.original: ਭਾਵੈ ਚੰਗਾ ਭਾਵੈ ਮੰਦਾ ਜੈਸੀ ਨਦਰਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: bhaavai cha(n)gaa bhaavai ma(n)dhaa jaisee nadhar tum(h)aaree ||4||
verses.translation: Whether the mortal is good or bad, he is as You look upon him, O Lord. ||4||

verses.original: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਕਉ ਅਲਹੁ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੇਖਾਂ ਆਈ ਵਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: aadh purakh kau alahu kaheeaai sekhaa(n) aaiee vaaree ||
verses.translation: The Primal Lord God is called Allah. The Shaykh's turn has now come.

verses.original: ਦੇਵਲ ਦੇਵਤਿਆ ਕਰੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਐਸੀ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਚਾਲੀ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: dheval dhevatiaa kar laagaa aaisee keerat chaalee ||5||
verses.translation: The temples of the gods are subject to taxes; this is what it has come to. ||5||

verses.original: ਕੂਜਾ ਬਾਂਗ ਨਿਵਾਜ ਮੁਸਲਾ ਨੀਲ ਰੂਪ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: koojaa baa(n)g nivaaj musalaa neel roop banavaaree ||
verses.translation: The Muslim devotional pots, calls to prayer, prayers and prayer mats are everywhere; the Lord appears in blue robes.

verses.original: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਮੀਆ ਸਭਨਾਂ ਜੀਆਂ ਬੋਲੀ ਅਵਰ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: ghar ghar meeaa sabhanaa(n) jeeaa(n) bolee avar tumaaree ||6||
verses.translation: In each and every home, everyone uses Muslim greetings; your speech has changed, O people. ||6||

verses.original: ਜੇ ਤੂ ਮੀਰ ਮਹੀਪਤਿ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਉਣ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
verses.translit: je too meer maheepat saahib kudharat kaun hamaaree ||
verses.translation: You, O my Lord and Master, are the King of the earth; what power do I have to challenge You?

verses.original: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਟ ਸਲਾਮੁ ਕਰਹਿਗੇ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਸਿਫਤਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: chaare ku(n)T salaam karahige ghar ghar sifat tum(h)aaree ||7||
verses.translation: In the four directions, people bow in humble adoration to You; Your Praises are sung in each and every heart. ||7||

verses.original: ਤੀਰਥ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਕਿਛੁ ਲਾਹਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਦਿਹਾੜੀ ॥
verses.translit: teerath si(n)mirat pu(n)n dhaan kichh laahaa milai dhihaaRee ||
verses.translation: Making pilgrimages to sacred shrines, reading the Simritees and giving donations in charity - these do bring any profit.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਮੇਕਾ ਘੜੀ ਸਮੑਾਲੀ ॥੮॥੧॥੮॥
verses.translit: naanak naam milai vaddiaaiee mekaa ghaRee sam(h)aalee ||8||1||8||
verses.translation: O Nanak, glorious greatness is obtained in an instant, remembering the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||8||1||8||

verses.translit: basa(n)t hi(n)ddol ghar doojaa mahalaa chauthhaa
verses.translation: Basant Hindol, Second House, Fourth Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਕਾਂਇਆ ਨਗਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਖਿਨੁ ਪਲੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਨ ਰਹਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: kaa(n)iaa nagar ik baalak vasiaa khin pal thir na rahaiee ||
verses.translation: Within the body-village there lives a child who cannot hold still, even for an instant.

verses.original: ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਵ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਥਾਕੇ ਬਾਰੰ ਬਾਰ ਭਰਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: anik upaav jatan kar thaake baara(n) baar bharamaiee ||1||
verses.translation: It makes so many efforts, and grows weary, but still, it wanders restlessly again and again. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਇਕਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਆਣੁ ॥
verses.translit: mere Thaakur baalak ikat ghar aan ||
verses.translation: O my Lord and Master, Your child has come home, to be one with You.

verses.original: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: satigur milai ta pooraa paieeaai bhaj raam naam neesaan ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Meeting the True Guru, he finds the Perfect Lord. Meditating and vibrating on the Name of the Lord, he receives the Insignia of the Lord. ||1||Pause||

verses.original: ਇਹੁ ਮਿਰਤਕੁ ਮੜਾ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਵਸਿਆ ॥
verses.translit: eih mritak maRaa sareer hai sabh jag jit raam naam nahee vasiaa ||
verses.translation: These are dead corpses, these bodies of all the people of the world; the Name of the Lord does not dwell in them.

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਉਦਕੁ ਚੁਆਇਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਆ ਰਸਿਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: raam naam gur udhak chuaaiaa fir hariaa hoaa rasiaa ||2||
verses.translation: The Guru leads us to taste the water of the Lord's Name, and then we savor and enjoy it, and our bodies are rejuvenated. ||2||

verses.original: ਮੈ ਨਿਰਖਤ ਨਿਰਖਤ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਸਭੁ ਖੋਜਿਆ ਇਕੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਲਤੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: mai nirakhat nirakhat sareer sabh khojiaa ik gurmukh chalat dhikhaiaa ||
verses.translation: I have examined and studied and searched my entire body, and as Gurmukh, I behold a miraculous wonder.

verses.original: ਬਾਹਰੁ ਖੋਜਿ ਮੁਏ ਸਭਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: baahar khoj mue sabh saakat har gurmatee ghar paiaa ||3||
verses.translation: All the faithless cynics searched outside and died, but following the Guru's Teachings, I have found the Lord within the home of my own heart. ||3||

verses.original: ਦੀਨਾ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਜਿਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਸਨੁ ਬਿਦਰ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥
verses.translit: dheenaa dheen dhiaal bhe hai jiau kirasan bidhar ghar aaiaa ||
verses.translation: God is Merciful to the meekest of the meek; Krishna came to the house of Bidar, a devotee of low social status.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿਓ ਸੁਦਾਮਾ ਭਾਵਨੀ ਧਾਰਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਆਗੈ ਦਾਲਦੁ ਭੰਜਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: milio sudhaamaa bhaavanee dhaar sabh kichh aagai dhaaladh bha(n)j samaiaa ||4||
verses.translation: Sudama loved God, who came to meet him; God sent everything to his home, and ended his poverty. ||4||

verses.original: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਵਡੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਰਖਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: raam naam kee paij vadderee mere Thaakur aap rakhaiee ||
verses.translation: Great is the glory of the Name of the Lord. My Lord and Master Himself has enshrined it within me.

verses.original: ਜੇ ਸਭਿ ਸਾਕਤ ਕਰਹਿ ਬਖੀਲੀ ਇਕ ਰਤੀ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਘਟਾਈ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: je sabh saakat kareh bakheelee ik ratee til na ghaTaiee ||5||
verses.translation: Even if all the faithless cynics continue slandering me, it is not diminished by even one iota. ||5||

verses.original: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: jan kee usatat hai raam naamaa dheh dhis sobhaa paiee ||
verses.translation: The Lord's Name is the praise of His humble servant. It brings him honor in the ten directions.

verses.original: ਨਿੰਦਕੁ ਸਾਕਤੁ ਖਵਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਤਿਲੁ ਅਪਣੈ ਘਰਿ ਲੂਕੀ ਲਾਈ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: ni(n)dhak saakat khav na sakai til apanai ghar lookee laiee ||6||
verses.translation: The slanderers and the faithless cynics cannot endure it at all; they have set fire to their own houses. ||6||

verses.original: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਜਨੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਵੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਾਸਾ ॥
verses.translit: jan kau jan mil sobhaa paavai gun meh gun paragaasaa ||
verses.translation: The humble person meeting with another humble person obtains honor. In the glory of the Lord, their glory shines forth.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕੇ ਜਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜੋ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸਾ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: mere Thaakur ke jan preetam piaare jo hoveh dhaasan dhaasaa ||7||
verses.translation: The servants of my Lord and Master are loved by the Beloved. They are the slaves of His slaves. ||7||

verses.original: ਆਪੇ ਜਲੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: aape jal apara(n)par karataa aape mel milaavai ||
verses.translation: The Creator Himself is the Water; He Himself unites us in His Union.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਜਿਉ ਜਲੁ ਜਲਹਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥੮॥੧॥੯॥
verses.translit: naanak gurmukh sahaj milaae jiau jal jaleh samaavai ||8||1||9||
verses.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukh is absorbed in celestial peace and poise, like water blending with water. ||8||1||9||

verses.translit: basa(n)t mahalaa panjavaa ghar pehilaa dhutukeeaa
verses.translation: Basant, Fifth Mehla, First House, Du-Tukee:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Listen to the stories of the devotees, O my mind, and meditate with love.
Ajaamal uttered the Lord's Name once, and was saved.
Baalmeek found the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
The Lord definitely met Dhroo. ||1||
I beg for the dust of the feet of Your Saints.

verses.original: ਲੇ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਾਵਉ ਕਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਦੇਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: le masatak laavau kar kirapaa dhen ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Please bless me with Your Mercy, Lord, that I may apply it to my forehead. ||1||Pause||
Ganika the prostitute was saved, when her parrot uttered the Lord's Name.
The elephant meditated on the Lord, and was saved.
He delivered the poor Brahmin Sudama out of poverty.

verses.original: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਤੂ ਭੀ ਭਜੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: re man too bhee bhaj gobi(n)dh ||2||
verses.translation: O my mind, you too must meditate and vibrate on the Lord of the Universe. ||2||
Even the hunter who shot an arrow at Krishna was saved.
Kubija the hunchback was saved, when God placed His Feet on her thumb.
Bidar was saved by his attitude of humility.

verses.original: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਤੂ ਭੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: re man too bhee har dhiaai ||3||
verses.translation: O my mind, you too must meditate on the Lord. ||3||
The Lord Himself saved the honor of Prahlaad.
Even when she was being disrobed in court, Dropatee's honor was preserved.
Those who have served the Lord, even at the very last instant of their lives, are saved.

verses.original: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਸੇਵਿ ਤੂ ਪਰਹਿ ਪਾਰ ॥੪॥
verses.translit: re man sev too pareh paar ||4||
verses.translation: O my mind, serve Him, and you shall be carried across to the other side. ||4||
Dhanna served the Lord, with the innocence of a child.
Meeting with the Guru, Trilochan attained the perfection of the Siddhas.
The Guru blessed Baynee with His Divine Illumination.

verses.original: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਤੂ ਭੀ ਹੋਹਿ ਦਾਸੁ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: re man too bhee hoh dhaas ||5||
verses.translation: O my mind, you too must be the Lord's slave. ||5||
Jai Dayv gave up his egotism.
Sain the barber was saved through his selfless service.

verses.original: ਮਨੁ ਡੀਗਿ ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ਕਹੂੰ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: man ddeeg na ddolai kahoo(n) jai ||
verses.translation: Do not let your mind waver or wander; do not let it go anywhere.

verses.original: ਮਨ ਤੂ ਭੀ ਤਰਸਹਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਾਇ ॥੬॥
verses.translit: man too bhee taraseh saran pai ||6||
verses.translation: O my mind, you too shall cross over; seek the Sanctuary of God. ||6||
O my Lord and Master, You have shown Your Mercy to them.
You saved those devotees.

verses.original: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਗੁਣੁ ਅਵਗਣੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਕੋਇ ॥
verses.translit: tin kaa gun avagan na beechaario koi ||
verses.translation: You do not take their merits and demerits into account.

verses.original: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਮਨੁ ਲਗਾ ਸੇਵ ॥੭॥
verses.translit: eeh bidh dhekh man lagaa sev ||7||
verses.translation: Seeing these ways of Yours, I have dedicated my mind to Your service. ||7||
Kabeer meditated on the One Lord with love.
Naam Dayv lived with the Dear Lord.
Ravi Daas meditated on God, the Incomparably Beautiful.
Guru Nanak Dayv is the Embodiment of the Lord of the Universe. ||8||1||
Basant, Fifth Mehla:
The mortal wanders in reincarnation through countless lifetimes.
Without meditating in remembrance on the Lord, he falls into hell.
Without devotional worship, he is cut apart into pieces.
Without understanding, he is punished by the Messenger of Death. ||1||
Meditate and vibrate forever on the Lord of the Universe, O my friend.

verses.original: ਸਾਚ ਸਬਦ ਕਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: saach sabadh kar sadhaa preet ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Love forever the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||Pause||
Contentment does not come by any endeavors.
All the show of Maya is just a cloud of smoke.
The mortal does not hesitate to commit sins.
Intoxicated with poison, he comes and goes in reincarnation. ||2||
Acting in egotism and self-conceit, his corruption only increases.
The world is drowning in attachment and greed.
Sexual desire and anger hold the mind in its power.
Even in his dreams, he does not chant the Lord's Name. ||3||
Sometimes he is a king, and sometimes he is a beggar.
The world is bound by pleasure and pain.
The mortal makes no arrangements to save himself.
The bondage of sin continues to hold him. ||4||
He has no beloved friends or companions.
He himself eats what he himself plants.
He gathers up that which brings corruption;

verses.original: ਸੇ ਛੋਡਿ ਚਲਿਆ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੫॥
verses.translit: se chhodd chaliaa khin meh gavaar ||5||
verses.translation: leaving them, the fool must depart in an instant. ||5||
He wanders in attachment to Maya.
He acts in accordance with the karma of his past actions.
Only the Creator Himself remains detached.
God is not affected by virtue or vice. ||6||
Please save me, O Merciful Lord of the Universe!
I seek Your Sanctuary, O Perfect Compassionate Lord.
Without You, I have no other place of rest.
Please take pity on me, God, and bless me with Your Name. ||7||
You are the Creator, and You are the Doer.
You are High and Exalted, and You are totally Infinite.
Please be merciful, and attach me to the hem of Your robe.
Slave Nanak has entered the Sanctuary of God. ||8||2||
Basant Kee Vaar, Fifth Mehla:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

verses.original: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਕੈ ਹੋਹੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਭਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: har kaa naam dhiaai kai hoh hariaa bhaiee ||
verses.translation: Meditate on the Lord's Name, and blossom forth in green abundance.

verses.original: ਕਰਮਿ ਲਿਖੰਤੈ ਪਾਈਐ ਇਹ ਰੁਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: karam likha(n)tai paieeaai ieh rut suhaiee ||
verses.translation: By your high destiny, you have been blessed with this wondrous spring of the soul.

verses.original: ਵਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣੁ ਮਉਲਿਆ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: van tiran tirabhavan mauliaa a(n)mirat fal paiee ||
verses.translation: See all the three worlds in bloom, and obtain the Fruit of Ambrosial Nectar.

verses.original: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਲਥੀ ਸਭ ਛਾਈ ॥
verses.translit: mil saadhoo sukh uoopajai lathee sabh chhaiee ||
verses.translation: Meeting with the Holy Saints, peace wells up, and all sins are erased.

verses.original: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਫਿਰਿ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਨ ਧਾਈ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: naanak simarai ek naam fir bahuR na dhaiee ||1||
verses.translation: O Nanak, remember in meditation the One Name, and you shall never again be consigned to the womb of reincarnation.. ||1||

verses.original: ਪੰਜੇ ਬਧੇ ਮਹਾਬਲੀ ਕਰਿ ਸਚਾ ਢੋਆ ॥
verses.translit: pa(n)je badhe mahaabalee kar sachaa ddoaa ||
verses.translation: The five powerful desires are bound down, when you lean on the True Lord.

verses.original: ਆਪਣੇ ਚਰਣ ਜਪਾਇਅਨੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਦਯੁ ਖੜੋਆ ॥
verses.translit: aapane charan japaian vich dhay khaRoaa ||
verses.translation: The Lord Himself leads us to dwell at His Feet. He stands right in our midst.

verses.original: ਰੋਗ ਸੋਗ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਨਿਤ ਨਵਾ ਨਿਰੋਆ ॥
verses.translit: rog sog sabh miT ge nit navaa niroaa ||
verses.translation: All sorrows and sicknesses are eradicated, and you become ever-fresh and rejuvenated.

verses.original: ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਣਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਇ ਨ ਮੋਆ ॥
verses.translit: dhin rain naam dhiaaidhaa fir pai na moaa ||
verses.translation: Night and day, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. You shall never again die.

verses.original: ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸੋਈ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਆ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: jis te upajiaa naanakaa soiee fir hoaa ||2||
verses.translation: And the One, from whom we came, O Nanak, into Him we merge once again. ||2||

verses.original: ਕਿਥਹੁ ਉਪਜੈ ਕਹ ਰਹੈ ਕਹ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: kithahu upajai keh rahai keh maeh samaavai ||
verses.translation: Where do we come from? Where do we live? Where do we go in the end?

verses.original: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਖਸਮ ਕੇ ਕਉਣੁ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: jeea ja(n)t sabh khasam ke kaun keemat paavai ||
verses.translation: All creatures belong to God, our Lord and Master. Who can place a value on Him?

verses.original: ਕਹਨਿ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਸੁਣਨਿ ਨਿਤ ਸੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: kahan dhiaain sunan nit se bhagat suhaavai ||
verses.translation: Those who meditate, listen and chant, those devotees are blessed and beautified.

verses.original: ਅਗਮੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੋ ਦੂਸਰੁ ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
verses.translit: agam agochar saahibo dhoosar lavai na laavai ||
verses.translation: The Lord God is Inaccessible and Unfathomable; there is no other equal to Him.

verses.original: ਸਚੁ ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸਿਆ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥੩॥੧॥
verses.translit: sach poorai gur upadhesiaa naanak sunaavai ||3||1||
verses.translation: The Perfect Guru has taught this Truth. Nanak proclaims it to the world. ||3||1||
Basant, The Word Of The Devotees,
Kabeer Jee, First House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
The earth is in bloom, and the sky is in bloom.
Each and every heart has blossomed forth, and the soul is illumined. ||1||
My Sovereign Lord King blossoms forth in countless ways.

verses.original: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਉ ਤਹ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: jeh dhekhau teh rahiaa samai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: Wherever I look, I see Him there pervading. ||1||Pause||
The four Vedas blossom forth in duality.
The Simritees blossom forth, along with the Koran and the Bible. ||2||
Shiva blossoms forth in Yoga and meditation.
Kabeer's Lord and Master pervades in all alike. ||3||1||
The Pandits, the Hindu religious scholars, are intoxicated, reading the Puraanas.
The Yogis are intoxicated in Yoga and meditation.
The Sannyaasees are intoxicated in egotism.
The penitents are intoxicated with the mystery of penance. ||1||

verses.original: ਸਭ ਮਦ ਮਾਤੇ ਕੋਊ ਨ ਜਾਗ ॥
verses.translit: sabh madh maate kouoo na jaag ||
verses.translation: All are intoxicated with the wine of Maya; no one is awake and aware.

verses.original: ਸੰਗ ਹੀ ਚੋਰ ਘਰੁ ਮੁਸਨ ਲਾਗ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: sa(n)g hee chor ghar musan laag ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: The thieves are with them, plundering their homes. ||1||Pause||
Suk Dayv and Akrur are awake and aware.
Hanuman with his tail is awake and aware.
Shiva is awake, serving at the Lord's Feet.
Naam Dayv and Jai Dayv are awake in this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. ||2||
There are many ways of being awake, and sleeping.
To be awake as Gurmukh is the most excellent way.
The most sublime of all the actions of this body,
says Kabeer, is to meditate and vibrate on the Lord's Name. ||3||2||
The wife gives birth to her husband.
The son leads his father in play.
Without breasts, the mother nurses her baby. ||1||
Behold, people! This is how it is in the Dark Age of Kali Yuga.
The son marries his mother. ||1||Pause||
Without feet, the mortal jumps.
Without a mouth, he bursts into laughter.
Without feeling sleepy, he lays down and sleeps.
Without a churn, the milk is churned. ||2||
Without udders, the cow gives milk.
Without travelling, a long journey is made.
Without the True Guru, the path is not found.
Says Kabeer, see this, and understand. ||3||3||
Prahlaad was sent to school.
He took many of his friends along with him.

verses.original: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਹਾ ਪੜੑਾਵਸਿ ਆਲ ਜਾਲ ॥
verses.translit: mo kau kahaa paR(h)aavas aal jaal ||
verses.translation: He asked his teacher, ""Why do you teach me about worldly affairs?

verses.original: ਮੇਰੀ ਪਟੀਆ ਲਿਖਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੋੁਪਾਲ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: meree paTeeaa likh dheh sree guopaal ||1||
verses.translation: Write the Name of the Dear Lord on my tablet.""||1||

verses.original: ਨਹੀ ਛੋਡਉ ਰੇ ਬਾਬਾ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ॥
verses.translit: nahee chhoddau re baabaa raam naam ||
verses.translation: O Baba, I will not forsake the Name of the Lord.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੋ ਅਉਰ ਪੜੑਨ ਸਿਉ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਮੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mero aaur paR(h)n siau nahee kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: I will not bother with any other lessons. ||1||Pause||
Sanda and Marka went to the king to complain.
He sent for Prahlaad to come at once.

verses.original: ਤੂ ਰਾਮ ਕਹਨ ਕੀ ਛੋਡੁ ਬਾਨਿ ॥
verses.translit: too raam kahan kee chhodd baan ||
verses.translation: He said to him, ""Stop uttering the Lord's Name.

verses.original: ਤੁਝੁ ਤੁਰਤੁ ਛਡਾਊ ਮੇਰੋ ਕਹਿਓ ਮਾਨਿ ॥੨॥
verses.translit: tujh turat chhaddaauoo mero kahio maan ||2||
verses.translation: I shall release you at once, if you obey my words.""||2||

verses.original: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਕਹਾ ਸਤਾਵਹੁ ਬਾਰ ਬਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: mo kau kahaa sataavahu baar baar ||
verses.translation: Prahlaad answered, ""Why do you annoy me, over and over again?

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਜਲ ਥਲ ਗਿਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਪਹਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: prabh jal thal gir ke'ee pahaar ||
verses.translation: God created the water, land, hills and mountains.

verses.original: ਇਕੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਛੋਡਉ ਗੁਰਹਿ ਗਾਰਿ ॥
verses.translit: eik raam na chhoddau gureh gaar ||
verses.translation: I shall not forsake the One Lord; if I did, I would be going against my Guru.

verses.original: ਮੋ ਕਉ ਘਾਲਿ ਜਾਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਮਾਰਿ ਡਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
verses.translit: mo kau ghaal jaar bhaavai maar ddaar ||3||
verses.translation: You might as well throw me into the fire and kill me.""||3||
The king became angry and drew his sword.
"Show me your protector now!"

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਥੰਭ ਤੇ ਨਿਕਸੇ ਕੈ ਬਿਸਥਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: prabh tha(n)bh te nikase kai bisathaar ||
verses.translation: So God emerged out of the pillar, and assumed a mighty form.
He killed Harnaakhash, tearing him apart with his nails. ||4||
The Supreme Lord God, the Divinity of the divine,
for the sake of His devotee, assumed the form of the man-lion.

verses.original: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਕੋ ਲਖੈ ਨ ਪਾਰ ॥
verses.translit: keh kabeer ko lakhai na paar ||
verses.translation: Says Kabeer, no one can know the Lord's limits.
He saves His devotees like Prahlaad over and over again. ||5||4||

verses.original: ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਮਨ ਮਧੇ ਮਦਨ ਚੋਰ ॥
verses.translit: eis tan man madhe madhan chor ||
verses.translation: Within the body and mind are thieves like sexual desire,

verses.original: ਜਿਨਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਰਤਨੁ ਹਿਰਿ ਲੀਨ ਮੋਰ ॥
verses.translit: jin giaan ratan hir leen mor ||
verses.translation: which has stolen my jewel of spiritual wisdom.
I am a poor orphan, O God; unto whom should I complain?

verses.original: ਕੋ ਕੋ ਨ ਬਿਗੂਤੋ ਮੈ ਕੋ ਆਹਿ ॥੧॥
verses.translit: ko ko na bigooto mai ko aaeh ||1||
verses.translation: Who has not been ruined by sexual desire? What am I? ||1||

verses.original: ਮਾਧਉ ਦਾਰੁਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਸਹਿਓ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
verses.translit: maadhau dhaarun dhukh sahio na jai ||
verses.translation: O Lord, I cannot endure this agonizing pain.

verses.original: ਮੇਰੋ ਚਪਲ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਿਉ ਕਹਾ ਬਸਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
verses.translit: mero chapal budh siau kahaa basai ||1|| rahaau ||
verses.translation: What power does my fickle mind have against it? ||1||Pause||
Sanak, Sanandan, Shiva and Suk Dayv
were born out of Brahma's naval chakra.
The poets and the Yogis with their matted hair
all lived their lives with good behavior. ||2||
You are Unfathomable; I cannot know Your depth.

verses.original: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਹਉ ਕਾਹਿ ॥
verses.translit: prabh dheenaa naath dhukh kahau kaeh ||
verses.translation: O God, Master of the meek, unto whom should I tell my pains?

verses.original: ਮੋਰੋ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖੁ ਆਥਿ ਧੀਰ ॥
verses.translit: moro janam maran dhukh aath dheer ||
verses.translation: Please rid me of the pains of birth and death, and bless me with peace.
Kabeer utters the Glorious Praises of God, the Ocean of peace. ||3||5||
There is one merchant and five traders.
The twenty-five oxen carry false merchandise.
There are nine poles which hold the ten bags.
The body is tied by the seventy-two ropes. ||1||

verses.original: ਮੋਹਿ ਐਸੇ ਬਨਜ ਸਿਉ ਨਹੀਨ ਕਾਜੁ ॥
verses.translit: moh aaise banaj siau naheen kaaj ||
verses.translation: I don't care at all about such commerce.
